chapters.title: Chapter 801 - 790: Nanhua Old Immortal
paragraphs: Rumble!
One saber strike after another, cleaving deeper and deeper into the ravine!

Ding Ling is a Saint-Grade Golden Core, with True Qi surging within like a sea. Although this realm is extremely peculiar and True Qi cannot be replenished once consumed, Ding Ling’s Saint-Grade Golden Core is comparable to a Primordial Spirit strongman.
Moreover, the Celestial Cry Saber Technique is an Immortal Level skill.

Thus, Ding Ling does not worry about exhausting his True Qi and dying prematurely, as even if his True Qi runs out, his Body Refining Cultivation remains, allowing him to continue attacking Nanhua Old Immortal.
He doesn’t believe that Nanhua Old Immortal’s Inner Heaven and Earth can be damaged without affecting his true body.
Simply because Ding Ling’s Sword Spirit also possesses a Grotto World Structure, and damage to the Grotto World Structure would also cause significant harm to the Sword Spirit!
It is precisely because of this understanding that Ding Ling relentlessly attacks without hesitation.
Boom!
Boom Boom Boom!
As Ding Ling descended further, the Divine Meditation Technique mirrored the land within fifty miles to ensure he didn’t cleave the wrong spot.

Unlike in the Netherworld, where the Divine Meditation Technique could easily mirror a two-thousand-mile area, in this world exclusive to Nanhua Old Immortal’s Inner Heaven and Earth, Ding Ling was suppressed everywhere.
The area that the Divine Meditation Technique could mirror was suppressed to fifty miles.
Yet even so, it was sufficient for Ding Ling.
Leveraging the Divine Meditation Technique, Ding Ling could immediately detect changes in the land’s Heaven and Earth.
To prevent Ding Ling from cleaving deeper below.
The land kept shifting, even the earlier cleaved ravine had long disappeared.
Ding Ling didn’t need to look up.
He knew the ravine he had cleaved earlier must have been buried under soil.
He had now delved hundreds of miles deep into the earth!
Only the ravine within a dozen miles of where he stood had not been buried under the earth, while other areas had been covered by it.
This world sought to bury, crush, and grind him.
The earth shook and exerted force.
Simultaneously, various chaotic rules were applied to Ding Ling.
Fortunately, Ding Ling’s mind was clear, ignoring else aside from relentlessly focusing on a single point to cleave incessantly.
Boom Boom Boom!
This continued for half an hour.
Ding Ling sensed a glimmer of light ahead, rejoicing at speed to strike another saber, Boom! The brightness surged, and Ding Ling accelerated forward, facing a fleshy palm.
His Thirteenfold Amplification Heaven-Flipping Palm!
The full force of a palm unleashed.
Boom!
A colossal palm of ten thousand feet swept out, causing heaven and earth to crumble in its path, accompanied by a scream. Ding Ling looked and saw a person shattered by the palm’s force.
And this person seemed remarkably familiar.
It was Nanhua Old Immortal!
"Died just like that?!"
Ding Ling was astonished:
"Couldn’t withstand much at all."
He instinctively glanced at his Character Panel.
[Obtained a C-Class Achievement Medal: Intimidate Nanhua Old Immortal.]

[Note: Nanhua Old Immortal, as a deity of the Upper Realm, possesses unrivaled strength. He uses Dream Butterfly as the soul, the world as the skeleton, dispatching two puppet avatars. Hoping they’d achieve greatness in the Lower Realm.
Yet, the Nanhua Old Immortal growing in the Lower Realm was unaware of his true identity. But instinctively began refining the Six Great Realms!
Continuing since the Ancient Era till now.
He had already refined the Demon Realm and other worlds, and half of the Immortal Realm, half of the Netherworld.
His strength had soared to a level unmatched in the historical plane. To swiftly fulfill his aims, he frequently descended to choose mortal agents to initiate wars!
The Shang-Zhou War! Dayu’s governance of water! Wang Mang’s chaos... traces of him were everywhere!
Initially, he thought this time he could seamlessly accomplish his goals, refine the Netherworld, Immortal Realm, then proceed to refine the Human Realm.
Unexpectedly, you emerged from an unanticipated angle.
Your overwhelming power completely caught him off guard!
Until death, he couldn’t believe there was yet such an extraordinary person like you in the world!]
Looking at the panel’s prompt.
Ding Ling fell silent, reflected:
"I killed only a puppet?!"
Merely two puppets.
Referring to Kun and Nanhua Old Immortal?
Dream Butterfly as the soul.
World as the skeleton.
No wonder Kun ultimately transformed into a butterfly; evidently, the original is a butterfly!
"But what kind of butterfly is Dream Butterfly?"
Ding Ling combed through various ancient histories, finding no related species:
"Likely a divine beast existing in the Upper Realm?"
Ding Ling questioned, unsettled:
"Who exactly is Nanhua Old Immortal, possessing such might? Can dispatch a puppet to the Lower Realm? On what basis? Now that I have killed his puppet, aren’t we sworn enemies?"
Ding Ling didn’t know which plane Nanhua Old Immortal occupied in the Upper Realm.
But definitely not in planes like Fengyun.
Possibly existing in an apex plane of the Pyramid?
"The road is long, and the responsibility is heavy. There’s a long journey ahead."
Just a puppet had so many means.
One can only imagine the strength of the puppet’s creator.
Ding Ling surveyed this Heaven and Earth.
With Nanhua Old Immortal’s death.
Heaven and Earth experienced drastic change.
A broken world appeared before Ding Ling.
This world resembled a world Ding Ling had previously been in.
Ding Ling’s Divine Meditation Technique mirrored within a ten-thousand-mile radius, comprehending:

"Here is the Immortal Realm of the Three Kingdoms. With Nanhua Old Immortal’s demise, the Immortal Realm returns to its proper course, and my Divine Meditation Technique gains Netherworld Heavenly Dao empowerment, now easily mirroring a ten-thousand-mile radius again."
Ding Ling stepped forward, eyeing Nanhua Old Immortal’s head.
His body was blasted apart, leaving only a head.
His eyes stared unyieldingly at him, filled with fear, astonishment, shock.
His face etched with bewilderment.
It was imaginable.
Before his death, Nanhua Old Immortal surely embarked on an unimaginable ’self-rescue journey’.
Unfortunately.
He encountered Ding Ling, the All-Purpose King with a Saint-Grade Golden Core.
Facing other Saint-Grade Golden Core strongmen, they might perish, doomed in Nanhua Old Immortal’s Inner Heaven and Earth.
But Ding Ling was different.
He knew too much, as long as he found a way out, as long as the strength gap wasn’t colossal, nothing could stop him.
"Died just like that."
Ding Ling’s Sword Realm enveloped, seeking to extract Nanhua Old Immortal’s memory.
Only to discover his conscious information had long merged with the Heaven and Earth, nowhere to be found.
"Inner Heaven and Earth."
Ding Ling scanned the surroundings.
Nearby, mountain peaks layered, waters mirror-like, green mountains floating in water, reflections graceful;

In the distance, waters of the Celestial River cascaded like a waterfall suspended in air, rushing forward, falling amongst the sky-covering peculiar peaks, winding downward, forming a landscape painting as poetry.
"This is the Immortal Realm."
Ding Ling kicked Nanhua Old Immortal’s head, strolling within the Immortal Realm.
This Immortal Realm is vast.
With Nanhua Old Immortal’s demise.
Nanhua Old Immortal’s Inner Heaven and Earth began to integrate into this Immortal Realm.
The Immortal Realm started to revive.
Heavenly power also bestowed upon Ding Ling.
This is the Heavenly Dao of the Immortal Realm!
With the Immortal Realm’s celestial might enhancing him, Ding Ling moved even faster.

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - 791: Celestial Heart Mark
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s ability to penetrate and see through the material layers had also risen by several tiers along with everything else.
"The Celestial Might of the Immortal Realm is in no way weaker than that of the Netherworld, and in some respects it even surpasses it!"

"Moreover, Nanhua Old Immortal’s Inner Heaven and Earth refined quite a number of worlds, and these worlds have all begun to merge into the Immortal Realm. It’s foreseeable that the Immortal Realm will become unimaginably powerful in the future—perhaps it might even reach the level of the Wind and Cloud Celestial Realm?"
The level of the Netherworld was already extremely high.
The level of the Immortal Realm would become even higher in time.
It was foreseeable.
It was possible the Immortal Realm would not only reach the Wind and Cloud Celestial Realm’s level, but might even surpass it!
"I never imagined a Historical Plane would have such potential and fortune!"
Ding Ling thought of the potential of the Breathing Technique.
The Breathing Technique could be cultivated all the way up to the Martial Arts Dharma Aspect level!
A glimpse of the leopard through a tube!

In the Ancient Era, there must have been quite a few people with extremely terrifying talent who, relying on the Breathing Technique and other Techniques, cultivated all the way to the Martial Arts Golden Core, the Primordial Spirit, and even the Dharma Aspect level!
It was only that Nanhua Old Immortal descended upon this world and kept meddling with it!
It might precisely be because of Nanhua Old Immortal that many inheritances were cut off, causing the rank of the Three Kingdoms World to continually fall!
"Eh."

After Ding Ling walked around the Immortal Realm for a while, he suddenly felt that under the simultaneous blessing of the three strands of Celestial Might, his sense and control over the Immortal Realm, the Netherworld, and the Human World instantly increased a hundredfold, a thousandfold.
"It seems I can instantly turn back to the Human World or the Netherworld."
Ding Ling pondered for a moment, then took a step forward.
In the next instant.
He actually arrived at Human World Chang’an.
He landed in the courtyard of a certain residence.
"So it really works?"
Ding Ling was utterly astonished.
"Is it because I saved the Immortal Realm, the Netherworld, and the Human World? So the Heavenly Dao of these Three Realms voluntarily handed over their ’Celestial Heart Marks’ to me?"
What was a Celestial Heart Mark?
Previously, Ding Ling didn’t understand, and didn’t know.
But as the Netherworld continuously recovered, and the Immortal Realm awakened and revived, the Celestial Might on Ding Ling’s body grew ever stronger.
He then suddenly developed a kind of understanding: namely, that he could freely travel among the three worlds!
He could even roughly locate the positions of the three worlds, then cross over in an instant!
Not only that.
Having obtained the Celestial Heart Marks of the three worlds, he had become the sole Deity of this Historical Plane.
To a certain extent, he could even alter the rules of some regions.
Just like Nanhua Old Immortal’s Inner Heaven and Earth.
"Alter the rules. This is actually possible?"
Ding Ling mused:

"Looks like the essence within Nanhua Old Immortal’s Inner Heaven and Earth was absorbed by the Immortal Realm, granting the Immortal Realm this same capability? And since I’ve become the controller of the Immortal Realm’s Celestial Heart Mark, I naturally gained this ability to a certain degree as well?
Ding Ling was both shocked and eager to test it.
This ability to alter rules was truly inconceivable.
His Grotto World Structure was at least a hundred and eighty thousand miles away from being able to alter rules.
Previously he had even doubted how someone who was merely a Martial Arts Primordial Spirit expert like Nanhua Old Immortal could possess such a powerful Inner Heaven and Earth.
After all, neither the Demon Lord nor Tathagata Buddha of the Wind and Cloud World had such a thing.
So why did Nanhua Old Immortal have it?
Now he had realized.
Nanhua Old Immortal’s possession of this ability was definitely due to his true body bestowing it.
Whereas the Demon Lord and Buddha Lord, having not been granted this Divine Technique by their true bodies, naturally appeared far more ordinary.
"Prince."
A voice filled with surprise and delight suddenly sounded behind Ding Ling.
Ding Ling broke off his thoughts and turned toward the voice.
And saw that at some unknown point, a peerlessly beautiful maiden had appeared behind him.
Her beauty was in no way inferior to Da and Xiao Qiao’s.
The grace and scholarly aura she carried by nature added several degrees of charm to her for no reason at all; simply walking down the street, she was enough to move and draw the eyes of any man.
"Cai Wenji."
Ding Ling came to his senses.
He had actually landed in the Cai Mansion.

And because Cai Wenji held not the slightest hostility toward him—on the contrary, she harbored great goodwill and kindness—Ding Ling, whose mind had been preoccupied, hadn’t noticed her sudden arrival. Under normal circumstances, any slight movement of grass or trees would never escape his notice.
"Prince."

Cai Wenji, her face filled with excitement, took a step forward, but whether out of fear, self-abasement, or some other reason, a shadow of dimness flashed across her face; she actually blushed and retreated a step.
Ding Ling took this in but didn’t point it out, only saying:
"Where is Consulting Officer Cai?"
Consulting Officer Cai was precisely Cai Yong, Cai Wenji’s father.
When Ding Ling was invested as Prince, Cai Yong had been chosen as Consulting Officer.
"My father?"
Cai Wenji froze; the shyness on her face instantly turned into sorrow and grief. In the emptiness of her eyes, there was a trace of extreme pain:
"He’s passed away."
Ding Ling’s expression changed slightly:
"My condolences."
"This isn’t your fault."
Cai Wenji forced a smile, a very bitter one:
"Five years ago, shortly after you ascended and left, my father passed on.
"May you restrain your grief."
"I will. All these years, I’ve thought it through as well."

Cai Wenji recalled the words her father had spoken before his death: "Wenji, if you like the Prince, then be bold and pursue your own happiness. I will no longer stand in your way. I hope you can be safe, healthy, and happy for a lifetime. Remember what I’ve said—you must be brave. I will watch over you from the heavens and bless you."
Her almond-shaped eyes couldn’t help but turn toward Ding Ling. She mustered her courage, but still failed to speak the words buried in her heart.
Ever since she’d been personally rescued by Ding Ling from the Xiongnu’s hands six years ago.
Cai Wenji had never again been able to forget that figure who descended like a Celestial God, saving her from fire and water!
And afterward, in Chang’an, having interacted with Ding Ling several times.
Her feelings only grew deeper.
Unfortunately.
She was too embarrassed to speak.
Cai Yong had seen through it, but he died early and never managed to deliver the final Xin he wrote.
"If you ever need anything, you can go directly to the Prince’s Mansion and look for Diao Chan and the others."
Ding Ling had a great fondness for Cai Wenji and Cai Yong, so his voice was quite gentle:
"I’m sure they’ll help you."
Cai Wenji didn’t know what came over her; she only stared blankly at Ding Ling and said nothing.
After Ding Ling spoke with her a few more words and saw she was still like this, he chose to take his leave.
"Prince."
Right as Ding Ling vanished without a trace in the space of an instant.
Cai Wenji finally seemed to come back to herself and cried out, "Prince!"
But how could she still see any sign of Ding Ling’s figure?
She searched in all directions.
Yet couldn’t find him anywhere.
As though everything that had just happened had been but illusion and bubbles.
Lost in spirit, she slowly walked back to the cool pavilion, her Emei brows tightly furrowed, gazing toward the Prince’s Mansion with deep melancholy.
All these years.
She had lived like this.
The steward of the Cai Mansion heard the commotion and came over, asking Cai Wenji what had happened.
Cai Wenji forced herself to hold up her spirits and gave a brief account, in the end concluding that perhaps she’d merely had a dream.
The steward left with a thoughtful look.
Not long after.
He took a Xin and hurried straight toward the Prince’s Mansion.
This Xin had been given to him by Cai Yong.
He had said that if Ding Ling ever came to the Cai Mansion, this Xin must be handed over to him.

After Ding Ling spoke with her a few more words and saw she was still like this, he chose to take his leave.
"Prince."
Right as Ding Ling vanished without a trace in the space of an instant.
Cai Wenji finally seemed to come back to herself and cried out, "Prince!"
But how could she still see any sign of Ding Ling’s figure?
She searched in all directions.
Yet couldn’t find him anywhere.
As though everything that had just happened had been but illusion and bubbles.
Lost in spirit, she slowly walked back to the cool pavilion, her Emei brows tightly furrowed, gazing toward the Prince’s Mansion with deep melancholy.
All these years.
She had lived like this.
The steward of the Cai Mansion heard the commotion and came over, asking Cai Wenji what had happened.
Cai Wenji forced herself to hold up her spirits and gave a brief account, in the end concluding that perhaps she’d merely had a dream.
The steward left with a thoughtful look.
Not long after.
He took a Xin and hurried straight toward the Prince’s Mansion.
This Xin had been given to him by Cai Yong.
He had said that if Ding Ling ever came to the Cai Mansion, this Xin must be handed over to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - 792: Furnace Spirit
paragraphs: If Ding Ling didn’t come, so be it.
The butler was very loyal to Cai Yong.
He was also very kind and caring towards Cai Wenji.
Watching Cai Wenji alone every day, growing thinner and more solitary.
He saw it with his own eyes, and it worried him deeply.
But Ding Ling ascended and did not return, so he had no solution.
He had been eagerly awaiting Ding Ling’s return from the Upper Realm.
But Ding Ling never came to Cai Mansion, and the butler couldn’t go against Cai Yong’s last will.

Nevertheless, the butler couldn’t ignore Cai Wenji’s plight. Seeing Cai Wenji wasting away even more quickly after Ding Ling’s return, he was incredibly anxious. Just as he was about to send out the letter regardless, Ding Ling arrived!
At this moment, the butler was overjoyed and couldn’t wait any longer.
He left Cai Mansion and went straight to the Prince’s Mansion.
At the Prince’s Mansion, he handed the letter to Zhou Cang and waited at the entrance.
After some time.
Diao Chan summoned the butler.

The butler went to pay respect, knelt on the ground, sorrowfully spoke about Cai Wenji’s situation, and pleaded with Diao Chan to show mercy for Cai Yong’s sake, giving Cai Wenji a chance, otherwise, he feared she would die if things continued.
Diao Chan was moved and said:
"Unexpectedly, Wenji’s feelings for the Prince are so deep. Very well. I will decide for him. Starting today, Wenji is the Prince’s concubine."
"Thank you, Queen. Thank you, Queen."
The butler was ecstatic.
The two conversed for a while longer.
Diao Chan said:
"You mentioned the Prince went to see Wenji. Where is the Prince?"
"I came to see the Prince. The Queen doesn’t know, so how could I?"
"It seems the Prince inadvertently ended up at Cai Mansion."
Diao Chan thought to herself but did not mention it, instead saying:
"I will personally go to welcome Wenji to the Prince’s Mansion."
"Thank you, Queen."
"It’s my duty."
Perhaps it was because the world-crushing Kun was slain by Ding Ling.
Only a few, like Diao Chan, returned to the Prince’s Mansion from the Celestial Ladder, waiting for news from Ding Ling.
Unexpectedly, they awaited the butler from Cai Mansion instead of Ding Ling.
At this moment, Ding Ling was unaware of Diao Chan’s ’self-directed actions.’
With a flash, he arrived in the Netherworld.
Divine Meditation Technique illuminated twenty thousand miles around.
He instantly knew where he was.
Only fifty miles from eighty-two Puppet Soldiers.
"It seems there’s a discrepancy, but not too large."
The previous deviation at Chang’an was only about ten miles.
Here, it’s fifty miles.
Thus, the discrepancy seems to fall within this range.
Whoosh!
With a leap, Ding Ling arrived near the Puppet Soldiers.
"Master!"
The Puppet Soldiers greeted with respect.
Ding Ling nodded, reached his hand towards the furnace, grabbing it into his hand.
This furnace had previously split into eleven, each extremely large.
Yet, after merging into one, it became significantly smaller.
Holding one leg of the furnace, Ding Ling carefully sensed and investigated.
Perhaps because the Nanhua Old Immortal and Kun had died.
The furnace, having lost its master, no longer struggled fiercely, allowing Ding Ling to explore.
Ding Ling soon sensed a ’spirit’ hidden in the deepest part of the furnace, resembling a Dragon Spirit hidden within a Dragon Vein.
Extremely sentient.
After some thought, in the next moment, a Sword Spirit emerged from Ding Ling’s body and entered the depth of the furnace.
Although the Sword Spirit had a physical form.
His existence was extremely unique, neither human, nor immortal, nor ghost, yet he could dwell in a place like the Netherworld where only Ghost Gods reside.

Especially as Ding Ling received the Celestial Heart Mark from the Netherworld, Immortal Realm, and Human Realm, it was as though the Sword Spirit also got such endowment, making him a being walking beyond the five elements, allowing him to enter the depth of the furnace and communicate with the ’Furnace Spirit.’
The Furnace Spirit appeared as a delicate little girl, seemingly five or six years old.
She curled up in a corner, blinking her big eyes with some fear and timidity as she looked at the Sword Spirit who intruded.

The Sword Spirit shone with a brilliant golden light, resembling a Divine Sword. This light, within the internal world of the furnace, served as his natural protective light, but upon seeing how timid the Furnace Spirit was, the Sword Spirit retracted his sword light and started communicating with the Furnace Spirit.
The Sword Spirit grew from Ding Ling’s Sword Thought.
In essence, he is Ding Ling’s avatar.
Thus, he possesses all of Ding Ling’s knowledge and skills, including acting, psychology, Observing People Skill, mimicry, etc.
Under his gentle voice and clever rhetoric, the Furnace Spirit gradually lowered her guard, gaining a bit of trust in the Sword Spirit.
And she began revealing her origins under the Sword Spirit’s gentle persuasion.
Only then did Ding Ling learn some truths buried deep in this world.

It turned out the Furnace Spirit was forged and refined from the ’bones’ and ’blood’ of the Mountain and Sea Realm, endowed with ’Kun’s’ Divine Techniques and all of Nanhua Old Immortal’s ’Alchemy Skills,’ which enabled her to refine other worlds.
"Mountain and Sea Realm?"
Ding Ling was surprised.
The Wind and Cloud World also has a Mountain and Sea Realm.
"Yes."
The Furnace Spirit looked adorable and appeared extremely naive and pure. In his contact with her, Ding Ling realized that her innocence wasn’t feigned; it was her intrinsic nature.
She had been sealed in the World Furnace, unable to communicate with outsiders, be they people, things, or spirits, for years, entertaining herself. Her optimistic and lively nature was evident.
Of course, the primary reason was her enormous and burdensome task of refining worlds, day after day, year after year.
She hadn’t become dull or numb, which in itself was remarkable.
"I have never heard of the Mountain and Sea Realm."
"Aren’t you from the Upper Realm?"
The Furnace Spirit looked at the Sword Spirit with confusion and asked:
"Beings like you and me reside in the Mountain and Sea Realm within the Upper Realm."
"Where exactly in the Upper Realm is the Mountain and Sea Realm?"
"It’s in the Upper Realm."
The Furnace Spirit couldn’t provide a detailed answer, and Ding Ling didn’t press further, instead inquiring about the ’bones’ and ’blood.’

"The Mountain and Sea Realm is the mother who birthed spirits. She created us but was killed by a god. I am a world furnace forged from the bones and blood of my mother through special means by immortals."
"Do you mean the Mountain and Sea Realm is also a god?"
"She is not a god. But if you want to interpret it that way, you may."
The Furnace Spirit seemed to grasp something:
"Are you not from the Upper Realm? Then how did you manage to kill the deities sent from the Upper Realm?!"
She was shocked, covering her little mouth, and exclaimed:
"Are you a mortal who grew up in the Lower Realm?! Wow."
She marveled and admired, saying:
"You are amazing. To be able to kill even an Innate Divine Spirit."

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - 793: World Furnace
paragraphs: The Furnace Spirit seemed to remember something, and its eyes grew increasingly bright:
"Mother once said, if one asks who in this world can kill gods and save spirits, it might only be a mortal who can achieve it. Could that person be you?"
She looked at Ding Ling with anticipation, excitement, and eagerness.
Ding Ling was lost for words.
He was certain.
He definitely wasn’t the one the Mountain and Sea Realm was expecting to kill gods.
Perhaps it’s someone else.
Ding Ling was about to speak, but the Furnace Spirit said crisply:

"It must be you, no doubt. Even Kun and terrifying figures like Nanhua Old Immortal were slain by you. As a mere mortal, killing gods in defiance—it’s truly extraordinary. I imagine if Mother saw you, she would be very happy as well."
Curious by her words, Ding Ling asked:
"Is the Mountain and Sea Realm dead? Then where can spirits like you and me live?"
"There is more than one Mountain and Sea Realm."

As the Furnace Spirit continued chatting with the Sword Spirit, she seemed to grow more fond of the Sword Spirit—naturally, this was in part due to the charm of the Sword Spirit, as well as its way with words:
"There are nine Mountain and Sea Realms in the Upper Realm. My mother is dead, but there should be eight remaining."
Should be...
Ding Ling understood.
Yet, despite understanding, he remained puzzled.

After all, the Mountain and Sea Realm was a person who could nurture such beings as him—truly peculiar. Ding Ling searched through all the novels, TV shows, and movies in his mind but couldn’t find a world quite like this.
He could only secretly ponder the possibility that the so-called Upper Realm might exceed the understanding of films?
And so.
Ding Ling discovered much more truth from the Furnace Spirit.
"The undead of the Netherworld all transformed into Soul Qi and merged into the Netherworld, countering the refining of the World Furnace."
"And the process of merging is also actively facilitated by Nanhua Old Immortal. Because the more Soul Qi that merges in, the stronger the Heaven and Earth Pill refined will be."
As for why Great Virtuous Master Zhang Jiao is still alive?
Naturally, it’s because the Northern Realm where he lives is protected by Nanhua Old Immortal.
While the other Earth Realms did not receive Nanhua Old Immortal’s protection.
The people in those realms mostly wouldn’t live for more than a few years before passively merging into the heaven and earth.
The merge occurs very quickly.
Usually in an instant.
That the Furnace Spirit knows all this.
Naturally, it is related to her Divine Techniques Attribute Points.
She can refine the world into pills!
Overwhelmingly powerful beyond measure!
It’s not surprising she senses these situations.
Of course.
She only possesses the ability to accommodate and refine the world. Though her functionality is singular, she has achieved the ultimate in this singularity—she is a god!
"Isn’t Nanhua Old Immortal always in the Immortal Realm? How could he come specifically to the Netherworld to protect Zhang Jiao? How did he enter this Netherworld?"
Ding Ling asked.
The Furnace Spirit answered crisply:

"Nanhua Old Immortal has always attempted to subvert and refine the Mortal World and Six Realms. For only by thoroughly decaying and dismembering those underlying realms can the influence gradually reach the topmost worlds.
Hence, he sometimes descends to the Mortal World to spread his teachings.
And once anyone cultivates his magic and skills.
To a certain extent, they would be influenced by him, unwittingly acting according to his subtle instructions.
Zhang Jiao is likely his cultivated human proxy.
After Zhang Jiao’s death, because he practiced Nanhua Old Immortal’s magic, his region was automatically protected by the World Furnace from melting by the heaven and earth."
"I see."
Ding Ling found relief.
The previous owner of the World Furnace is Nanhua Old Immortal.
That the World Furnace protects Zhang Jiao.
Is equivalent to Nanhua Old Immortal protecting him.
It’s not that the Northern Realm is special, but because Zhang Jiao is in the Northern Realm!
"Have all the undead perished?"
Ding Ling thought of many heroic figures from history:
"Liu Xiu, Emperor Qin Shi Huang, Bai Qi, Huo Qubing, Weii Qing, Li Guang, Dayu... Have all these heroes and Human Emperors died?"
"All dead."
The Furnace Spirit replied:

"Some ascended to the Immortal Realm due to their profound cultivation, like the Three Emperors and Five Sovereigns; some, due to outstanding cultivation, ascended to the Demon Realm, similar to beauties of the Nine-tailed Fox clan. Some became gods after death, like Liann Po, Tian Dan, Le Yi, Li Mu, etc. However, they all perished in Nanhua Old Immortal’s schemes."
"The Three Emperors and Five Sovereigns are all dead."
Ding Ling felt a wave in his heart:
"Nanhua Old Immortal’s power isn’t very profound, so how did he achieve this?!"

"He secretly drew Primordial Qi from various realms using the World Furnace, constantly lowering the worlds’ status, causing the Three Emperors and Five Sovereigns’ strength to gradually diminish! Not only that, he also incarnated as various figures, infiltrating major tribes to instigate discord and wars! Due to mutual slaughter and widespread chaotic conflicts.
The World Furnace absorbed more and more Primordial Qi from the realms.
That’s how Nanhua Old Immortal, the mastermind, gained an advantage.
By the time some realized what was happening, it was too late. Nanhua Old Immortal had already become a Primordial Spirit Level strong person, aided by the World Furnace and Kun.
The severely injured, nearly decayed strong people of various realms stood no chance against him.
He swept them away one by one."
Ding Ling felt like he was listening to a legend.
"Don’t disbelieve. It’s the truth."
The Furnace Spirit said:

"You could kill him. He probably didn’t expect that someone as strong as you could exist in this world. Otherwise, given his personality, he would never have come out to personally confront you, but would rather stay hidden behind the scenes."
Ding Ling nodded, yet he still felt a bit dreamy.
Because he killed Nanhua Old Immortal, it seemed he did so too easily.
But on second thought, this was due to Nanhua Old Immortal facing him, an All-Powerful with a Saint-Grade Golden Core.
If faced with another Saint-Grade Golden Core, Nanhua Old Immortal would certainly have prevailed.
Then he understood.
Nanhua Old Immortal surely believed he would never lose.
Who would have thought that, after winning over strong figures like the Three Emperors and Five Sovereigns, he would lose to a junior like Ding Ling!
He died unwillingly.
It’s understandable!
So...
Mindset is crucial.
No matter when, never let oneself become too arrogant!
Ding Ling thus warned himself.
In the subsequent period.
Ding Ling uncovered many valuable secrets from the Furnace Spirit’s words.
Later on.
Under the guidance of the Furnace Spirit, he imprinted his thoughts on the core of the World Furnace, and hence, this World Furnace became Ding Ling’s Magical Treasure.
Once the World Furnace became his Magical Treasure, Ding Ling gained a deeper understanding of it.
He realized that the World Furnace even possesses the function of stabilizing worlds and establishing order across ten realms.
With the World Furnace here.
It can stabilize a world on the brink of shattering; the World Furnace, like the beam of a house, makes the world more stable.
"Worthy of being the World Furnace."
Ding Ling held the furnace, moving with intention, and with the Puppet Soldiers as the focal point, the rules of this region began to change.
Soul Qi grew increasingly dense.
Mountains rose abruptly from the ground.
Palaces began to coalesce in Ding Ling’s mind constantly.
In mere moments.
This region underwent significant transformations.

This region underwent significant transformations.

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - 794: Rule Enlightenment
paragraphs: "This is finally starting to look like the Netherworld."Ding Ling, following his memory of the Netherworld, conjured the Yellow Springs Path, Wangchuan River, Bridge of Helplessness, Wangxiang Platform, Three Lives Stone, and King Yama Hall."Besides these, there should also be the Six Paths of Reincarnation."Ding Ling communicated with the Celestial Heart Mark of the Netherworld.It is known that in the ancient era, the Netherworld had the Six Paths of Reincarnation.It still does now.But the current Six Paths of Reincarnation have shattered, and the Netherworld is striving to repair it.To restore it to its normal state, Ding Ling must use the power of the Immortal Realm and the human world to accelerate the repair.Ding Ling used the Power of Rule to communicate with the Six Paths of Reincarnation, speeding up its repair.At the same time, he tossed the World Furnace inside to stabilize it.In this way, the Six Paths of Reincarnation, which were teetering and hidden from the world, gradually began to take shape."The World Furnace can stabilize worlds and can indeed stabilize the Six Paths of Reincarnation."Ding Ling nodded secretly, the Power of Rule interconnecting.The Six Paths of Reincarnation were placed deep within King Yama Hall.Besides this.Ding Ling also used the Power of Rule to construct the Eighteen-Layered Hell Tower."The Power of Rule in the Netherworld is indeed useful."Ding Ling was moved:"The feeling of controlling everything in the world is truly intoxicating. Unfortunately, this is just a capability granted by the Celestial Heart Mark, and once I leave this lower realm, I will revert to my original state."Just like when Ding Ling was in the Three Kingdoms World, supported by Celestial Might.He went to other worlds.Without Celestial Might, Ding Ling immediately reverted to his normal combat power state.It is the same now.He does not have the ability to change the world and reshape heaven and earth.All of this is granted by the Celestial Heart Mark."Possessing Celestial Heart Marks from three worlds. Indeed extraordinary."Ding Ling took a step forward and entered King Yama Hall, extending his hand to point at a puppet soldier, which immediately transformed into a King Yama clad in a yellow robe and wearing an emperor’s crown."From this day, you are King Qin Guang of the first hall."With a wave of Ding Ling’s hand, King Qin Guang, standing five meters tall, with a build as large as a mountain, handsome features, and a refined temperament, immediately flew onto the Emperor’s Seat:"You are in charge of the life and death registers of the human world, guiding rebirth, and determining auspicious and inauspicious events in the Netherworld!"Bang! As Ding Ling finished speaking.The Heavenly Dao of the Netherworld immediately responded, and a thunderous sound echoed out of nowhere, followed by a slightly intoxicated yellow light appearing in the void.This yellow light split into two in mid-air, with twenty percent falling onto Ding Ling’s head and eighty percent onto King Qin Guang’s head.With the assistance of this eighty percent yellow light, King Qin Guang’s form transformed again, growing by another meter, becoming six meters tall, his form immensely imposing and boundless.Not only did his presence become more profound, but even his eyes became extremely lively and spirited, as if he was infused with a kind of memory.This caused his aura, spirit, memory, etc., to have greatly enhanced and transformed.Whew! King Qin Guang exhaled a breath, and immediately a mirror platform, a zhang high, appeared beside him. The mirror platform was large, with ten surrounding sides, hanging eastwards, and inscribed with the seven characters: ’In front of the Mirror of Evil, there are no good people!’And it was unmistakably the Mirror of Evil! Ding Ling was taken aback and, after carefully sensing and exploring, suddenly understood:"It turns out that the yellow light just now was the Light of Merit. The merit of the Heavenly Dao in the lower realm isn’t much, and the Netherworld granted it entirely because its rules were already chaotic and corrupted.But my reconstruction offers the hope of recovery for the Netherworld! Hence, the Heavenly Dao proactively granted the Light of Merit."Previously, I rescued an entire world but wasn’t rewarded, yet now I am..."Ding Ling was speechless, unable to comprehend the merit-granting rules of the lower realm.However, after thinking it over carefully.Perhaps, with the collapse of the Six Realms, merit might automatically return to the Upper Realm? And at this moment, by reconstructing the rules.This might pull the merit from the Upper Realm back here passively? And then it was immediately bestowed by the Heavenly Dao? How things really are.It’s hard to determine.After all, the concept of merit is extraordinarily mysterious, and Ding Ling placed this merit into the Sword Spirit’s shell for future necessity.He didn’t use the merit to enhance his cultivation power.Only because he sensed that using merit to break someone’s limits or help someone without potential to improve serves remarkably.For those with potential, blindly using merit to enhance cultivation might actually diminish future potential to ascend the大道.Naturally, Ding Ling was unwilling, so he didn’t choose to increase his power immediately.But the potential of the puppet soldiers was essentially used up, and choosing to instinctively enhance their own cultivation is only natural.Regarding the birth of the Mirror of Evil?"This seems somehow related to the Upper Realm too?"Ding Ling was bewildered.But he didn’t think further on it.With his current limited cultivation, pondering about certain things is futile.It’s more practical to focus on improving oneself! Once again, he pointed at a puppet soldier with a bent finger.This soldier also uncontrollably flew to the Emperor’s Seat of the second hall."From now on, you are King of Chujiang!"With the movement of Ding Ling’s rule.King of Chujiang instantly transformed into a handsome emperor clad in a yellow robe and wearing an emperor’s crown."You openly and honorably, shall govern the Living Earth Hell!"With the sound falling.Bang! Another thunderous sound echoed from the Celestial Extreme.A yellow light descended.It split into two.Eighty percent fell onto King of Chujiang’s head and twenty percent onto Ding Ling’s head.Ding Ling routinely stored this merit into the Sword Spirit’s body, while King of Chujiang, with this fortune, transformed into a towering six-meter high form, with significant changes in aura, spirit, and more.In terms of strength, he was no less powerful than King Qin Guang!"It’s indeed useful."Ding Ling felt joy.Casually, he pointed at other puppet soldiers.He respectively selected King Song of the third hall, Wuguan King of the fourth hall, King Yama of the fifth hall, King Biancheng of the sixth hall, King of Mount Tai of the seventh hall, King of the City of the eighth hall, King of Equality of the ninth hall, and King of Reincarnation of the tenth hall.A total of ten Kings Yama were selected.They settled upon the ten great halls, managing all parts of the Netherworld.Each of them not weak like a Martial Arts Golden Core strongman.But their subsequent power is all elevated by merit, with their limits just stopping here, unless in the future they receive immense fortuitous encounters, otherwise, they can never enhance their cultivation power purely through self-training."Thank you, Master, for granting us the supreme fortune!"The ten Kings Yama were full of excitement and gratitude, kneeling in thanks."You may rise."Ding Ling’s voice was as warm as the breeze of spring entering the deep heart of the ten Kings Yama:"In the future, diligently perform your duties and ensure that this Netherworld doesn’t fall into chaos."We vow to strictly follow Master’s orders! Diligently, conscientiously, and keeping true to our original intentions!"Mm."Ding Ling casually pointed at twenty puppet soldiers, transforming them into Granny Meng, Judge, Black and White Impermanence, Ox Head, and Horse Face, etc.Ding Ling left the remaining dozens of puppet soldiers to the Kings Yama.This Netherworld is vast.Without assistance, it’s hard to achieve success.These dozens of puppet soldiers, born and living in harmony, are most suitable for cooperative battles.Presumably, with Kings Yama, Ox Head, Horse Face, etc., successively taking their positions.As Ding Ling was just about to turn around and leave, he sensed a presence on the Yellow Springs Path.

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - 795: Great Tang Li Yuan
paragraphs: This person doesn’t have the aura of the Three Kingdoms World.
Ding Ling holds the Celestial Heart Mark of the Human Realm, Immortal Realm, and Underworld of the Three Kingdoms World.
His mastery and understanding of the Three Kingdoms World have reached an unprecedented level!
Thus, with just one glance, he’s certain this person is definitely from another world.
"Undead from other worlds?"
Curious, Ding Ling steps forward, and in the next instant, he appears hundreds of miles away on the Yellow Springs Path, standing in front of this person.
"Hmm?!"
The person is startled, instinctively stepping back, scrutinizing Ding Ling:
"Who, who are you?! How did you suddenly appear in front of me?!"
Ding Ling doesn’t answer, simply raising an eyebrow, asking:
"What’s your name?"
This person exudes an extraordinary aura, looking at people with an evaluative gaze like someone of high rank examining a subordinate, clearly not an ordinary person.
Yet Ding Ling has killed countless demons.
Why would he care about an ordinary undead?
Thus, when he asks questions, his expression remains emotionless.
The person becomes even more bewildered and instinctively says:
"I am Li Yuan, the founding emperor of the Great Tang! Where is this place? Is it the Yin Dynasty Underworld?!"
"Li Yuan?"
Ding Ling feels ripples in his heart:
"Great Tang?!"
In that moment.
Ding Ling suddenly realizes he might have overlooked something.
That is, this Underworld, Immortal Realm, might not only be connected to one Historical Plane.
They should be linked to the historical planes of Late Qin, Late Sui, and Three Kingdoms.
Meaning...
People from these historical planes, if they become gods or immortals, they would either actively or passively enter the Immortal Realm, Underworld?
If this is true.
Wouldn’t the Immortal Realm be filled with several Three Emperors and Five Sovereigns?!
Unless the Immortal Realm, Underworld, of the other two historical planes is shattered, which led Ding Ling during reconstruction to inadvertently connect them.
"If this is true? Could I travel to other historical planes?"
Ding Ling connects to the Celestial Heart Mark, exploring carefully for a while, disappointed:
"I cannot travel to the other two historical planes. However, the undead from the other historical planes, after dying, will actively enter this Underworld!"
As for the specific reasons.
Ding Ling still cannot know.
He can only deduce based on existing information and evidence.
He guesses it might be when virtue declines, unintentionally opening several planes.
After all, virtue is a mysterious thing and might inadvertently open certain unseen tunnels, which isn’t strange.
"Forget it."
Ding Ling doesn’t wish to probe further, so he steps forward, disappearing before Li Yuan.
Whether Li Yuan would reincarnate or suffer in the Eighteen Layers of Hell, there are Judges, King Yama, and others to judge; he doesn’t need to manage it.
What’s foreseeable, though.
With the reconstruction of the Underworld, the decline of virtue, and Heavenly Dao acknowledging the existence of King Yama, Judges, etc.
More and more undead will be passively led onto the Yellow Springs Path.
Swoosh!
Ding Ling steps into the sky, looking over the entire Underworld, seeing clearly.
The Yellow Turban Legion of the Northern Realm also starts to roar towards the center of the Underworld, as if some unseen rule is driving them forward.
This is the rule set by Ding Ling: undead must step onto the Yellow Springs Path! Otherwise, over time, they would be reduced to ashes.
Undead who don’t want to die can only go to the Yellow Springs Path!
"Yellow Springs Path, Wangchuan River..."
This method.
It’s practically comparable to the Creator!
"The Celestial Heart Mark is truly extraordinary."
Ding Ling sighs.
He steps out once more, entering the Human Realm.
He plans to handle affairs in the Human Realm before going to the Immortal Realm to construct its rules.
And at the moment Ding Ling disappears.
Li Yuan is dumbfounded:
"Just now, just now, wasn’t the person I met the King Yama of the Underworld?!"
His lips tremble slightly, with some fear, panic, doubt:
"But is King Yama so young? Does he not look like it?"
Not until he crosses the Yellow Springs Path, the Bridge of Helplessness, and meets King Qin Guang, does he realize who the true King Yama is!
Who was the young person earlier?
After being judged by King Qin Guang, he finally feels relieved.
Because he, as the founding emperor, still has some virtue that offsets his sins, he still has the possibility of reincarnating.
So, after putting down the burden in his heart, he respectfully bows thrice towards King Qin Guang before saying:
"Lord Yama. Before crossing the Bridge of Helplessness, I encountered an extremely strange young man on the Yellow Springs Path."
He roughly describes Ding Ling’s appearance and continues:
"Why can he roam freely in the Underworld without being judged?"
"Impudent!"
King Qin Guang slams the table, angrily rebuking:
"How dare you, a mere ordinary undead, wish for my master to be judged? You have such boldness! Do you wish to be suppressed into the Eighteen Layers of Hell, never to reincarnate?!"
"What?!"
Li Yuan is so startled that his scalp goes numb, hair stands on end, face full of disbelief, but quickly, he comes to his senses, falls to his knees with a thud, and keeps bowing to King Qin Guang:
"Forgive me, Lord Yama, forgive me, Lord Yama. Li Yuan spoke unthinkingly, please don’t take it to heart!"
Li Yuan, being an emperor.
Had naturally read some storybooks.
Even had his fortune told.
Knowing there’s an Underworld, he naturally develops a reverence for Lord Yama.
Upon actually seeing King Yama.
Seeing King Yama’s towering six-meter figure.
Li Yuan, merely standing in front of King Yama, feels an overwhelming pressure and suffocation, asking questions is his limit.
Truly rebuking or scolding King Yama, he simply can’t achieve.
Let alone King Yama saying he would be punished in Hell.

Thinking of the book’s descriptions of the Eighteen Layers of Hell, Li Yuan can’t help but feel fear, tremble, and shake, unable to stand steadily, instinctively kneeling; this despite being emperor, if it were an ordinary person, they couldn’t even look directly at Yama, let alone just now kneeling, let alone asking questions!
This is King Qin Guang’s intimidating presence on ordinary undead!
As King Yama of the Underworld, he is already a deity acknowledged by Heavenly Dao! As long as the Underworld exists, so does he!

Originally formed from the earth of Underworld, he is extremely compatible with it, having received various blessings, now King Qin Guang’s pressure on undead is vast, like the sky against ants, the ocean against a boat, it’s overwhelming.
"If there’s a next time, I’ll ensure you never reincarnate."
King Qin Guang glared at Li Yuan, making him dizzy, almost scared limp on the ground.
He couldn’t imagine he met the master of King Yama on the Yellow Springs Path?!
That young man was actually the master of King Yama?!
So was he the Heavenly Dao of the Underworld? Earth Mother? Or the Venerable of the Three Realms and Six Paths?

Li Yuan tried guessing based on his understanding of myths, but still could not truly determine Ding Ling’s true identity. Pulled by Ox Head and Horse Face, he cautiously headed to the next destination.

chapters.title: Chapter 807 - 796: Dragon Head Mountain
paragraphs: Until the members of the Yellow Turban Legion began to step onto the Yellow Springs Path.
Li Yuan inadvertently chatted with a leader of the Yellow Turban Army, and that’s when he speculated Ding Ling’s true identity, growing increasingly shocked and terrified:
"How is this possible?!"
"Ding Ling is merely a mortal! How can he command divine spirits?!"
Moreover, the divine spirit he’s commanding is the King Yama of the Yin Dynasty Underworld!
King Yama!
This is the King of the Underworld! An unparalleled existence worshipped and revered by countless undead!
This kind of divine being actually submitted to a human!
Recognized a mere mortal as the master?!
Just thinking about it made Li Yuan’s liver tremble. He even doubted for a moment if his speculation was wrong.

But there were quite a few leaders in the Yellow Turban Army, and these people had all witnessed Ding Ling’s powerful divine might and seen Ding Ling’s appearance. After multiple verifications, Li Yuan couldn’t help but be alarmed:
"Could it really be Ding Ling?! That mortal who dominated the Upper Realm with unrivaled prowess?!"
Even in the Great Tang World,
Li Yuan had heard plenty about Ding Ling from the mouths of the aliens.
He was once impressed and envious.
He also wanted to ascend to the Upper Realm.

Unfortunately, his talent was limited, and being older in age, he truly couldn’t advance to the level of a Super-Elite Fierce General. In the end, due to hasty pursuits, he damaged his organs and unfortunately died early.
"I heard Ding Ling killed my son Yuan Ba?"
Li Yuan suddenly remembered something:
"Could this Ding Ling be the same Ding Ling?!"
He didn’t dare to confirm.
Nor did he dare consult King Yama for verification.
An official of higher rank crushes people to death.
He’s no longer the Supreme Emperor of the Great Tang, nor a figure whose words carry weight.
He’s just the most ordinary, low-ranking undead in the Underworld.
Not to mention King Yama could easily crush him, even the Judges could easily cut off his soul and slash his spirit!
In this situation.
How could he dare to verify whether Li Yuanba was killed by Ding Ling?!
"Ashes to ashes, dust to dust. Soon, I’ll reincarnate. Then, if fate permits, Yuanba might even become my elder brother?"
This is an uncertain matter.
After all, Li Yuanba has been dead for a long time.
Thinking of this.
Li Yuan felt relieved.
The first time he heard about Li Yuanba being killed by Ding Ling, he was also enraged and heartbroken!
But as time passed, now that he was really dead and became a ghost, Li Yuan’s feelings were completely different from when he was alive.

Especially when being oppressed and intimidated by King Qin Guang’s authority, kneeling on the ground like a dog, ’wagging his tail and begging for mercy,’ his mindset was even more vastly different from when he was alive.
In life, Li Yuan absolutely could never have imagined he would have such a day!
But he has already died.
And given the opportunity to reincarnate, asking him to give it up just like that, he couldn’t do it! He didn’t want his soul to be scattered.
"I’ve heard from the alien that the Underworld has Meng Po Soup. If I could reincarnate without drinking this soup, how wonderful it would be."
Within the Netherworld.
Following drastic changes in the rules.
The successive arrivals of Granny Meng, the Judges, and others.
The entire Netherworld started to operate independently.
The repair speed of the Netherworld was many times faster than before.
Especially as ghost souls continuously poured into the Netherworld, and the Six Paths of Reincarnation began to operate, the repair speed of the Netherworld increased several times again.
Familiar names appeared on the Book of Life and Death.
From this point on.
The three major historical planes were thoroughly connected.
And regarding all of this.
Ding Ling currently knew nothing.
Once he appeared in the human realm, he linked with the Celestial Heart Mark, and in an instant, he found the hiding Zuo Ci.
"So he’s hiding in a Grotto Heaven World within the Ten Thousand Great Mountains. No wonder I couldn’t find him."
Ding Ling was amazed:

"Zuo Ci received teachings from the Nanhua Old Immortal and didn’t die. Yet Nanhua Old Immortal didn’t come out to deal with him. It seems this guy is a pawn of the Nanhua Old Immortal. But now that the Nanhua Old Immortal is dead, this pawn will also become a wasted piece."
Ding Ling didn’t know the purpose or significance behind the Nanhua Old Immortal’s move.
He had no interest in exploring it.
That’s just how he was.
If he couldn’t figure it out, he wouldn’t think about it. Doing what needs to be done now, improving himself, that was the true kingly way!
He believed:
A person can have grand ambitions!
But must not aim too high and miss the mark!
Stepping steadily, doing each step well, gradually getting closer to the goal, that’s right.
He had always acted this way.
Although he was still far from the goal of eternal life and invincibility across the heavens, he was not discouraged and would step by step reach the peak.
With cheats in hand.
If he still couldn’t reach the peak, that would be his own fault!
Ding Ling didn’t remind himself just once that he must hold steady, as long as he holds steady, everything in the future is possible.
Swoosh!
Ding Ling stepped out one step and covered tens of thousands of miles.
After mastering the Celestial Heart Mark.
Ding Ling could establish various rules, and now, he was the embodiment of the Lower Realm’s rules, wherever he was, was the rule, was the Celestial, Earthly, and Mankind Dao!
If he wanted to take one step tens of thousands of miles, he could do it.
This is the powerful aspect of the Celestial Heart Mark.
Hence, the degree of generosity the Immortal Realm, the Netherworld, and the Human Realm Heavenly and Earthly Dao had towards him was evident!
"This is it."
Ding Ling surveyed with his gaze.
A vast expanse, peaks gathered like a crowd!
At the end of this great lake, among the mountains, there was a Grotto Heaven portal hanging ten feet in the air.
This portal was not visible to the naked eye.
It could only be faintly seen when the first light of dawn cast the mountain’s reflection on the lake surface.
And to see it, one must be a master surpassing a Super-Elite Fierce General.
Unless better in cultivation, they couldn’t see this portal.
But even if they saw it, entering it also required proficiency in the Nine Palaces Bagua Array and Exotic Concealment Array. Otherwise, they couldn’t step into this portal.
But these weren’t problems for Ding Ling.
He was a constructor of the rules; at his thought, the portal opened automatically, and a ladder extended from the door, reaching his feet.
Stepping on the Celestial Ladder, Ding Ling instantly reached the entrance, looking inside.
Only an enormous tomb-like Dragon Head Mountain was settled inside!
"This is the Dragon Vein source of the human realm."
At a glance.
Ding Ling understood:

"I was wondering why Zuo Ci was hiding. Turns out he was refining the Dragon Source. Once he refines this Dragon Source, he will become the master of the Earthly and Mankind Dao! From then on, the development of the human realm will be at his whim. He can also become ageless and immortal, totally binding with the Earthly and Mankind Dao."
To kill him, one must destroy the Earthly and Mankind Dao!
What a deep calculation.
Ding Ling was amazed.
Even as an enemy.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but admire Zuo Ci’s methods.
And judging by the illusory state of Dragon Head Mountain,
it was evident that in seven or eight years.
Zuo Ci might just succeed!
By that time.
Zuo Ci being ageless and immortal, incarnating thousands of times in the human world would be absolutely no problem.
"Too bad. You met me."
Ding Ling pointed a finger toward Dragon Head Mountain.
The next moment.
From within the belly of Dragon Head Mountain, a person was forcibly squeezed out.

chapters.title: Chapter 808 - 797: Heavenly Book of Escape Armor Full Level
paragraphs: This man has crane-white hair and a youthful face, with a celestial air, could he not be Zuo Ci the Zuo Daoist?!
He is clearly going all out, in seclusion refining the Dragon Source.
Suddenly expelled from Dragon Head Mountain, a trace of shock and confusion lingered on his face.
Until he saw Ding Ling.
He then seemed to realize:
"Is it you, Ding, Ding Ling?!"
"Zuo Ci, demon dao."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Long time no see."
"It was, it was you behind all this!"

Zuo Ci, shocked and horrified, instinctively turned to flee, but just as he rose, he felt the weight of ten thousand pounds pressing down on him, making it impossible to stand. More shaken and terrified, his lips trembled:
"How, how, how did you do it? And how did you find me?!"
His crow incarnation had only been killed not long ago!
Ding Ling has managed to find this place!
And even silently expelled him from the heart of Dragon Head Mountain!
How is this possible?!
For the sake of eluding Ding Ling’s pursuit, he had laid out various arrays of concealing Heaven and Earth all across the Grotto Heaven World at Dragon Head Mountain!
He even utilized the divine concealment feature of the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor, bestowing the entire Grotto Heaven World with divine concealment characteristics!
Even if gods came.
Zuo Ci was confident they would absolutely never find this Grotto Heaven World!
And Ding Ling?!
This, this...
Just the thought.
Zuo Ci couldn’t help but feel his scalp tingle and his pupils dilate.
"Is this the Primordial Spirit Body?"
Ding Ling glanced at Zuo Ci, remarked in wonder:

"To have a mere mortal physique, yet give birth to a Primordial Spirit Body. It shows your fortune and transformation are indeed extraordinary. No wonder you are unwilling to leave this mortal world for the upper realm."
Zuo Ci’s going to the upper realm was merely an incarnation.
Ding Ling had previously speculated, and now he was more certain.
Zuo Ci was speechless.
As someone of his seniority! Many masters and famed generals upon seeing him would show him respect!
Yet Ding Ling was actually looking down on him, critiquing him!
Such a feeling was strange, like an adult in the past seeing a child coldly criticizing God; like seeing an ant toppling a great tree.
That sense of disorientation and discrepancy threw Zuo Ci into a stupor.

But he quickly came to, realizing Ding Ling was not someone he could easily manipulate anymore. Five years ago, Ding Ling was already a Super-Elite Fierce General who could borrow Celestial Might, commonly known as a Celestial Human Realm powerhouse!
At that time, Ding Ling could defeat one of his strongest incarnations!
Not someone he could manipulate easily, but even so, Zuo Ci did not consider Ding Ling a threat, as long as he could completely refine Dragon Head Mountain with his Primordial Spirit Body.
He would become the Dragon Source of this world, truly attaining the ’Dao’ of immortality!
And his Primordial Spirit Body’s refining of Dragon Head Mountain could not be interrupted, hence he didn’t choose to kill Ding Ling.
But unexpectedly, in just over five years, Ding Ling had become a powerful and incredible character!
Five years ago, his Primordial Spirit Body could instantly kill Ding Ling!
Five years later.
He was being looked down upon and manipulated by Ding Ling, unable to move at all, completely involuntary!
Just over five years!!
His progress was rapid, yet Ding Ling’s rate of improvement was absurdly fast!
Practically unbelievable! Inexplicable!
"How did you become so strong?!"
Zuo Ci couldn’t help but ask.
Without comparison, there is no harm. Zuo Ci prided himself as a peerless genius, unmatched in the world! Yet Ding Ling surpassed him with crushing superiority.
How could he remain calm?!
"What do you know about your master Nanhua Old Immortal’s background?"
Ding Ling did not respond to Zuo Ci, only asked.

"I have not had deep contact with Nanhua Old Immortal. But in the dark, there seems to be a force pointing me, guiding me, making me stronger. I was able to find Dragon Head Mountain, seemingly guided by this force."
Zuo Ci instinctively replied with two sentences, upon finishing, he looked at Ding Ling in horror:
"Why, why, why did I suddenly lose control?!"
He lost control.
Naturally it was due to Ding Ling’s Celestial Heart Mark’s constraints!
Within Ding Ling’s Rule Realm, when Ding Ling requests Zuo Ci to speak truthfully, he must speak truthfully!
It is just this defying of heaven!

Of course, even with the aid of rules, Ding Ling still could not perfectly strip all memory information flows from Zuo Ci, or else upon seeing Zuo Ci, he would certainly kill Zuo Ci without asking further questions.
Since perfect separation is not possible.
Ding Ling chose to make Zuo Ci voluntarily confess.
"You don’t know the origin of Nanhua Old Immortal?"
"Don’t know."
"It seems you truly are a pawn."
Ding Ling sighed.
Zuo Ci’s finding of Dragon Head Mountain and becoming the Primordial Spirit Body, without doubt, was guided by Nanhua Old Immortal from behind the scenes.

The Furnace Spirit of the World Furnace had once said: As long as one practices Nanhua Old Immortal’s magic and skills, their subconscious will be controlled by Nanhua Old Immortal. They will unknowingly act according to Nanhua Old Immortal’s instructions.
Though not a puppet.
But equal to a puppet.
Such a method is extremely rare.
Ding Ling had not seen it before.
And obviously, Zhang Jiao and Zuo Ci were both affected.
As for whether Yhiuu Ji was affected, Ding Ling did not know.
He plans to find time to check on Yhiuu Ji, and if Yhiuu Ji is affected, he will have Yhiuu Ji abolish the martial arts of the Taiping Qingling Dao and switch to other techniques.
As for why Ding Ling himself reached Full Level with Taiping Sutra and Taiping Qingling Dao yet wasn’t affected?
He reckons it must be because he hasn’t had close contact with Nanhua Old Immortal’s transmission of magic.

When Nanhua Old Immortal transmitted magic to Zuo Ci and others, he must have tampered with it, just that Zuo Ci and others at that time had too low cultivation to detect it. And Ding Ling, not being a recipient of Nanhua Old Immortal’s transmission, naturally remains unscathed.
"Pawn?!"
In Zuo Ci’s stunned moment, Ding Ling slapped towards him:
"You may die now."
"No, please, spare..."
The plea for mercy had yet to be uttered.
A flip of the palm overturned the earth, bang! It struck Zuo Ci’s head, shattering it, and his body cracked open like a vessel into countless fragments amidst the snapping sounds.
On his face lingering were fear, confusion, resentment, curse, and various negative emotions.
Ding Ling disregarded.
Instead, the Rule Realm spread over.
Soon, lengthy streams of information were stripped away.
Ding Ling’s Sword Realm could already strip others’ memories.
Though only about two to three percent could be stripped.
But that was impressive.
And as the rules came upon.
Neither the extent reached seven to eight percent, nor the speed was accelerated countless times.
In just an instant.
Various information fell under Ding Ling’s control.
[Astrology Full Level]
[Nine Golden Liquid Gold Full Level]
[Heavenly Book of Escape Armor Full Level]
[Taiqing Pill Scripture Full Level]
Hundreds of techniques and skills surged into Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness.
Ding Ling in an instant glanced over all the content and knowledge points of these skills and techniques.
Then, in another instant, these techniques and skills were all at Full Level.
The speed, incomparable to reading books.
Reading books requires page turning.
But this requires merely a thought to thoroughly review all information streams!
"So this is the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor?"
Ding Ling leapt into the void, then transformed into a bird.

chapters.title: Chapter 809 - 798: Constructing the Celestial Court
paragraphs: Ding Ling stood on the ground and transformed into a hunchbacked seventy-year-old man.
Then he rolled into the void and transformed into a fierce tiger with wings on its back.
"Truly extraordinary."
Ding Ling praised:

"But this Transformation Skill seems to only allow eight transformations. If I forcibly cultivate the ninth, the Transformation Talisman formed by this skill might collapse, rendering the Transformation Skill unusable."
After Ding Ling’s Transformation Skill reached Full Level.
A delicate talisman naturally condensed in his Dantian.
As long as he activates this talisman.
He can transform into other people or things.
However, he can only transform into eight types of people or things.
Therefore, he must choose to set the transformation as eight types, and once chosen, they can’t be changed.
"Zuo Ci can also transform, but he must rely on the body of people or things to transform. Clearly, his Transformation Skill hasn’t reached Full Level."
Ding Ling didn’t see Nanhua Old Immortal transform.
Most likely, Nanhua Old Immortal didn’t have time to use his real skills before being killed by Ding Ling!
After all, Nanhua Old Immortal’s strongest Divine Techniques and Creation were probably his Inner Heaven and Earth.
Even Inner Heaven and Earth couldn’t trap Ding Ling.
It’s naturally understandable that Nanhua Old Immortal would run out of tricks.
"Apart from Transformation Skill, the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor also excels in the power of Escape Skill and the unpredictability of Array."
The Heavenly Book of Escape Armor records various High-level Arrays.
Among them are the Immortal Trapping Array, Heaven-Filling Array, and other advanced arrays.
Ding Ling reached Full Level in an instant.
With the aid of these arrays, Ding Ling will surely advance smoothly in the future.
Moreover, the ’Illusionary Escape Skill’ in the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor skillfully combines Illusion Skill with Mind Confusion Skill.
This Escape Skill, when displayed, seems dream-like, illusion-like, smokey, and misty, with extremely fast speed, like lightning.
Even ordinary people who see it will think it’s an illusion.
"Also, the Breathing Technique is top-notch. But how did Zuo Ci’s Spirit transform into Primordial Spirit Body?"
Ding Ling, by searching through Zuo Ci’s memory stream, quickly realized:
"It was under the guidance of mysterious powers that he found a pure Primordial Spirit Body without memory or Divine Techniques, which Zuo Ci replaced himself with!"
Is that possible?
Ding Ling didn’t possess such a Secret Technique to replace others’ Primordial Spirit Body.
Clearly.
This is another trick of Nanhua Old Immortal.

"Great Sun Buddha and Demon King Poxun are merely thoughts of Upper Realm big shots, hence they didn’t gain any top-notch Divine Techniques or Cultivation Techniques. But Nanhua Old Immortal is clearly different, possessing superior Divine Techniques, Cultivation Techniques, and significant Creation on him.
Thus, it can be inferred that the planner behind Nanhua Old Immortal had high hopes for Nanhua Old Immortal. Now that I’ve killed him, I’ve certainly offended this person.
If we meet in the future, he will surely be my enemy."
Ding Ling felt tense.
And somewhat helpless.
These big shots have such long-reaching hands.
They even reach into this lowest layer of the Historical Plane.
Moreover, through this encounter.
Ding Ling has become certain of one thing.
That is, the Historical Plane, Martial World, Xianxia World...
Going in sequence.
They grow stronger.
But in reality, it’s not the case.
In the Ancient Era, the Historical Plane was definitely very strong, possibly stronger than many Xianxia Worlds.
"As a foundational place, the Historical Plane indeed has its unique, mysterious aspects."
"If Nanhua Old Immortal hadn’t meddled, the Historical Plane’s heritage wouldn’t have been severed, it wouldn’t have fallen into its current state."
Luckily, with the resurgence of the Netherworld and Immortal Realm.
The Human Realm also started to grow stronger.
Though lacking the Demon Realm and other three Great Realms.
Unintentionally connected to other Historical Plane’s Netherworlds, surely in the future, it will grow very strong.
Then the Netherworld, Immortal Realm, and Human Realm now form a triangular relationship.
If one grows strong, it will lead the other two to grow stronger slowly.
These three, rise and fall together!

"Not only that, Zuo Ci died, and the Dragon Source he refined returned to Dragon Head Mountain! Dragon Head Mountain has become refined and real again, it’s predictable that the Human Realm will revive fully with the resurgence of Dragon Head Mountain, elevating the realm to an era boiling with Spiritual Qi and Primordial Qi. The upper limits of Human Realm will undoubtedly rise because of this."
Ding Ling was moved:
"It seems players staying in the Historical Plane have awaited dawn and light of hope!"
It’s just like the revival of Spiritual Qi!
Although previously the Historical Plane’s Spiritual Vitality surpassed the real world.
Compared to the Martial Hero Plane, especially the Wind and Cloud Plane, it was far inferior.
But with the revival of Spiritual Qi.
The Historical Plane’s Spiritual Vitality might surpass the Wind and Cloud Plane immensely!
In such an environmental heaven and earth for cultivation.
Martial Artists will naturally advance much faster.
Predictably.
In the future, the Historical Plane will see Super-Elite Fierce Generals everywhere, definitely becoming reality!
Ding Ling took a step out of the Grotto Heaven World.
This Grotto Heaven World is crucial to the rise and fall of the Human Realm.
Ding Ling, using his Power of Rule, completely concealed it deep in the void, so unless someone’s cultivation and creation compare to the heavens, it is impossible to find Dragon Head Mountain.
"Time to go to the Immortal Realm."
Ding Ling took a step forward and reached the Immortal Realm.
With the Celestial Heart Mark he possessed.
He can travel across the three Great Realms instantly.
This feeling truly makes him feel comfortable and exhilarated!
He knows.
This is the feeling of controlling everything.
And this isn’t from his own capability, it’s thanks to the Celestial Heart Mark; he must not indulge in this feeling.
Otherwise.
If someone far stronger than Nanhua Old Immortal appears in the future, how will he deal with them?
Plan ahead.
Constantly strengthening oneself is the true path.
This Celestial Heart Mark is merely a foreign object, after all.
Ding Ling’s mind was clear; taking a step forward, he had already reached the position above the Celestial River.
Overlooking the entire Immortal Realm.
Mountains and green waters nestled together,
majestic Celestial River like a waterfall pouring down.
The scenery is beautiful, the realm vast and boundless.
But unfortunately, besides some flowers and trees, there are no creatures.
Ding Ling walked along the Celestial River, and under the rule of thought, mountains rose from the Earth Realm, falling above the sea of clouds, beside the Celestial River.
Ding Ling began to construct a Celestial Court here.
Thus.
He started to use the powers from the Celestial Heart Mark, under the action of extraordinary Power of Rule.
Mountains continually rose, or transformed into floating mountains above the sea of clouds, or were leveled, becoming foundations for building the Celestial Court.
In Ding Ling’s construction.
One palace after another condensed;
Cloud Palace, Five Lights Palace, Sun Palace, Huale Palace...
Every palace shone brightly, like radiant stars in the sky;
Ding Ling walked through them.
Until reaching the core of the Celestial Court, the Lingxiao Palace was also constructed.
"This is complete now."

Ding Ling looked at the Emperor’s Seat in the Lingxiao Palace, nodded with satisfaction, turned around, stepped out of the palace, pointed forward, and a South Celestial Sect appeared out of thin air, falling beside the Celestial River, stabilizing the four gate realms.
"Heaven-Filling Array, activate!"
"Nine Palace Miasma Array, activate!"
