chapters.title: Chapter 810 - 799: Immortal Path
paragraphs: "Spirit Gathering Array activate!"
"Profound Celestial Annihilation Array activate!"
Ding Ling continuously formed seal techniques, utilizing the Power of Rule.
He maximized the Full Level Array Skill from the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor.
Grand arrays were embedded in the Ten Directions Realm of the Celestial Court.
The Celestial Court was surrounded tightly.
Apart from the South Celestial Sect, no other realms could be accessed.
The reason for this, besides enhancing safety and increasing Spiritual Qi concentration, was to prevent trespassers from entering the Celestial Court.

"With these arrays assisting, the spiritual vitality of the Celestial Court will become more enriched. This place will be the most suitable for cultivation in all of the Three Realms and Six Paths. Given time, the Wind and Cloud World won’t be able to compare."
Wind and Cloud World’s Heavenly Dao would not generously bestow such ’gifts’ to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling managed to construct the Celestial Court, a feat completely accomplished by harnessing the unfathomable capabilities of the Celestial Heart Mark’s rules!
Otherwise,
relying solely on his own power, he could never have achieved all this.
At least for now, he lacks such capability.
"Originally, I planned to let Diao Chan and the others head to the Upper Realm, but now it seems unnecessary."
Ding Ling took a deep breath.
Hoo!

He exhaled, transforming his breath into a streak of light flying out of the South Celestial Sect, crossing over the Celestial River, landing on the Immortal Realm’s ground, then piercing through the Immortal Realm like a Celestial Ladder, constantly transforming in mid-air, and within moments, becoming a Dragon Ladder thousands upon thousands of miles long.
Once this Dragon Ladder took form, it stretched downward like lightning, taking root alongside the Celestial Ladder in Chang’an.
"Go!"
Ding Ling blew out another breath.
This breath fell into the human world, transforming into a huge stone monument, with two characters engraved:
"Immortal Path."
At this moment.
Pan Feng, Zhao Zilong, and their group were stationed beside the Celestial Ladder.
They witnessed the Dragon Ladder arriving from beyond the sky, landing beside them, then a stone monument suddenly miraculously generating, rooting itself into the earth.
They stared wide-eyed, as if in a dream:
"Immortal Path?!"
"What does it mean?!
Wang Yue, Xiao Qiao, Tong Yuan, and the others were all on the Celestial Ladder, seeing the Immortal Path appear beside them, completely bewildered.
Players were even more astonished:
"How could this Historical Plane suddenly produce an Immortal Path? Quick, log off and see if other planes have it."
After some players logged on and off as quickly as lightning, they reported that other planes did not have this.
Players were even more excited, incredulously:
"The lowest-grade Historical Plane has an Immortal Path?! Unbelievable! Why has this change suddenly occurred? It’s impossible to be without a reason, there must be some explanation."

"Do you think it might be because of Ding Ling? Ever since Ding Ling set foot on the Historical Plane, I’ve noticed the Three Kingdoms World experiencing constant upheavals, with earth-shattering changes. The heavens nearly got destroyed before! While the Late Sui and Late Qin Historical Planes didn’t experience this, what does this imply? It’s self-evident!"
"Ding Ling, this guy, truly deserves to be the number one among us players! If he really created this Immortal Path, I truly have no words to describe him!"

"Right. A momentous hero, unrivaled national talent, peerless prodigy? None of these fully capture his transcendent might! This guy... I hope this Immortal Path wasn’t created by him, otherwise, as fellow players, the gap between us is just too vast, I can’t accept it."
Players were endlessly discussing.
The discussions were loud.
Pan Feng, Wang Yue, Tong Yuan, and even Xiao Qiao were accustomed to this.
Players were ’carefree’, like ’detached spectators’. They lacked sufficient reverence for even Cao Mengde, let alone for Pan Feng and others.
If not for living here, learning martial arts, seeking masters, etc., they might have already ’arrogantly ascended to the heavens’!
Thus, once Pan Feng and others grew accustomed, they were not offended and instead listened intently to their conversations.
Because they all knew that aliens who call themselves players come from other worlds and know about the Upper Realm, even each realm’s happenings.
Therefore, asking aliens with curiosity is bound to yield correct answers.
At this moment, hearing aliens discussing Ding Ling.
Wang Yue, Tong Yuan, and their group exchanged glances, clearly seeing mutual astonishment, joy, shock, and excitement in each other’s eyes:
"If this truly is the Prince’s doing, what kind of unmatched cultivation does the Prince have?"
"Can’t imagine."
"Perhaps after some time, when the Prince returns, we’ll know the truth."
Pan Feng’s group was discussing.
Suddenly, they noticed small characters appearing beside the Immortal Path, and upon closer inspection, they saw written there:
"As long as one’s cultivation reaches the level of a Third-class General, one may step onto the Immortal Path, heading to the Immortal Realm!"
"Cultivation reaching the level of a First-class General may report to the Celestial Court."
There were densely packed instructions outlining specific guidelines.
Pan Feng, Tong Yuan, Xiao Qiao, and the players looked on, some excited, some bewildered, some incredulous.
Players were the most daring.
Immediately, those players without obligations laughed aloud and stepped onto the Dragon Ladder!
They didn’t step onto the Celestial Ladder because their cultivation wasn’t enough.
Moreover, they were reluctant to abandon the breathing techniques, sword and saber techniques, and other skills honed over the years, to head to the Upper Realm.
Thus, they continued enduring in the Historical Plane!
Just hoping one day to endure to the level of a Super-Elite Fierce General, then to ascend to the Upper Realm.
Enduring like this.
Took seven years and more!
However, most of them still only reached levels of Third-class, Second-class General, rarely First-class, not to mention reaching Super-Elite, which was even fewer.
Compared to Ding Ling, who soared like lightning, leaving them in the dust.
Their progress was as slow as a snail!
They became desperate themselves!
The only thing that comforted them was that in the Martial World, players cultivating Inner Power also progressed super slowly, not faster than their cultivation of the Breathing Technique!
Some who abandoned Breathing Technique cultivation, heading to the Upper Realm to learn Inner Power, mostly regretted it because cultivating Inner Power also began at five or ten years!
In this way.
It further emphasized Ding Ling’s defying nature, and formidable prowess.
They repeatedly sighed in admiration, envy, jealousy over Ding Ling’s success, rankings, cultivation, etc.
And now.
Clouds parted to reveal the moon!
In the Three Kingdoms World, a path to the Immortal Realm abruptly appeared, so why hesitate?!
Players meeting the criteria eagerly stepped onto this Immortal Path.
Players with attachments and families reluctantly left their loved ones, encouraging them to cultivate diligently for future family fun on the Immortal Path.
Compared with the Super-Elite Fierce General standard of the Celestial Ladder.
The Immortal Path’s Third-class General standard was much more lenient, even a mediocre talent, with hardworking cultivation for seven or eight years, could attain this standard.
Thus.
Once the news spread from one to ten, then a hundred, it spread wide.

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - 800: Superstar at the Pinnacle
paragraphs: The entire Three Kingdoms World was in uproar.
Countless players surged towards the Dragon Ladder, embarking on the path to the Immortal Realm.
Meanwhile, players of the Late Sui and Late Qin planes were furious upon learning of this:
"Why is it that the same historical plane allows people from the Three Kingdoms Plane to have an Immortal Path and Immortal Realm while we can’t?!"
"Damn it. This stupid game is getting more and more unfair! It’s becoming harder to play!"
"Protest! We want the Immortal Realm and Immortal Path too!"
The emergence of an Immortal Path and Immortal Realm in the historical plane quickly created huge waves in the real world!
After all, the extraordinary capabilities of the game had already deeply penetrated every household and every person in the world now.
Everyone knew that playing the game could strengthen oneself, and no one could resist playing.
Though, dying too much did result in strong side effects.
But, as long as one was cautious not to die too much and treated the game as a second world to live in and strive for, even the real-world self could grow stronger along with it!
This was undoubtedly a very cost-effective deal for anyone.
Especially for some elderly suffering from terminal illnesses, growing stronger in the game world could gradually cure their diseases without medicine.
That’s why, seven years later, nearly every adult played the game!
The young people who reached the age and were impatient to play the game were uncountable, like fish swimming through a wide river.
Originally, the first batch of these young people logged in and chose the Martial World.
But now, suddenly, a new Immortal Realm and Immortal Path appeared in the historical plane, making them all start to watch and ask questions to the veteran players on forums:

"Uncles, aunties, big brothers, and sisters. Little sister here just turned eighteen, and not long ago received a game helmet as a reward from my parents. I originally planned to go to the Wind and Cloud World, but it’s too dangerous. The Inner Power of the Martial Hero Plane is also hard to learn, so I want to ask what’s going on in the Three Kingdoms World now? How is the Spiritual Vitality concentration? Has the difficulty of cultivation reduced? What are the odds of me becoming a Super-Elite Fierce General..."
One question after another was thrown.
A heap of replies followed below.
’Also just came of age. Also want to know the answers to these questions.’
Clearly.
The young people of the new era, under the influence of their parents and various news and newspapers, already have as much understanding of the game as some veteran players.
Of course, they are all still theoretical.
Plus, being full of youthful vigor, each of them initially set their goal at a Super-Elite Fierce General!
In their eyes.
Ding Ling, the legendary Divine Level player!
The god in the heart of all players!
He is their idol, their goal!
Only, they dare not say this aloud, fearing the veteran players’ derision!
Thus, they lowered their goal to Super-Elite, writing it on the forums.
Nevertheless, even with this.

There’s still a bunch of veteran players below who went crazy with sarcastic mockery: ’Today’s new players, young people, truly know no heights, back in the day, we suffered a lot to become Second-class Fierce Generals, and you just joined wanting to be Super-Elite, dreaming?!’
Many veteran players were criticizing.
The new players, full of Blood Qi and boldness like newborn calves unafraid of tigers, certainly wouldn’t tolerate this from the veteran players, each angrily rebuked back.
Saying ’Veteran players are all useless, having cultivated for seven or eight years, still stuck at Third or Second-class level, while Hero Ding Ling can crush a bunch of you with just one finger!
Not striving for progress is one thing, but then to attack newcomers’ confidence and ambition, truly shameless, stupid and despicable!’
The veteran players were all infuriated by these remarks.

Each rolled up their sleeves, angrily retaliated saying: ’Young people arrogant, unaware, saying this when they haven’t experienced hardship, when you actually engage with the game to cultivate, you’ll realize someone like Ding Ling, ordinary players can’t touch or imagine! A bunch of youngsters actually thinking of chasing Ding Ling. Truly don’t know what death is!!’
For a time.
The internet was surge after surge, debates ceaseless.
Search term frequencies for ’Ding Ling’ ’Immortal Path’ ’Immortal Realm’ ’Three Kingdoms’ rocketed up several notches.
News anchors on that night all began reporting on the matter.
Further intensifying the fervor of this matter.
Later.
When everyone learned that Ding Ling orchestrated this, and Ding Ling even became the Celestial Emperor of the Immortal Realm.
All players were astonished, bewildered, couldn’t believe it.
After a moment of silence on the internet.
Even more furious waves surged, rolled, flew!
The heated discussions and reports on Ding Ling directly surged to the top of world trending.
Today.
Worldwide, countless countries’ TV stations, newspapers, magazine journals were reporting this matter.
Ding Ling’s world top-tier reputation!
Once again proven!
So-called international big-name stars, domestic top-tier superstars, in front of Ding Ling, seemed like mere chickens and dogs, completely unable to withstand a single blow!
Advertisers.
Manufacturers.
Directors.
Various related event organizers...
They either waved money bills in their hands or ardently called for Ding Ling to join them, for him to shoot commercials, make movies, etc.
Conditions arbitrary.
Ding Ling’s popularity so high.
Crushing anyone in the world.
Even top-tier world stars comparing to him, are like fireflies compared to the bright moon!
Of course.
These are all things that happened subsequently.
At present.

After blowing two breaths of air, Ding Ling thought for a moment, and blew another breath turning into a dragon boat, this boat landed beneath the Celestial River waterfall, as long as a person reached First-class Fierce General, they could board the dragon boat, ascend against the current, arriving before the South Celestial Sect.
"I fear this Celestial Court might be the weakest version."
Ding Ling gazed at the empty Celestial Court, and sighed thus in his heart.
Yet his initial purpose for building the Celestial Court was to provide Diao Chan and others a stable environment for cultivation.
Clearly.
This Celestial Court is most suitable.
As the Spirit Gathering Array and all grand arrays were activated, the concentration of Spiritual Vitality within the Celestial Court grew higher and higher.
And as the Immortal Realm continuously revived.
This recovery speed of Spiritual Vitality will definitely enhance again.
So how to accelerate the Immortal Realm’s recovery speed?
Ding Ling thought of King Yama and the others in the Netherworld, couldn’t help but step forward, the next moment.
He appeared outside the Prince’s Mansion.
’Error margin’ kept shrinking.
Ding Ling nodded secretly.
As the Netherworld revives and grows stronger, its Celestial Heart Mark strengthens, Ding Ling naturally also rises with everything.
Thus his instant teleportation error margin in the Three Realms shrinking can be understood.
"Your Highness!"
Zhou Cang, Pei Yuanshao saw Ding Ling, eyes brightened, bowed together, loudly stating.
"Mm."
Ding Ling nodded, stepped out, and vanished into thin air before the two generals.
They were unperturbed, instead extremely excitedly saying:
"I saw His Highness again!"

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - 801: Zhen Mi
paragraphs: To Zhou Cang and Pei Yuanshao.
Being able to see someone as high-profile as Ding Ling is a fortunate event.
Even if Ding Ling stays in the Prince’s Mansion,
it is difficult for them to see Ding Ling.
After all, they are just gatekeepers!
Especially for Pei Yuanshao, the times he has met Ding Ling can be counted on one hand.
Every time he sees Ding Ling, he gets more excited than anyone else.
"The Prince has returned this time, is he here to get married?"
"Not exactly."
"Then what is he here for?"
"We are gatekeepers. Just do your job properly. Don’t mind what you’re not supposed to!"
Zhou Cang glared at Pei Yuanshao:
"If the Prince is dissatisfied, he could replace us. Where could you find such a good job?"
"True, true. I won’t ask anymore."
Pei Yuanshao smiled awkwardly.

Ever since they found out that Ding Ling had returned, countless high-ranking officials and generals wanted to send their children to the Prince’s Mansion. Even if they only served as gatekeepers, they were content with it!
Upon learning the inside story, Zhou Cang and Pei Yuanshao became extremely nervous.
For fear of being replaced by Ding Ling and Diao Chan someday.
As a result, they became particularly meticulous and diligent!
They mastered the ’art’ of gatekeeping!
Other households’ gatekeepers were left speechless and ashamed!
With a step, Ding Ling walked into the depths of the Prince’s Mansion and stood before Diao Chan.
Diao Chan seemed to be speaking with someone, seeing Ding Ling, she couldn’t help but pause and then showed a joyful expression. She gave Ding Ling a respectful bow and said:
"My lord, you have finally returned."
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"This time I have returned specifically to take you to a place. Get ready, and then follow me."
"Yes, my lord."
Diao Chan didn’t ask more, responded, and then got up and brought Ding Ling to a side, pointing to a slender, beautiful young woman in the yard, saying:
"She is Cai Wenji’s younger sister, whom I personally brought to the Prince’s Mansion not long ago."
"My lord, the situation is this..."
Diao Chan explained in detail and sincerely hoped Ding Ling would agree to Cai Wenji becoming a member of the mansion. Otherwise, it would be a pity and loss for Cai Wenji to fade away like this.

Although Ding Ling had undergone significant changes in cultivation and mindset compared to seven or eight years ago, he did not reject a sensible and lovely woman like Cai Wenji. Seeing that Diao Chan had arranged everything properly, he said:
"The harem will be managed by you in the future. Make the decision as you see fit.
Diao Chan’s decisive, brave, resilient, gentle, and kind nature made her extremely suitable to be the Master of the Harem.
Ding Ling had already formed an idea about Diao Chan’s arrangements in his mind.
A while later.
Diao Chan, Cai Wenji, Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhao Zilong, Pan Feng, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, and others all gathered at the foot of the Dragon Ladder.
On Ding Ling’s signal, they all stepped onto the Dragon Ladder, preparing to go to the Immortal Realm.
And at the foot of the Dragon Ladder.
There were countless dense crowds watching.
Among these people were players and natives.
Everyone was hotly discussing.
Zhen Jiang and others were bidding farewell to their families.
This time, almost all the direct members of the Zhen Family were present.
Zhen Yi, Zhen Yao, Zhen Yan, Zhen Tuo, Zhen Dao, Zhen Mi, and others all gathered here.
Compared to more than five years ago,
the current Zhen Mi had grown into a charming and lovely girl. Judging by her age, she appeared to be a fifteen or sixteen-year-old maiden now.
She had come to Chang’an with her family a few days ago.
But she had not seen her brother-in-law whom she missed dearly.
When she met him again, Ding Ling was about to take Zhen Jiang and others to the Immortal Realm.
"What do you think?"
Zhen Tuo whispered to Zhen Mi, smiling:
"You finally see the brother-in-law who you’ve been talking about every year. What are your thoughts?"
"Thoughts..."
Zhen Mi withdrew her gaze from Ding Ling, tucked her hair behind her ear with her right hand, her face slightly reddened, and she spoke somewhat shyly:
"Brother-in-law is indeed dashing and extraordinary. No wonder so many people praise him and sing his praises. His majestic demeanor alone is enough to inspire admiration."
"Is that all?"
Zhen Tuo looked at Zhen Mi in surprise:
"Many have said those words. You, this little clever one, shouldn’t just repeat what others say, right?"
"Sister."
Zhen Mi shyly raised her hand and lightly hit Zhen Tuo:
"Don’t say anymore."
"Hehe."
Zhen Tuo covered her mouth and laughed softly:
"If you have anything to say, you should hurry up. Your brother-in-law and they are about to leave for the Immortal Realm."
"I can go too."
Zhen Mi said nonchalantly:
"I have been diligently cultivating day and night, and now I have reached the standard of a second-class general. I can step onto the Dragon Ladder to the Immortal Realm anytime."
As she spoke this,
she quickly turned her eyes and went to find Zhen Jiang.
Zhen Tuo was taken aback, then she was filled with regret:
"So little Mi, this clever girl, has been learning martial arts for this day?! No, that’s not it."
She remembered that Ding Ling had only come down to the lower realm recently.
There had been no news about Ding Ling descending to the lower realm before.
Ding Ling’s sudden descent, and the Immortal Path had only appeared not long ago.
Zhen Mi couldn’t have been preparing to such an extent.
There’s only one possibility.
Zhen Mi has the intention of stepping on the Celestial Ladder to the Upper Realm and has been working hard towards that.
"It seems that my little sister doesn’t want to be a person of the lower world. Her ambitions are high!"
Zhen Tuo felt relieved, yet at the same time, somewhat dejected and regretful.
She had spent these years immersed in needlework, wasting her time.
To reach the level of a second-class general like Zhen Mi, how long would it take?
An hour later.
Ding Ling and his group took the Immortal Path to ascend to the Immortal Realm.
Zhen Tuo, Zhen Yi, and others looked up.
Their faces were filled with pride, contentment, and a sense of honor.

Zhen Yi had often felt proud of having a son-in-law like Ding Ling; now, Ding Ling was willing to take Zhen Mi, Zhen Yao, and other Zhen family members who met the cultivation standard to the Immortal Realm to practice!
This made Zhen Yi feel even more that his son-in-law was generous and took care of his people, but at the same time, he also felt some anxiety.
"It seems that when I return, I should gradually hand over the Zhen family’s business to others, encouraging my family to cultivate diligently and as a group, move to the Immortal Realm!"
Immortal Realm.
Just by hearing its name, one knows it’s incomparable to the mortal world.
And there’s an old saying:
People move on to higher places, and water flows to lower places!
Zhen Yi, as the head of the family, naturally has his ambitious aspirations! He is not content to lag behind, which is quite normal.
"If I can’t seize the opportunity with such a capable son-in-law, I would truly be foolish and useless!"
The more Zhen Yi thought, the more determined he became in his mind.

He glanced at Zhen Tuo, Zhen Dao, and other children, seeing the regret, frustration, and envy on their faces, he knew they had also made up their minds, so they immediately returned home, preparing for the family to diligently cultivate to meet the standard to enter the Immortal Path, and then collectively migrate to the Upper Realm.
Among the crowd of onlookers,
were Xiahou Yuan, Xiahou Dun, and others gathering.
Cao Ren asked:
"Did the whole Pan Feng family leave?"
"They left."

chapters.title: Chapter 813 - 802: Dragon Boat
paragraphs: Xiahou Dun replied;
"It’s not just Pan Feng, the entire family of Zhao Zilong, Wang Yue’s disciples, and Tong Yuan’s students have basically all left."
"A mighty throng."
Xiahou Yuan sighed:

"The talent drain is significant! If this continues, our Great Wei Kingdom will face a severe shortage of talent. It’s foreseeable that soon many cities in the Great Wei Kingdom will be ’barely scraping by’."
"Indeed."
Cao Hong also came, interjecting at this moment:

"Fortunately, the Immortal Realm allows free movement, you can go up and come down. So our Great Wei Kingdom just needs to maintain good relations with the Immortal Realm. In this way, even if there’s a talent shortfall, it would still deter the petty villains. After all, the Prince is our Great Wei Kingdom’s Guardian God, Grand General, First-Rank Prince!"
"That’s absolutely right!"
Xiahou Dun and Xiahou Yuan exchanged glances and then nodded and smiled:
"With the Prince, no worries!"
At this point.
They also started getting restless:
"How about we all move to the Immortal Realm collectively?"
"Let’s send someone to scout the route."
"Let Li Dian go then."
Cao Hong said:
"His strength has recently reached the Super-Elite level, and he’s incredibly fast. It’s perfect to send him to scout the way."
The group made a decision.
Thus, they let Li Dian take the Dragon Ladder to the Immortal Realm.
Compared to the Celestial Ladder.
The difficulty of the Dragon Ladder drops significantly.
Therefore, Li Dian took just seven days for a round trip and brought back important news.
"The concentration of Spiritual Vitality in the Immortal Realm is a hundred times that of the Lower Realm!"

"And the concentration of Spiritual Vitality in the Celestial Court is a thousand times greater? Training in the Celestial Court for one day equals three to four years of training in the Lower Realm! And this is just the most initial stage of the Immortal Realm! Currently, the Immortal Realm is undergoing drastic changes, and with time, training one day in the sky may equal ten years in the human realm."
Upon hearing this.
The collective was in uproar!
The court was shaken.
Cao Mengde couldn’t sit still, if not for Cao Ang going to the Celestial Court with Ding Ling, he would have thought about abdicating now and letting Cao Ang take the throne.
Compared to immortality.
What is being an emperor?
Cao Mengde has been an emperor for several years, and it’s enough.
Thinking of this.
Cao Mengde started mulling over who to pass the throne to?
Unable to decide immediately, he casually named Cao Pi as Crown Prince, letting him first learn to handle political affairs and important matters.
Cao Pi wore a bitter expression, his face full of ’I don’t want to’!

Ever since knowing that Cao Ang and Cao Chong went to the Immortal Realm with Ding Ling, with a possibility of becoming immortal, Cao Pi suddenly felt that the so-called emperor’s throne was a wasted opportunity!
He declined: "You could train my brother Cao Zhi. He’s smarter than me."
Although Cao Zhi is younger, he’s exceptionally wise since childhood. Hearing this, he rolled his eyes and giggled:
"I’m still young, can’t bear such heavy responsibilities, moreover, I need to follow father to the Immortal Realm, excuse my absence."
This made Cao Pi even more anxious:
"I’m also going to the Immortal Realm."
It was about to start a fuss that would lead to chaos.
Cao Mengde frowned:
"Alright, alright. Anyone wanting to go to the Immortal Realm must first improve their strength. None of you have sufficient cultivation, yet you want to go?"
"Brother Cao Chong also hasn’t reached the level, how did he go?"
"He has a good master, do you?"
Cao Zhi and Cao Pi looked at each other, full of discontent:
"We also want to take on a master, but father you won’t allow us!"
Left speechless, Cao Mengde slammed the table in anger:
"Each of you thinks about shortcuts! Get back and cultivate properly, those not up to standard, I won’t take them to the Immortal Realm!"
"So father’s intention is I don’t need to be emperor?"
Cao Pi joyfully asked.
"Go away then."
Cao Mengde waved his hand weakly.
"Yes, yes, yes. I’ll go, I’ll go."
Cao Pi beamed brightly.
If he could go to the Immortal Realm to learn the ways of immortality, who would still want to remain in the mundane world as a restrained emperor?
He may be young, but he’s not foolish.
Cao Mengde evidently saw through his little schemes, didn’t force him, but started gradually transferring power to the Prime Minister, General, and others!
He has enjoyed what he should, now age has caught up, and naturally, it’s time to prepare for the future.
With Ding Ling leading the way.
Under Diao Chan’s guidance, the speed of the group was extremely fast, akin to traveling on lightning. In a flash, they passed by many teams striving on the Dragon Ladder.
These were all players and natives whose cultivation met the standards!
They were all heading to the Immortal Realm, to become its first inhabitants.
Soon.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and others arrived in the Immortal Realm.
"Wow, it’s so beautiful."
Zhen Mi marveled as she surveyed the surrounding Earth Realm.

The mountains and rivers were majestic, the scenery picturesque, at the far end the Celestial River hung high, radiant with a myriad of colors, palaces looming at Cloud Peak, as if glimpsing a paradisiacal wonder!
"Is that the Celestial Court?"
Cai Wenji murmured, dazed.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling nodded:
"That’s where you all will reside going forward, follow me onto the Dragon Boat to the Celestial Court."
Ding Ling led the way.
The group arrived at a lake beneath the Celestial River’s waterfall, where a Dragon Boat was moored.
At Ding Ling’s gesture, Da and Xiao Qiao, Cai Wenji, Cao Chong, and others found themselves on the Dragon Boat.
The Dragon Boat was large.
Once everyone boarded.
The Dragon Boat self-activated, moving upstream, racing against the waterfalls, charging into the Celestial River.
Cao Ang watched, his blood boiling, filled with admiration:
"Never imagined I’d step into the legendary Celestial Court one day!"
"You should be glad you have a good master."
Standing beside Cao Ang, Shi A looked up at the Celestial River waterfall hanging high, standing at the bow was akin to ants viewing the Celestial Palace, the impact, extremely shocking.
Feeling his own insignificance, upon hearing Cao Ang, he remarked:
"How many heroes desire to become apprentices to the Prince and cannot. You are truly lucky."
"Indeed."
Cao Ang agreed, consistently feeling wise about kneeling and kowtowing back then!
If it weren’t for that kowtow, he might not have had the chance to become Ding Ling’s disciple. Naturally, he wouldn’t receive various opportunities and fortunes.
These opportunities, any one casually taken out, would make his father and brothers envious to the point of being stupefied!
Understanding this, Cao Ang held Ding Ling in high regard and deeply respected him!
Even though Ding Ling rarely taught him, having only passed on a single cultivation technique, he remained extremely impressed and respectful!
Whoosh!

The Dragon Boat raced upstream, compared to the vast Celestial River with no visible end, this Dragon Boat moving upstream felt like a grasshopper carrying a leaf amidst a mighty river, delivering an unparalleled visual impact!
Zhen Mi found it perplexing:
"Brother-in-law, from afar this Celestial River doesn’t appear large, why does it seem so vast and grand up close?"
"This is the unique Power of Rule belonging to the Immortal Realm and Celestial Court."
"Power of Rule?"

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - 803: Lingxiao Palace
paragraphs: Zhen Mi seemed to half-understand, half-not, only glancing at Ding Ling with a slightly flushed face. Her almond-shaped eyes, as gentle as water, were filled with admiration, closeness, and trust—anyone could see it.
Zhen Jiang was helpless, how could she not see that this little girl Zhen Mi had fallen for her own husband.
But her husband’s charm was too great; how many women on Chang’an Street wouldn’t like him?
Thinking of it this way,
she was relieved.
’For years, Zhen Mi often spoke of wanting to meet her brother-in-law. Now that her wish has come true, she must be extremely joyful.’
Zhen Mi grew up listening to stories of Ding Ling.
Naturally, her feelings towards Ding Ling were quite complex.
Among them were admiration and affection for her idol;
astonishment and respect towards the hero;
trust and closeness towards family;
Moreover, Ding Ling was peerless and extraordinary, with limitless grandeur, like the sun standing among the crowd!
His brilliance diminished the radiance of famous generals and figures like Cao Mengde and Xiahou Yuan.
It was no surprise that Zhen Mi fell in love at first sight.

But this feeling, she was too shy to express, only occasionally sneaking glances at Ding Ling, with a look of infatuation in her eyes that was noticeable to others, yet she was completely unaware of it.
Cai Wenji saw this and, feeling a sense of shared sentiment, couldn’t help but develop a fondness for Zhen Mi. She saw her own shadow in Zhen Mi.
After all, in the past, wasn’t she the same?
Fortunately.
She met such an understanding and gracious sister as Diao Chan.
Thinking of this, she couldn’t help but tug on Diao Chan’s sleeve.
Diao Chan glanced at her and patted the back of her hand with a smile.
"We’ve arrived."
The dragon boat sailed against the wind and waves, moving upstream. When it reached the South Heavenly Gate, Ding Ling waved his hand, and clouds formed out of thin air.
Everyone stepped onto the clouds, following Ding Ling as they flew toward the entrance of the South Heavenly Gate.
"Wow."
Even Cao Chong started to exclaim in amazement.
They passed through the deep azure, glazed South Heavenly Gate.
Upon seeing thousands of golden rays rolling with red rainbows and auspicious vapors spraying purple mist, amidst the splendid rosy clouds, a series of palaces appeared faintly visible!
"We’ve truly arrived at the Celestial Court!"
"It’s completely different from the Mortal Interface!"
Everyone descended from the clouds, landing on the ground.
They felt as if the ground was also woven from clouds, stepping on it lightly, as if they could fly far away in an instant.
"So extraordinary."
Wang Yue, Tong Yuan, and the others couldn’t help but secretly marvel:
"No wonder it’s the legendary Celestial Court; it’s almost exactly as I imagined!"
With aliens serving as ’copyists’ in the Mortal Interface, Wang Yue and his group had read many classics like Journey to the West.
And this Celestial Court wasn’t much different from what was recorded in Journey to the West.
The only difference might be that there were no people!
But with their arrival,
the Celestial Court gained a lot more vitality.
Ding Ling led them to Lingxiao Palace.
To begin the Divine Enthronement.
Of course.
Before the enshrinement, Ding Ling asked if they were willing to become deities of this Celestial Court.
"What happens if we become gods?"
Pan Feng couldn’t help but ask.
"You will share the same lifespan as Heaven and Earth! The Immortal Realm is eternal, and so will you be."
Everyone was astounded:
"Meaning, we will be immortal?!"
Da and Xiao Qiao couldn’t believe it.
Cao Ang, Shi A, and the others were also overwhelmed with emotions, unable to remain calm!
"Yes."
Ding Ling nodded.
"Then I am willing!"
Shi A was the first to raise his hand in agreement:
"My potential is limited, becoming a god is the best thing that could happen!"
"Once we become gods, can we no longer cultivate?"
Wang Yue asked.
"No."
Ding Ling replied:

"Even after becoming gods, you can still cultivate. If, in the future, you wish to descend to the Lower Realm to climb the Celestial Ladder and head to the Upper Realm, you can do that too. However, you must remember this: in the Celestial Court, you are bestowed divine status. You can live as long as Heaven and Earth do. But upon reaching the Upper Realm, you will no longer be under the protection of this Heaven and Earth, thus losing the immortality.
Therefore, if you live a thousand years in this realm, then head to the Upper Realm, you might die in an instant. So, consider carefully what choices to make and how to proceed in the future."
Subsequently, Tong Yuan, Zhao Zilong, and others asked questions.
Ding Ling answered each one.
After a period of time.
Zhao Zilong, Tong Yuan, Diao Chan, and everyone else chose to become gods.
Because after becoming gods, they would be more aligned with this realm’s Heavenly Dao, and their cultivation speed would be incredibly fast!
The only flaw seemed to be that once they ascended to the Upper Realm as gods, they would no longer be deities, and the lifespan granted to them by Heaven and Earth would automatically be returned.
Of course, if their cultivation was advanced enough that their lifespan reached ten thousand years, or even twenty thousand years,
even if they stayed a thousand years in this realm, they could still maintain themselves intact upon reaching the Upper Realm, without any discomfort.
And if they cultivated Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding to Great Perfection, their lifespan could easily be extended by twenty thousand years!
Tong Yuan, Diao Chan, and others planned to cultivate the Martial Dao True Understanding to Great Perfection in the Celestial Court before venturing to the Upper Realm!
Ding Ling approved of this.
The concentration of Spiritual Vitality in the Celestial Court surpassed that of the Wind and Cloud World.
Especially in specific realms like the Lingxiao Palace, it far exceeded others like the Wind and Cloud World.
And once the Divine Enthronement succeeded,
it could be foreseen.
The concentration of Spiritual Vitality in the Celestial Court will definitely reach a terrifying level, and at that time, it will certainly become a very suitable place for cultivation.
With this in mind.
Ding Ling began the enshrinement.
He communicated with the rules and first pointed to Diao Chan:
"Enshrine Diao Chan as the Great Saint of the Jade Pool, Queen Mother of the West!"
A flash of golden light.
Diao Chan’s attire dramatically changed; a celestial robe of ethereal magnificence draped over her, enhancing her majesty, gracefulness, and supreme stature!

"You are in charge of warning about calamities and rewarding the good and punishing the evil in the Three Realms and Six Dao. You also oversee all female immortals in the Three Realms, being the head of the female immortals!"
As the voice fell.
Rumble!
Heavenly Dao immediately launched a thunderous sound, and then a yellow light appeared in the void.
The yellow light split in two.
Eighty percent fell onto Diao Chan, and twenty percent on Ding Ling’s head.
Diao Chan, following Ding Ling’s advice, stored this eighty percent of yellow light within her, for his use, without immediately using this merit to enhance her cultivation.
Ding Ling did the same.
Whoosh!
Diao Chan, recognized by the Heavenly Dao, unexpectedly received a Divine Paper in her Sea of Consciousness, faintly glowing, allowing Diao Chan to intuitively understand its use.
Surprisingly, it was for communicating with the Heavenly Dao, enabling her to be informed about disasters and the actualities of good and evil across the Three Realms and Six Dao in advance.
At the same time.
With this Divine Paper, she could live and not die, sharing the lifespan of Heaven and Earth.
Diao Chan told Ding Ling about this.
Ding Ling was slightly surprised, but after a brief thought, he understood.
The King Yama also had a Divine Paper, but theirs was ethereal and invisible, yet with the Immortal Realm beginning the enshrinement, the King Yama’s Divine Paper would gradually materialize.
Once it fully materializes,
the King Yama will become a deity within the system of the Three Realms and Six Dao!
Even if the Netherworld gets destroyed, as long as the Immortal Realm is unharmed, they can still achieve eternal life and immortality!

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - 804: Divine Enthronement
paragraphs: This is the powerful aspect of the system of Divine Enthronement.
The Three Realms and Six Paths are interconnected; one flourishes, all flourish; one suffers, all suffer!
The glory of the Immortal Realm can radiate to the Netherworld.
The halo of the Netherworld can likewise elevate the upper bounds of the Immortal Realm.
If any world within the Three Realms is damaged, although it will lower the limits of the other worlds, similarly, the beings within the damaged world can seek refuge in other worlds and survive.
This is the unique, inclusive nature of the Three Realms and Six Paths.
"Very well."
Ding Ling, having realized the mysteries and principles within, was very satisfied.
He pointed towards Tong Yuan:
"Confer Tong Yuan as Emperor Ziwei."
A streak of purple light flashed by.
Tong Yuan was immediately adorned with a magnificent celestial robe with starlight gleaming, its purple color accentuating his grand and supreme presence.
"You are the Master of the Stars, Grandmaster of Myriad Phenomena, ruling the Heavenly Scripture and Earthly Weave, controlling ghosts and thunderbolts."
As those words fell!
Rumble!
Thunder roared, the Heavenly Dao responded, a beam of yellow light descended, splitting into two, falling towards Tong Yuan and Ding Ling respectively.
Tong Yuan also did not use merit to enhance his cultivation; his potential is infinite and should not be wasted here.
He thanked Ding Ling.
With a face full of gratitude and emotion, his recognition of Ding Ling in this moment reached unprecedented heights!
No doubt.
In the future, he will certainly be the most steadfast ’battle comrade’ standing behind Ding Ling!
Ding Ling, proficient in the Observing People Skill at full level, knew this well, and nodded, then pointed towards Wang Yue:
"Confer Wang Yue as the Antarctic Emperor of Longevity!"
A white light flashed by.
Wang Yue was also endowed with a white celestial robe.
"You assist the Jade Emperor in controlling the climate of the four seasons, governing the pivot of fortune and misfortune in all things!"
Rumble!
The Heavenly Dao responded, yellow light descended.
In Wang Yue’s Sea of Consciousness, a Divine Paper also appeared!
He was equally full of admiration and excitement, unable to restrain himself from bowing deeply to Ding Ling in gratitude.
The initial investment had yielded a profound return like today.
Wang Yue, such a capable Grandmaster, couldn’t help but sigh at the past when he selflessly taught Ding Ling all his skills, otherwise how could he have gained such favor from Ding Ling?
One piece of effort, one result.
He sowed a seed of effort, and reaped a hundredfold reward!
Ding Ling’s response and reward to him were so generous, almost to the point of embarrassment in accepting.
But not accepting it would affect his Martial Dao future.
He couldn’t help but accept it.
But he secretly made a decision in his heart, that no matter what, he must stand steadfastly by Ding Ling’s side and be his loyal supporter in the future!
Next.
Ding Ling conferred Zhao Zilong as the Emperor Gouchen!
Du Qingcheng as the Lower Earthly Deity, Following Heaven and Emulating Houtu!
Pan Feng as Emperor Dongji Qinghua!
Cai Wenji as the Nine Heavens Profound Lady!
Zhen Mi as Luoshen!

Da Qiao as Chief of the Celestial Constellations, Venerable of the North Pole Purple Qi, having command over eighty-four thousand stars and malevolent spirits, eternally seated as Kan Palace Doumu True God!
Xiao Qiao as Hundred Flowers Fairy!
Cao Ang as Wuqu Star!
Cao Chong as Wenqu Star!
Zhou Cang and Pei Yuanshao as Marshals guarding the Lingxiao Palace!
Shi A as Chief of the Thunder Department, Nine Heavens Responding Origin Thunder God, and Universal Transformation Celestial Venerable!
Chen Dao as Grand Marshal of Demon Suppression!
Cheng Huan as Water Virtue Star Monarch!
Xun Chen, Tian Feng, Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Bingxuan, Zhao Feng, and others were all granted titles in turn.
These individuals were among the earliest who steadfastly stood by Ding Ling’s side.
Now they all received unprecedented and unimaginable returns, one by one shocked and delighted, while their gratitude and reverence for Ding Ling reached a peak at this moment.
After all the close ones were conferred titles.
Ding Ling conferred upon himself the title of Jade Emperor!
With Ding Ling’s golden robe, emperor’s crown, and Divine Paper adding to his presence, a surge of unparalleled power infused at Ding Ling’s crown!
Making Ding Ling appear even more majestic and grand, like a mountain towering over the ocean!
Tong Yuan, Wang Yue, and others watched with vibrating hearts, unable to restrain themselves from bowing towards Ding Ling:
"Salutations to the Empress of Haotian Golden Firmament, the Supreme Venerable, Natural Wondrous and True Emperor, Jade Emperor!"
Since they had all become deities,
In the hidden realms, they came to know of Ding Ling’s full title!
Ding Ling waved with a smile:
"Beloved ministers, rise."
"Thank you, Your Majesty."
Tian Feng and others rose one after another.
They were all perplexed, never imagining that, as civil officials, they would also become immortal and divine one day!
This gift was too heavy!
Devoting a lifetime, they feared they could never repay, they could only do their best in their remaining years, not disappointing the importance and affection Ding Ling had for them!
"There are still many divine positions in the Celestial Court."
Ding Ling said:

"I will stay in the Celestial Court for a while. Next, you all should carefully select reliable individuals with adequate cultivation, and I will confer them as deities. Let the Three Realms and Six Paths accelerate its operations."
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
After discussing with Ding Ling for a while, the deities dispersed, as they all had duties to attend to.
After all, the Celestial Court had just been established.
Much needed to be done.
Everything had to start anew!
"This feeling..."
Ding Ling sat on the Emperor’s Seat, slightly closed his eyes, sensing himself.
As numerous deities were conferred.
The merit Ding Ling received was considerable; after all, he gained twenty percent of each deity’s merit, plus the full ten successes of the Jade Emperor!
These merits condensed together, forming a small hollow circular halo in the Sword Spirit’s Dantian!
This halo, warm and soothing, made Ding Ling’s mind increasingly clear, accelerating his cultivation and understanding.
Not only that.

The Immortal Realm indeed was as he predicted, speeding up its recovery by not less than twice, with all the deities in place; in time, the Immortal Realm would become increasingly vast! The Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi would naturally grow denser too.
"The Spiritual Qi has revived."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
He had not expected the ultimate direction of the Historical World to be such an outcome.
This truly was beyond his expectations!
However, such a result, could not be better!
Tian Feng, Jushou, Cheng Huan, and other literary figures with lesser martial talent could also be conferred as deities, thus sharing the longevity of heaven and earth, never aging or dying.

Zhao Zilong and others obtained high-tier official ranks, and with these divine positions enhancing their cultivation, combined with their extraordinary talents and the Martial Dao True Understanding as a Divine Skill to train in, the future prospects were bright!
Everything was racing toward a better direction!
Even beyond Ding Ling’s expectations!
How could Ding Ling not be satisfied?
"Celestial Might, Celestial Heart Mark... indeed, the Three Kingdoms Plane is very special!"
It is heard that Late Qin and Late Sui also possess Celestial Might.
Could their worlds in the past also have had Netherworld and Immortal Realm?
Ding Ling was just pondering this, suddenly sensing that the Immortal Realm seemed to be connecting with the Late Sui and Late Qin historical plane worlds.
People from those worlds seemed to be able to ascend to the Immortal Realm too?!
"Indeed, has the merit led to the barriers of the Lower Realm being broken?"

Ding Ling, absorbed in thought, waved his hand, sending a streak of Vigorous Qi like a dragon flying out from the South Celestial Sect, across the Celestial River, piercing through countless dimensions in the hidden realms, forming a Dragon Ladder linking to the Mortal Interface of Late Sui.
Boom!
This Dragon Ladder landed outside the atmosphere of the Late Sui world, slowly descending.

The Three Realms and Six Paths are interconnected; one flourishes, all flourish; one suffers, all suffer!
The glory of the Immortal Realm can radiate to the Netherworld.
The halo of the Netherworld can likewise elevate the upper bounds of the Immortal Realm.
If any world within the Three Realms is damaged, although it will lower the limits of the other worlds, similarly, the beings within the damaged world can seek refuge in other worlds and survive.
This is the unique, inclusive nature of the Three Realms and Six Paths.

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - 805: Casting Talismans in Midair
paragraphs: The speed at which the Dragon Ladder descends is quite slow.
It is estimated that it would take one or two years to completely reach outside of Chang’an City in the lower realm.
Ding Ling pondered:
"It seems the complete repair and perfection of the Celestial Realm will take one or two years."
During this one or two years.
The Celestial Realm will continuously reward Ding Ling.
Making Ding Ling possess various unfathomable mystical energies.
What use does this energy have?
Ding Ling currently does not know.
But he has a feeling that if he fully masters this energy, it will undoubtedly be greatly beneficial to his development in both Martial Dao and Immortal Dao!
He is now just a mere Martial Arts Golden Core Level expert, far from becoming immortal.
And at his current level, he has already begun to be infused with the inexplicable special mysteries of the Celestial Realm.
These mysteries are beyond what he can currently control within his cultivation range, so he is not clear about their use either.
But he knows one thing.
If it is beneficial, he should first acquire it and talk about it later.
Therefore, he plans to stay in the Three Kingdoms for one or two more years.
"I’ll take advantage of this time to train well with Diao Chan and the others and enhance their strength!"
But before that.
I have to descend to the mortal world once.

Thinking so, Ding Ling shed his yellow robe, dressed in plain clothes, stepped out, and the next moment, he arrived at a Daoist Temple located outside of Lujiang County, Wan County, more than ten miles away in the human realm.
As he became the Immortal Realm Emperor.
The power triggered by his Celestial Heart Mark grew stronger, and the margin of error naturally reduced further.
Nowadays, he can almost pinpoint the exact location.
Therefore.
This time, he stepped out directly to reach the destination and saw the person he wanted to find.
A Daoist priest turned his back towards him, attending to someone’s illness.
Ding Ling proactively called out:
"Senior."
The Daoist priest trembled slightly, turned his head, and upon seeing Ding Ling, his pupils slightly dilated with a bit of surprise, but more disbelief:
"Prince. You, you..."
"Long time no see."
"Indeed. It’s been five or six years."
The Daoist priest was Yhiuu Ji.
For some reason, he visibly aged a lot, but upon seeing Ding Ling at this moment, he couldn’t help but show joy, stood up with a smile, and said:
"It’s truly my humble abode’s honor to welcome the Prince!"
He was about to entertain Ding Ling, but seeing the patients lined up in a long queue, he felt a bit awkward.
Ding Ling smiled:
"Let me help."
Yhiuu Ji’s eyes lit up as he recalled Ding Ling’s skill in talisman crafting, which surpassed the master, with some anticipation, but then felt embarrassed due to Ding Ling’s current status.
After all, times have changed.
Ding Ling is no longer what he was, while he remains just a small Daoist temple priest.
Ding Ling, seeing through Yhiuu Ji’s thoughts, did not reveal them, and just went forward, flicked his finger, and a flash of golden light appeared, manifesting talismans out of thin air in the void.
The talismans turned into streams of light that entered the patients’ bodies.
In the next moment.
All patients felt spirited and invigorated, with their ailments inexplicably vanished.
They were shocked, unable to believe it.
Yet instinctively knelt in gratitude.

When someone in the crowd revealed that the healer was Ding Ling, the Sword God and Guardian God of the Great Wei who swept across the land a few years ago, they were even more moved, discussing among themselves:

"Who would’ve thought the Prince isn’t only skilled in warfare, but his healing abilities have reached unfathomable levels! With a wave of a hand, he healed over a hundred patients present. It’s like a fantasy!"
"Indeed. Who would believe it without witnessing it themselves?!"

"I heard from an Alien that the Prince seems to have created a celestial path to the Celestial Court. If some of our descendants are qualified, they might be allowed to walk the Immortal Path, and if they gain the Prince’s favor, it would truly be a blessing accumulated over eight lifetimes!"
Ding Ling’s healing divine techniques were too legendary and fantastical.
Not to mention the patients who were dumbfounded.
Even Daoist Yhiuu Ji was bewildered, his lips trembling uncontrollably:
"This, this, this, the ability to manifest talismans mid-air? It’s not recorded in the Taiping Qingling Dao. Rumor has it, it’s not even in the Taiping Sutra."
He looked at Ding Ling in disbelief:
"How did you manage to do it?"
"Senior, do you want to learn it?"
"Of course!!"
"Then I’ll teach you."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was stunned, but instinctively expressed gratitude.
Ding Ling smiled and said:
"Senior taught me Taiping Qingling Dao, allowing me to smoothly reach the Celestial Human Realm; I’ve long wanted to repay this kindness. Now is the right time.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was ashamed and remorseful:

"Prince, if you say so, it really embarrasses this old Taoist! When the Prince learned the methods back then, you passed through many of my tests, which is completely different from how you’re imparting knowledge now. I, I..."
"Senior, don’t think that way."
Ding Ling comforted:

"Different times, different circumstances. To you, the Taiping Qingling Dao is everything. But to me, this so-called Medical Dao is just one skill among many I have learned. Senior should feel at ease to accept it."
Ding Ling took out a Medical Canon from his arms and handed it over:
"Here you go."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was deeply moved, looking at Ding Ling with admiration and praise in his eyes:
"Prince’s magnanimity is something this old Taoist is ashamed of."
Ding Ling placed the Medical Canon into Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s hand.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s hand trembled as he opened the Medical Canon; after just reading the first page, he found himself engrossed.
However, after only a dozen pages, he began to sweat.
By the time he reached the middle, he was already dizzy and unable to continue reading.
He took a deep breath, reluctantly and arduously closed the Medical Canon, marveling and being astonished, he said:
"Is this Medical Canon compiled by the Prince?"
"Indeed."

"It truly is extraordinary, the various medical methods in it are enough to overturn people’s worldview and imagination! I once doubted whether it was real. But after just witnessing the Prince’s method of casting talismans in the air to heal, I had to believe it."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji sighed in admiration and praised repeatedly.
After chatting with Ding Ling for a while.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji slapped his forehead and said:
"Look at me, I even forgot to entertain the Prince. Come to the living room with me, and I’ll make a good pot of tea for you!"
"Senior."
Ding Ling stopped Daoist Yhiuu Ji and said:
"I came here this time, wanting to see you properly."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was moved:

"I understand. I’ve received your goodwill. Over the years, Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing have sent letters to me, saying you are grateful and generous. Now I truly understand, you are indeed a rare and exceptional young man!"
Ding Ling smiled, thought for a moment, and then spoke candidly:
"Daoist, Zuo Ci and Nanhua Old Immortal have been killed by me."
"What?!"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s body shuddered, and he exclaimed:
"What did you say?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 817 - 806: Black Serpent
paragraphs: Ding Ling then repeated it once more.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji murmured, somewhat lost:
"Nanhua Old Immortal, Zuo Ci, are both, both dead?!"
In his eyes, Zuo Ci was a mysterious figure like a Divine Dragon.
Nanhua Old Immortal was even more so, in his heart akin to an Immortal God.
Yet such legendary Venerable figures.
Were killed by Ding Ling?!
How could that be possible?!

However, Ding Ling wouldn’t lie, Daoist Yhiuu Ji believed in Ding Ling’s character, and knew Ding Ling wouldn’t kill without reason. Ding Ling understood righteousness and repays kindness; he couldn’t be someone who kills the innocent indiscriminately. Thus, after a moment of panic, he composed himself and fixed his bright gaze on Ding Ling:
"Can you tell me the details?"
"Of course."
Ding Ling nodded.
He briefly pointed out what Nanhua Old Immortal and Zuo Ci had done.
Upon hearing this, Daoist Yhiuu Ji took a breath and said:
"If that’s truly the case, their deaths are not regrettable."
He sighed deeply:

’I never expected these characters I admired to be such people. Truly, knowing a person is far more intricate than understanding their outward appearance. Indeed, in this world, the human heart is the hardest to fathom.’
Ding Ling neither agreed nor disagreed, saying:

’Therefore, I came to find you this time to see if Nanhua Old Immortal tampered with your cultivation in Taiping Qingling Dao. If it was tampered with, it may need to be abolished, or serious consequences could ensue.’
Daoist Yhiuu Ji nodded, signaling Ding Ling to check it.
Ding Ling then approached for a detailed inspection.
With the Celestial Heart Mark to assist.
Ding Ling’s abilities had now reached an unimaginable level.
Even if Immortal Gods descended to earth, they would be no different.
The various Powers of Rule from the Secret Manual bestowed upon him, allowing Ding Ling to instantly comprehend the mysteries within others.
He was like having been born with Eyes of Golden Flame, when he laid hands on Daoist Yhiuu Ji, he discovered a trace of unfathomable Soul Power flowing in him.
This Soul Power was deeply hidden within Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s organs and Sea of Consciousness, even if he cultivated to the Golden Core or Primordial Spirit Realm, he would certainly not detect it.
Unless his Cultivation surpassed that of Nanhua Old Immortal, otherwise, as time passed this Soul Power would act, causing Daoist Yhiuu Ji to be controlled by others.
Ding Ling informed Daoist Yhiuu Ji of this matter.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was astonished and saddened:
"To think I always greatly revered Nanhua Old Immortal. He intended to use me all along."
What did he want to use Daoist Yhiuu Ji for?
Ding Ling didn’t know.

However, Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s intelligence was extraordinary and his Taoist heart steadfast, perhaps this Soul Power struggled to be effective, leading Nanhua Old Immortal to abandon him? Consequently, allowing Daoist Yhiuu Ji to be killed by Sunx Ce?
The original plotline was indeed that Yhiuu Ji was killed by Sunx Ce.
However, now the storyline had drastically changed.
Sunx Ce ascended to the Upper Realm.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji remained well in this Daoist Temple.
"Must the cultivation of Taiping Qingling Dao be abolished?"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji felt deeply troubled:
"I am already old, if I abolish my cultivation, I fear I may not survive this winter."
"Best to err on the side of caution."
Ding Ling said:

"Your Soul Power subtly interlocks, I fear that even if you die, it will follow you into Reincarnation. If that happens, should Nanhua Old Immortal’s mastermind emerge, continuing to manipulate you, whether you live or die, you may become helpless."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s expression changed slightly upon hearing Ding Ling, he sighed deeply and said:
"If that’s the case, then I shall abolish my cultivation."
"Once your cultivation is abolished, you could consider becoming a deity in the Celestial Court. As a deity, free from death or aging, you could naturally do what you love."
"Can I really become a deity?"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was astonished and surprised.
Ding Ling explained the reason.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji inhaled deeply, looking at Ding Ling in disbelief yet gratefully nodded:
"Nothing could be better."

With that, Ding Ling used the Power of Rule from the Celestial Heart Mark to abolish Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s cultivation, stripping away the tight strands of Soul Power entwined around his organs and Sea of Consciousness.
After these Soul Powers were stripped away, they rolled and hissed in the void like a black python, looking quite frightening.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s face turned pale, unable to believe such malice lurked in his body.
Ding Ling used the flame from the Power of Rule to incinerate the black python.
Afterward.
Ding Ling took Daoist Yhiuu Ji and flew to the skies, heading towards the Celestial Court to prepare for Divine Enthronement.
Unexpectedly, halfway there, Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s vitality visibly waned.
He said:
"Ding Ling, I’m nearing my end, the end is nigh."
Ding Ling sensed it carefully, utterly shocked.
Yet Daoist Yhiuu Ji had indeed died, and speaking with him now was Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s soul.
"How could this be?"
Initially, Ding Ling was puzzled.
Soon after, he grasped it.
It turned out Daoist Yhiuu Ji was bonded with the strands of Soul Qi.
The black python died, so must Daoist Yhiuu Ji!
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was dead.
Divine Enthronement was naturally impossible.
Ding Ling, without The Investiture of the Gods, couldn’t enthrone others’ souls.
Hence, he pondered and took Daoist Yhiuu Ji to the Netherworld.
"Is this the Underworld?"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji glanced all around, sensing something.
"Yes."
"Remarkable."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji’s heart was shaken:
"Ding Ling, your Cultivation has already reached such heights? Youthful talent indeed!"
Ding Ling sighed.
Originally, he intended to enthrone Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
Instead, he ended up killing Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
This was yet another unexpected event.
He trusted too much in the abilities of the Celestial Heart Mark, forgetting that behind Nanhua Old Immortal was a powerful, unbelievable mastermind.
How could the methods of such a strong adversary be underestimated?
"You need not blame yourself."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji viewed it lightly, laughed heartily:
"Life includes birth, aging, sickness, and death, daily fortunes and misfortunes. Years ago, I sensed my end approaching. Even if you hadn’t acted, I doubt I’d live much longer. So, you needn’t.
He paused, adding:

’Speaking of which, I ought to thank you for removing the black python. If not, even through reincarnation, I might be controlled by others. Now I’m liberated, feeling unprecedentedly free and relieved.’
Ding Ling knew Daoist Yhiuu Ji was comforting him, and without extra words, he led Daoist Yhiuu Ji onto the Yellow Springs Path, walking forward together.
The Ghost Souls on the Yellow Springs Path were growing more numerous, a dense long queue.
Some colossal figures occasionally emerged and vanished in the void, appearing in the forest beside The Yellow Springs Path. To the troubling Ghost Souls, they gave a lash, crack!
Crack!
The sound of lashes on Soul Bodies went straight into the heart, and every Ghost Soul hearing the whip instinctively shivered, becoming more obedient, not daring to act out.
Ding Ling nodded silently.
These Puppet Soldiers, after receiving merit and fortune, were growing more intelligent and spirited.
They seemed to have seen Ding Ling, each one knelt in the void, paying respects to Ding Ling.
Causing the Ghost Souls from Late Sui, Late Qin, and Three Kingdoms’ worlds to be perplexed and uncertain.

chapters.title: Chapter 818 - 807: Reincarnation
paragraphs: "To whom are these Underworld emissaries paying such homage?!"

"Indeed. They are rampant and unscrupulous; even Chen Sheng and Wuu Guang, who reigned supreme in the Late Qin World, were crushed at their whim. Yuwen Huaji and Dou Jiande from the Late Sui World were pummeled into groans and wails. Such ghost gods, yet they have someone they revere?!"
"To whom are they bowing?!"
With the Netherworld permeating the three historical Plane Worlds.
The ghost souls transformed from the dead are all guided into this world.
Among them are many renowned figures!
These figures were all slain during the struggles for supremacy and duels. Although deceased, the solidity and stature of their ghost souls are far more formidable than ordinary ghost souls.
However, strong as they are, they stand no chance against the judges or puppet soldiers transformed into Ox Head and Horse Face.

It is precisely due to understanding the strength of the Judge and Ox Head and Horse Face that they feel astounded and puzzled by Ox Head and Horse Face suddenly paying homage to Ding Ling, leading to endless speculation and debate.
Ding Ling merely nodded slightly to Ox Head and Horse Face, then, with Yhiuu Ji in tow, used Instant Step to appear within King Qin Guang’s King Yama Hall.
Yhiuu Ji was awestruck.
Especially upon seeing the legendary King Yama being deferential to Ding Ling, he was even more astonished, unable to close his gaping mouth.
And the person being judged by King Qin Guang at that moment was Chen Sheng and Wuu Guang of the Late Qin.
They too witnessed these scenes with wide-eyed astonishment.
They looked at Ding Ling, all speculating:
"Who exactly is this young man, looking neither tall nor grand, yet even the towering, overbearing, intimidating, and inscrutable King Yama submits to him?!"
Initially, they held a mocking attitude towards Ding Ling’s abrupt appearance.
Thinking that King Yama would certainly harshly punish someone like Ding Ling who disregards rules!
After all, on the Yellow Springs Path, beside the Bridge of Helplessness, any undead daring enough to provoke the ghost gods and act recklessly would be whipped!
They learned their lesson the hard way and became wiser as a result.
However, to their surprise, King Yama actually paid formal respect to this young man?!
Their souls trembled, stunned and shocked beyond belief.
"I am here to send Yhiuu Ji into reincarnation."
Ding Ling pointed at Yhiuu Ji, saying:
’Quickly take Yhiuu Ji through the process; I want to personally witness him entering the Six Paths of Reincarnation.’
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
King Qin Guang respectfully replied.
With Ding Ling becoming the Immortal Realm Emperor!

King Qin Guang’s Divine Paper also became increasingly refined because his Divine Paper falls under the framework of the Three Realms and Six Dao, hence intuitively he also became aware of Ding Ling’s full title, knowing now how to appropriately address Ding Ling.
He no longer called Ding Ling master.
It is naturally different in terms of identity, so the form of address also differs.
Ding Ling did not mind these details, instead following King Qin Guang.
Leaving Chen Sheng and Wuu Guang alone in King Yama Hall staring at each other, until Ding Ling and the others departed, Chen Sheng and Wuu Guang exclaimed with a sharp intake of breath:
"King Yama actually called that young man Your Majesty?! Is he possibly the Ghost Emperor of Fengdu?! Or is he the legendary Celestial Emperor?!"
Their hearts surged with turbulent waves as various thoughts came to mind.
Regardless of which scenario.
Undoubtedly.
Ding Ling is not someone they could engage or provoke.
"And who exactly is this Yhiuu Ji to be favored by such a major figure!"
Chen Sheng and Wuu Guang were filled with envy:
"If only we could also win recognition from such a remarkable person, how great that would be?!"
It was not just them.
Standing at the entrance of the grand hall, Dou Jiande and Yuwen Huaji and others were equally dumbfounded, staring rigidly in the direction where Ding Ling and the others left.
"We actually brushed past legendary figures!"
"Yhiuu Ji? Sounds so familiar!"
"If I remember correctly, the Taoist killed by Sunx Ce during the Three Kingdoms period was named Yhiuu Ji!"
"I recall now. What is it about Yhiuu Ji to earn such regard!"
Yuwen Huaji, Dou Jiande, and others all gazed with envy and jealousy so fierce that their eyes went bloodshot!
At that moment, they all wished to stand in for Yhiuu Ji, at Ding Ling’s side!
As for this.
Unknown to Ding Ling.
He followed closely around King Qin Guang, watching as King Qin Guang executed the process, ultimately delivering Yhiuu Ji to the threshold of reincarnation within the Six Paths.
He looked at Ding Ling:
’Your Majesty, what is your choice?’
Yhiuu Ji was stunned like a stone pillar!
Through it all.
He saw too many undead judged and imprisoned, saw ghost souls lined up to take turns drinking Meng Po Soup.
Only he, through conveniently opened doors, was unimpeded in reaching the gateway to reincarnation within the Six Paths.
Led covertly by the legendary King Yama, what does it feel like,?!
Now Yhiuu Ji experienced it.
It’s simply exhilarating!
Thinking of the envious, jealous, bewildered, and incredulous gazes of the ghost souls along the way, Yhiuu Ji’s heart was filled with mixed emotions.
He dislikes backdoor dealings.
But when it’s actually his turn, one must admit, it’s truly a relief!

For that, he felt deeply grateful to Ding Ling; without Ding Ling, in Hell after his death, the treatment he would receive would definitely not be better than others, surely accompanied by a series of cumbersome procedures.
How could it be like now, smoothly reaching the Six Paths of Reincarnation?
"Senior, in which world do you wish to be reborn? And what person do you wish to be?"
Ding Ling looked at Yhiuu Ji.
Yhiuu Ji was amazed:
’Even this can be chosen?!’
"Yes."
Yhiuu Ji gasped, pointing at his head:
"My memory?"
"Will be preserved."
"Even the memory is preserved. This, isn’t it too good."
Assisted so openly in opening ’convenient doors’.
Yhiuu Ji was a bit apprehensive, not out of fear, but the feeling of undeserved favor.
"There’s nothing wrong with it."
Ding Ling smiled and said:

"This facilitates your path to enlightenment. Should you in the future refine your skills successfully, you can advance to the Immortal Realm, then naturally someone will come to escort you to become a god."
Yhiuu Ji was profoundly moved:
"Your Majesty. How shall I repay you in the future?"
After dying, Yhiuu Ji’s form of address for Ding Ling changed, from Prince to Ding Ling.
Apparently, upon a person’s death, their mindset also subtly changes in the void.
Currently, he also follows King Qin Guang in addressing Ding Ling as Your Majesty.
As he has hope for reincarnation.
Thus, courtesy must not be abandoned.
"Senior, refine your skills well, becoming immortal and imperishable, naturally providing you a chance to repay."
Ding Ling replied with a smile.
"Alright."
Yhiuu Ji nodded, pondering repeatedly, then said:
"I choose the Late Sui World — a humble abode."
King Qin Guang questioned:
"Why not opt for a wealthy and prestigious home? That would better aid martial training?"

"I am born with retained memory. Taiping Qingling Dao was recently cultivated to Great Perfection, the Medical Canon is mostly memorized. Under such circumstances, I shall refrain from seizing others’ welfare. Retaining memory after being reborn already constitutes cherished fortune."

chapters.title: Chapter 819 - 808: Divine Child
paragraphs: Yhiuu Ji understands satisfaction, and also knows that if one is too greedy, the Dao Heart may inevitably become tainted. He chose a commoner’s family because it’s the best way to face the Dao Heart directly.
"Are you sure?"
King Qin Guang asked.
"I’m sure."
Yhiuu Ji said solemnly.
King Qin Guang looked at Ding Ling. After Ding Ling nodded, King Qin Guang sent Yhiuu Ji into the Human Dao of the Six Paths of Reincarnation!
Whoosh!
Yhiuu Ji transformed into a beam of light and disappeared into the depths of the Six Paths of Reincarnation.
Ding Ling had the Celestial Heart Mark on him.
Some time later.
He perceived that Yhiuu Ji had been reborn into a commoner’s family in the Late Sui World.
Ding Ling was currently powerless to interfere in the Late Sui World.
After all, the Dragon Ladder of the Immortal Realm would take one or two years to descend upon the Late Sui World.
Not only in the Late Sui World, but also in the Late Qin World.
One or two years later.
The world barriers of these two worlds would be thoroughly breached, and by then, the people from those worlds could naturally ascend to the Immortal Realm via the Dragon Ladder.
Yhiuu Ji was born with memories, and as long as his cultivation goes smoothly, he could enter the Immortal Realm in a few years.
Thinking this.
Ding Ling no longer worried, and after bidding farewell to King Qin Guang, he stepped out and arrived at the Celestial Court in the Immortal Realm.
He specifically invited Tong Yuan and Tian Feng, told them about Yhiuu Ji, and let them reserve a divine position for him at the right time.
After the two people withdrew following his orders.
Ding Ling then went to cultivate with Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and others.
Cai Wenji also joined the cultivation team on this day.
Although she had a weak foundation and poor aptitude,
her remarkable insight allowed her to navigate the difficulties of cultivating such divine skill as the Martial Dao True Understanding with relative ease, especially with Ding Ling’s assistance.
And this divine skill, which could only be cultivated by married couples,
naturally excluded Luoshen Zhen Mi.
She watched as Cai Wenji, ’a goddess’ much weaker than her, experienced a ’rocket-like’ surge in cultivation, shocked and stunned to the extreme.
Several times she pursued Cai Wenji for her secret.
Finally, unable to resist, Cai Wenji blushed and shared this broadly with her.
After hearing this, Zhen Mi blushed as well, awkwardly saying:
"I see.
She was a bit envious:
"Your brother-in-law is so good to you."
"Indeed."

Cai Wenji expressed harmony with Ding Ling over this period, shedding her past frail and melancholic state, looking invigorated and increasingly beautiful beyond compare. Speaking of Ding Ling, her eyes shone with the light of happiness:
"His Majesty is gentle and accommodating to me. It isn’t just me; he treats every wife like this."
Listening to this, Zhen Mi felt increasingly miserable.
She too liked Ding Ling.
But didn’t know how to express it.
Cai Wenji figured out the truth, approached her, and holding her hand, whispered:
"Don’t worry. In some time, I will discuss with Diao Chan and Sister Zhen Jiang. We’ll definitely let you fulfill your wish."
"Oh dear."
Exposed, Zhen Mi became somewhat flustered:
"I’m not talking about this anymore. I have something to go."
She turned and hurried away.
But her heart was joyful, thrilled, and happy. Therefore, even in haste, her steps showed speed and rhythm, light and heavy, signaling the tumultuous state of her emotions.
Cai Wenji watched Zhen Mi’s back and laughed, going to find Diao Chan and the others.
After truly being with Ding Ling, she understood what happiness and complete security meant.
She was very grateful to Diao Chan, hence treating her with utmost respect and admiration.
She bonded with Zhen Mi well because Zhen Mi’s circumstances evoked sympathy and pity in her.
Time flowed like water.
In the Late Sui World, Yhiuu Ji was born in a southern remote mountain village.
He was born accompanied by strange phenomena, flowing light.
The villagers revered him as a Divine Being, believing Yhiuu Ji to be the reincarnation of their local deity, greatly favoring him.
Especially since Yhiuu Ji could speak at birth, walk after one day, and run after three days, leaving them all dumbfounded!
Due to the deep mountain location, the locals were very superstitious.
Yhiuu Ji’s performance reinforced their unwavering belief in their previous assumptions, confirming him as a deity reincarnated, they further cherished him.
Yhiuu Ji never disappointed them with his actions.
In less than a month, he could leap, climb trees, and swim.
In less than half a year, he could eat several bowls of rice and instruct villagers on herb gathering and hunting, excelling in everything.
The medical skills he displayed were miraculous, as he cured several terminal villagers.
This made the locals worship him as a Bodhisattva.
Of course.
Yhiuu Ji knew that the big tree attracts wind, so he repeatedly instructed the locals never to disclose his matters.
The local people initially obeyed.
But three years later.
As Yhiuu Ji displayed increasing wisdom and bravery, during exchanges with people from other villages, they couldn’t resist showing off a bit, and this incident gradually spread to other places.
Some people who doubted came to see.
Seeing a three-year-old child incredibly powerful, they were shocked, and some even harbored malice, wanting to capture Yhiuu Ji and offer him to the current emperor Li Shimin!
Yhiuu Ji knew he couldn’t stay in this village. That night, he left behind some talismans and Great Medicine for his parents of this world and left without a word.
The villagers searched everywhere for Yhiuu Ji the next day.
After pondering and considering.

They realized that someone must have revealed Yhiuu Ji’s information, causing him to be unable to stay. They naturally resented the informant deeply, but since Yhiuu Ji was gone, they couldn’t pursue.
And it was from this day onwards.
The legend and stories of Yhiuu Ji began to spread throughout the Late Sui World.

Not only the natives, but even many players marvelled, finding it incredible, discussing how in the Historical World this might happen — a newborn speaking, walking in one day, several months later guiding villagers in herb gathering and hunting, and healing people!
However, many eyewitnesses vowed with their lives, which made them have no choice but to believe.
Especially when an entire village spoke the same, every individual’s eyes brimming with admiration for Yhiuu Ji, showing no sign of acting.
How could this not spark curiosity among the players and natives?
"Unbelievable!"
"This isn’t a Mythical World, so why did such a person suddenly appear?!"
"Didn’t you notice that since Ding Ling descended into the Historical Plane, strange things have continuously occurred, could this Divine Child have something to do with Ding Ling?"
"Why do you always link everything to Ding Ling?! Can you speak of something else!"
"It’s hard not to think so. After all, Ding Ling is the Jade Emperor of the Celestial Court!"
Nearly four years passed.
Yhiuu Ji grew up.
Ding Ling’s Dragon Ladder Immortal Path also opened up the Late Sui and Late Qin Worlds. At this time, not only did many players enter the Immortal Realm, but also many natives.
Hence, they all know who rules the Celestial Court.
Knowing this, they instinctively associate anything with Ding Ling.
