chapters.title: Chapter 820 - 809: Cao Mengde Ascends to Godhood
paragraphs: Let us not speak of Yhiuu Ji’s matter for now.
Time flows back to when Zhen Mi and Cai Wenji were conversing.
From that day on.
Ding Ling almost secluded himself in the Jasper Pool area of the Celestial Court without venturing out.
If anything needed handling, naturally Zhao Zilong, Tian Feng, Jushou, and others took care of it.
His only appearance was on the day the Dragon Ladder connected the Late Qin and Late Sui Worlds.
Cao Mengde brought many people onto the Immortal Path, arriving at the Celestial Court on a Dragon Boat.
Among these people were Li Dian, Cao Ren, Cao Hong, Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Dian Wei, Xuu Chu, Cao Mengde, and others.
Their martial powers and other attributes met the standards.
Moreover, they held remarkable status in the Lower Realm.
Ding Ling personally came forward to ennoble them as deities.
Cao Mengde’s wishes were fulfilled, and he was overwhelmed with joy, grateful beyond words to Ding Ling!
Dian Wei, Xuu Chu, and others also knelt in thanks.
At this moment.
Ding Ling became their true ’superior’!
He was their ’Your Majesty’!
Even Cao Mengde, the Human Emperor, had to call Ding Ling Your Majesty; naturally, Xuu Chu, Dian Wei, and others would not foolishly refrain from calling Ding Ling Your Majesty.
Thus, they ’inexplicably’ switched lords!
Dian Wei, Xuu Chu, and many others who were loyal to Cao Mengde were somewhat baffled!
But having become deities, achieving immortality, and seeing the fervor Cao Mengde had towards Ding Ling, they could only accept this reality!
After the Divine Enthronement.
Ding Ling returned to Jasper Pool to continue training with Diao Chan and the others.

Meanwhile, Cao Mengde became Marshal Tianpeng, in charge of the Celestial River Navy, with the Divine Paper hidden in his Sea of Consciousness, immortal, living as long as heaven and earth. He eagerly went to handle his affairs like a new official full of enthusiasm.
He went toward the Celestial River laughing, his joy and excitement visible to all.
Though Xuu Chu muttered, wasn’t the title of Marshal Tianpeng belonging to Zhu Bajie?

Cao Mengde cared little; on the contrary, he thought the position of Marshal Tianpeng was very fitting. In his words, arriving at the Celestial Court late and obtaining such a high position was unexpected, and he was grateful to Ding Ling beyond measure.
How could he possibly reject a position like Marshal Tianpeng from a literary novel?
As for how Xuu Chu knew "Journey to the West," it was naturally due to the proliferation of ’copycat’ Aliens.
"Splash!"
Cao Mengde fell into the Celestial River.
Because he was in charge of the Celestial River, the Divine Paper granted him considerable control over it. And with the increase in cultivation, this control would only grow stronger.
Thus, when he stepped into the Celestial River, he was unharmed.
In the Celestial River, now after a year or two of development, there were quite a few Celestial Soldiers and Generals.
Among these Celestial Soldiers and Generals, there were players and natives.
Seeing an additional leader.
They were greatly astonished.
And when they saw that Marshal Tianpeng was indeed Cao Mengde.
Players and natives were incredulous:
"Has Your Majesty become Marshal Tianpeng?!"

"Why are you still calling him Your Majesty?! Do you want to die?! The true Majesty is none other than the Jade Emperor, high on the Lingxiao Palace! An Emperor in the mortal world, at most, is a Human Emperor!"
"Hehehe, yes, yes, yes. Who would have thought Cao Mengde, a Human Emperor, would come to the Celestial Court and work alongside us."

"How can these be the same? They are deities, immortal. We are just Celestial Soldiers and Generals, though protected by rules, it’s difficult to live as long as heaven and earth. The treatment is completely different!"
Players and natives, amidst their astonishment, also wore faces filled with envy and jealousy!
They had arrived earlier than Cao Mengde.
Yet did not receive the treatment of Divine Enthronement!!
Cao Mengde observed all this, growing more complacent, happy, and excited, lifting his appreciation and admiration for Ding Ling to an extreme!
Several years ago.
Before Ding Ling’s ascension, Cao Mengde had been very wary and uncomfortable with Ding Ling.
Now that Ding Ling had become the Jade Emperor.
He had become Ding Ling’s subordinate.
Instead, he felt much more at ease and comfortable! With no pressure at all!
Especially since he had realized his heart’s desire, his sense of pleasure and satisfaction was soaring!
"Throughout history, how many Great Emperors could not achieve immortality, yet I, Cao Mengde, have achieved it!"
Cao Mengde knew all this was thanks to Ding Ling.
Hence, he resolved to perform his duties well, not wanting to betray Ding Ling’s trust in him.
Time flowed by gently, like water.
Huang Yueying also followed her father onto the Immortal Path into the Immortal Realm.
She longed to see Ding Ling, but now that Ding Ling was lofty and unreachable, she felt powerless, and even her father could hardly help her.
She looked up at the faintly visible palace community on Cloud Peak, secretly determined: I must strive to ride the Dragon Boat and ascend to the Celestial Court!
The cultivation environment in the Immortal Realm was a hundred times better than that in the Lower Realm!
After a few years of cultivation here, more and more people were meeting the standard and entering the Celestial Court to become Celestial Soldiers and Generals.
Huang Yueying was confident that she too would eventually meet the standard and become a Female Immortal in the Celestial Court!
Only by constantly striving.
Would she draw closer to Ding Ling!
Huang Chengyan saw all this, smiling bitterly, knowing he couldn’t stop the intelligent and highly capable Huang Yueying from a young age!
Knowing he couldn’t stop her, he chose to help her!
He also hoped that one day Huang Yueying would truly become a Goddess in the Celestial Court, allowing Huang Yueying to also achieve immortality.
The matter of Cao Mengde, Cao Ang, Cao Chong, Cao Ren, Cao Hong, Xiahou Dun, Dian Wei, and others being ennobled and achieving immortality had already spread throughout Jiuzhou in the Lower Realm.
The number of envious and jealous people was countless!
All were sighing that the Cao Family had such good fortune, encountering a figure like Ding Ling!
Becoming a Human Emperor was due to Ding Ling’s support.
Becoming an immortal deity of the Celestial Court was also thanks to Ding Ling’s assistance!
And with all this.
Cao Mengde and the others naturally also understood. To avoid any gossip, they became increasingly diligent in their work, increasingly loyal, and never negligent in their duties!
On this day.
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhen Jiang, Cai Wenji, and others successively reached the Shattered Realm with Ding Ling’s help.
Cai Wenji was the last to reach the Shattered Realm.
Seeing that they all met the standards.
Ding Ling decided to leave this world.
Before leaving, he specifically instructed Diao Chan and transferred the power of Divine Enthronement to Diao Chan.
How was the transfer done?
The Celestial Heart Mark could not be conferred.
Ding Ling took the Divine Paper from his Sea of Consciousness and placed it into Diao Chan’s Sea of Consciousness.
At that moment.
Diao Chan simultaneously held the responsibilities of the Queen Mother and the Jade Emperor.
She naturally also gained the ability to bestow low-level divinities.
Appointing Earth Gods, Mountain Gods, ordinary Immortal Fairies of the Celestial Court posed no issues for her.
After this matter was declared in the Lingxiao Palace.
Ding Ling, amidst the reluctance of Diao Chan and others, took one step and arrived at the Celestial Ladder in the Lower Realm.
This time.
Due to the Dragon Ladder Immortal Path linking the other two Historical Planes.
He could choose among three Celestial Ladders.
Which were the Late Sui, Late Qin, and Three Kingdoms worlds.
But he did not go to the Late Sui or Late Qin.
He still chose the Three Kingdoms.

chapters.title: Chapter 821 - 810: The Deer and the Cauldron
paragraphs: Whoosh!
Ding Ling stepped out and arrived at the end of the Three Kingdoms Celestial Ladder.
Standing here, one can clearly see the Gate of Glory woven with golden light.
Inside the Gate, there are three deep and boundless roads.
Above each road, golden characters hang in the air.
Ding Ling looked at the roads within the Gate of Glory and pondered:

"I can choose to return to the Wind and Cloud World now, or choose to return through the layers of the Gate of Glory. But the choices of the Gate are currently uncertain, and I can’t be sure which world I will step into. Let’s see my luck."
Ding Ling wanted to see if he could eventually reach worlds like The Smiling, Proud Wanderer and Divine Condor.
If he could enter them all.
That would save many opportunities to go back to the Lower Realm!
It must be known that if he ascends to the Upper Realm this time, he can never return to the Three Kingdoms World again!
But other worlds, if he steps onto the Ladder this time, and luck is good, enters.
It’s equivalent to having the opportunity to go back to that world in the future.
In that case.
Naturally, Ding Ling would want to step onto the Ladder and enter the Gate of Glory to try his luck.
After all, opportunities to return to the Lower Realm are quite rare.
"Staying in the Three Kingdoms World, my future will definitely end in a miserable fate."
Ding Ling had a premonition.
The mastermind behind Nanhua Old Immortal would certainly not let things go.
"How could someone who can kill a dignified Upper God from the Mountain and Sea Realm be a kind-hearted person?"
Ding Ling must prepare in advance and get strong quickly.
So, he decisively left the gentle land.
Since ancient times, the gentle land has been the grave of heroes, and Ding Ling has spent a combined time of two years with Diao Chan and them.
Over two years.
Aside from the major transformation of the Sword Spirit.
His True Qi has also become orderly like Yin and Yang, hard and soft as needed, akin to the Yin Yang Qi when Heaven and Earth first opened!
This is due to the frequent practice of the couple’s technique, over time!
Compared to the True Qi when first descending to the Lower Realm a few years ago.
Today’s True Qi can be as fierce as a dragon and as gentle as the wind! Regarding the control power of this True Qi, Ding Ling suddenly elevated it by several times!
Combat power naturally increased manifold as well.
Even so.
When it later came to pass.
Although Diao Chan and others’ cultivation steadily rose, his own cultivation remained stagnant, resulting in increasingly poor training effects.
In view of future difficulties.
Ding Ling finally extricated himself and left.
"Before leaving, should I take the World Furnace with me?"
Ding Ling thought for a bit, but ultimately gave up.
The World Furnace is too large.
Moreover, its utility is singular, only capable of accommodating and refining worlds, and the long time it takes to refine a world is evident from Nanhua Old Immortal’s actions.
Ding Ling can’t afford such a delay.
He needs to rapidly grow stronger and can’t waste time waiting at the same place just to refine a world.

"Let the World Furnace continue to suppress the Six Paths of Reincarnation. In doing so, the Immortal Realm and Netherworld will become increasingly stable, and their upper limits will continue to rise."
Ding Ling had already shared with Diao Chan the method to receive the World Furnace.
When Diao Chan and them reach the world’s limits and cultivate Martial Dao True Understanding to Great Perfection, they will naturally take the World Furnace and leave the Lower Realm.
Moreover, players can always be aware of occurrences in the Upper Realm.
Ding Ling and Diao Chan had discussed and decided.
When he has developed to a certain level and progress in the Upper Realm, Diao Chan will choose whether to ascend according to her own situation.
"Everything is arranged. Time to go."
Ding Ling took a deep breath, stepped out, and entered the Gate of Glory.
In the next moment.
A beam of golden light swept in like a ribbon, suddenly enveloping Ding Ling’s body, drawing him into the Heaven-Reaching Dao of ’The Deer and the Cauldron’.
Ding Ling, whose sight has improved tremendously now, saw clearly and couldn’t help feeling regret:
"It seems luck isn’t on my side."
He thought he could go to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
This would save him a chance, but unexpectedly, he couldn’t go.
’Hope the next time will be smoother!’
Ding Ling couldn’t believe that with several choices, he’d be this unfortunate in picking the wrong world.
Boom!
Ding Ling felt the Celestial Heart Mark being gradually stripped away.
This signified his distance from the Historical Plane.
Layer after layer of dimensional worlds was penetrated.
When the Celestial Heart Mark was completely stripped, darkness fell before Ding Ling’s eyes, and he couldn’t perceive anything further.
With the Celestial Heart Mark in place, he could even sense how many layers of dimensional worlds he’d pierced.
Without the Celestial Heart Mark.
He was immediately returned to his original state.
Back to his normal level.
Even so.
He was still innumerable times stronger than ordinary Super-Elite Fierce Generals!
He could crush a group of fierce generals with a single finger.
Thus, although he couldn’t perceive anything, he didn’t pass out, instead observed in silence as suddenly before his eyes, brightness unfolded.
He found himself in a new world, glancing behind him, faintly seeing a black hole disappear in the void.
"Is this how the transmission works?!"
Ding Ling pondered.
He didn’t delve deeper.
Because overthinking is useless, considering such divine techniques as piercing dimensional layers are far beyond his control.
"Better figure out where this place is first."
Ding Ling didn’t want to linger in such a Martial World for long; his descent was for Diao Chan, Little Dragon Girl and others.
Now Diao Chan and they are settled.
He ought to arrange for Qu Feiyan and others.
Regretfully.
This time he had entered the world of The Deer and the Cauldron, not The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
Wanting to meet Qu Feiyan could only wait for the next ’return opportunity to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’.
These opportunities are used sparingly.
Ding Ling didn’t want to waste them.
So this time, he planned to directly head to Chang’an, then ascend the Heaven-Ascending Ladder again, to the next world.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling stepped with the breeze, like the Wind God, taking an Instant Step, spanning dozens of miles in a flash.
With the Celestial Heart Mark being stripped.
His ability to immediately reach another world was naturally gone.
But even so, in such a Low-level Martial World, traversing hundreds of miles in an instant remained easy!
After all.
He’s now several times stronger than when he first descended to the Lower Realm!
Traversing hundreds of miles in a moment was naturally not a problem.
But Ding Ling merely stepped out, seventy to eighty miles away, he found human traces and did not continue forward, but descended to the earth, walking steadily ahead.
A hundred meters ahead.
There was a tea stall.
The stall wasn’t large, apart from essential equipment like a stove for making tea, it had only two tables and eight long benches.
The owner was an elderly man over seventy years old, who was pouring tea for a beautiful, snow-white-skinned young girl.
The girl was lost in thought, supporting her chin with a small hand, staring vacantly ahead.
Until Ding Ling arrived.
Her eyes brightened a little.
"Old man."
Ding Ling glanced at the girl, then looked at the old man, politely asking:
"Can you tell me where this place is?"
"This is Zhao Family Village."

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - 811: Mu Jianping
paragraphs: "Where is Zhao Family Village?"
Ding Ling continued to ask.
The old man saw Ding Ling dressed in fine clothes and with an extraordinary aura, clearly a person of importance. Somewhat nervous, he hunched slightly and said haltingly:
"I don’t know where it is either. I just know that if you walk ahead for more than twenty miles, you might reach Qingyun Town."
"Qingyun Town?"
The names of various small towns flashed through Ding Ling’s mind, and he really couldn’t recall a place called Qingyun Town on the Jiuzhou Land for a moment.
Then he looked at the young woman:
"I wonder, young lady, if you know where this place is?"
"Lin’an."

The young woman saw Ding Ling, outstanding and handsome, a rare sight of beauty in this world, and for a moment, she was mesmerized. It wasn’t until Ding Ling spoke that her face turned slightly red, and she shyly said:
"This Qingyun Town is a small town under the jurisdiction of Lin’an."
"Lin’an."
Ding Ling nodded and smiled:
"Thank you."
He was so gracious and polite, it felt like a spring breeze.
The old man’s nervousness receded a bit, and he smiled sheepishly and said, "I haven’t done anything to help you. No need to be so polite, Young Hero."
He quickly took out a cup, poured some tea, and said:
"If Young Hero doesn’t mind, perhaps you could have a cup of tea. You seem weary and travel-worn; are you a stranger here?"
"You could say that."

Ding Ling had intended to walk away immediately, but seeing the old man’s expression and demeanor, he couldn’t refuse, so he sat down, picked up the cup, and drank the tea in one gulp. Taking some broken silver from his pocket, he placed it down and smiled:
"Old man, I have some matters to tend to, so I’ll take my leave now."
After finishing speaking,
Ding Ling stood up and stepped away.
The old man was startled upon seeing the broken silver on the table. He hurried to catch up, saying:
"Young Hero, you shouldn’t do this. I offered you the tea, I can’t accept your money."
Ding Ling paid no heed, only walking faster.
Seeing that Ding Ling was about to disappear from sight,
the young woman disregarded her tea, whistled, and the horse grazing beside her came at the sound. She leapt onto the horse’s back and chased after Ding Ling, calling out as she ran:
"Hero, Hero, wait for me, wait!"
Ding Ling didn’t pay attention to the old man.
He understood the hardships of the poor; it was clear from how the old man, despite his age, was still working, that life was tough for him.
Yet giving gold seemed inappropriate.
Ding Ling crushed a silver ingot from his pocket, leaving some broken silver as tea money for the old man.
Now, with the young woman calling after him, Ding Ling, who initially planned to use Soaring in the Void to travel hundreds of miles instantly to Chang’an, paused.
The young woman had offered directions.
Ding Ling couldn’t ignore her, so he stopped where he was, waiting for the young woman’s horse to catch up and then said:
"Do you have something to ask me?"
"Uh."
The young woman froze; she was an escapee from a ruined household.
She had been fleeing for several months.
Looking around, the land was vast, yet nowhere felt safe.
She had no idea where to go.

Seeing Ding Ling, and recognizing that he was also a stranger, alongside his kindness and sympathy towards the old man—she already admired his appearance and charisma tremendously—and now her good impression of Ding Ling soared even higher.
So, seeing Ding Ling about to leave,
it was instinctive for her to follow.
This was mere instinct, but it also indirectly proved Ding Ling’s current great allure; he was indeed very captivating!
"If you have nothing to ask, then let us part here."
Ding Ling, seeing the young woman daydreaming, gently reminded her.
The young woman came back to her senses quickly, saying:
"Hero. Where are you going? Could you take me with you?"
"Take you with me?"
Ding Ling was taken aback.

The young woman’s face turned as red as fire, and feeling it was impolite to talk to Ding Ling from horseback, she jumped down, tidied her hair over her ear, her eyes flitting a bit, and somewhat unnaturally said:

"I am Mu Jianping from the Mu Royal Mansion. Due to the Prince’s Mansion being besieged by the Great Qing official Duolong and his troops, we had no choice but to flee. During the escape, I got separated from my brother. The silver, silver is all spent. I don’t know where to go."
The more she spoke,
the redder Mu Jianping’s face became,
until finally, her head drooped completely, as if too embarrassed to face Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was speechless.
He looked Mu Jianping up and down.

Even though the girl had a face full of frost and weariness, the inherent elegance and clarity in her bones were hard to hide. Her features were more appealing upon closer inspection; if she were to rid herself of the weariness and dress up, she would certainly be as captivating as a bright pearl from the sea, or a beautiful jade in one’s palm.
"Mu Jianping from the Mu Royal Mansion?"
Ding Ling thought for a moment and remembered:
"Don’t you know Weil Xiaobao?"
According to the storyline.
Mu Jianping should have long been Weil Xiaobao’s wife.
"Weil Xiaobao?"
Mu Jianping was taken aback, a flash of distaste across her pretty face:
"That little scoundrel is too much, I don’t like him!
It appeared that with the players’ interference,
Mu Jianping hadn’t ended up with Weil Xiaobao.
Ding Ling continued:
"It’s our first meeting, and you already revealed your background to me. Aren’t you afraid I might hand you over to the Great Qing for a reward?"
"I’m not afraid."
A flicker of fear crossed Mu Jianping’s face, but she quickly straightened up, her bright almond eyes fixing on Ding Ling, and said crisply:
"Hero, you are a good person. You wouldn’t harm me."
Ding Ling’s eye twitched twice:
"We’ve only just met, how do you know I’m not pretending?"
Ding Ling leaned close to Mu Jianping, their faces nearly touching.
His acting activated, he smirked mischievously:
"If I were to assault you now and then hand you over to the authorities, wouldn’t that be making a huge profit?"
Ding Ling’s acting was at full level.
This smile made Mu Jianping’s heart quiver, making her instinctively step back. But soon after, as if thinking of something, she straightened her chest, approached Ding Ling, and said coquettishly:

"I’m not afraid at all. I believe you’re a good person, just trying to scare me! Your demeanor towards the old man and me shows your nature. Besides, your steps are as quick as the wind, clearly a Martial Arts Expert. If you wanted to harm me, you would have done so already, why bother with such words?"
"... It seems you’re not stupid."
’Of course I’m not stupid.’
Mu Jianping put on a wide-eyed expression:
"I’m clever, otherwise the Great Qing soldiers would have caught me long ago!"
"Hehe."
Ding Ling chuckled, without a word, glanced around:
"It’s getting late. Let’s talk as we walk."
"Hero, does this mean you agree to let me follow you?"
Mu Jianping eagerly asked.
"If you wish to follow, then come along."
Ding Ling lifted a leg and walked forward.
"Alright!"
Mu Jianping gleefully said:
"Thank you, Hero!"
She led her horse, trotting to follow behind Ding Ling, calling out:
"Hero, Hero. Do you want to ride the horse? My horse is well-behaved. How about you ride it?"
"No need. You ride it yourself. You look so petite and run so slowly. Better ride the horse."

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - 812: Hero
paragraphs: Mu Jianping made several concessions, yet Ding Ling was walking faster and faster.
She watched as Ding Ling’s distance from her grew farther and farther.
She mustered all her strength to run but still couldn’t catch up.
Helplessly.
She could only ride her horse to catch up quickly, yet found that no matter how fast she rode, she couldn’t match Ding Ling’s pace, always two positions behind him.
She was shocked in her heart and couldn’t help but speak more.
"Hero, Hero. What’s your name?"
"Ding Ling."
"Oh, that sounds familiar. I seem to have heard it somewhere. Hero, Hero, you must be a very famous person in Jianghu, right?"
"Perhaps."
"Wow. So... Hero, can you help me find my brother?"
"No."
In the course of their questions and answers.
The two stepped into Qingyun Town one after the other.
It was already late.
Ding Ling was in no rush for now.
After all, he had stayed in the Three Kingdoms for two years.
Delaying a day or two was no big deal.
Yet at this moment.
Ding Ling thought, ’Since I’m already here in The Deer and the Cauldron World, why not finish reading all the books in this world’s library before I leave.’
But he changed his mind temporarily.
Planning to take a trip to the Capital.
Anyway, in such a Low Martial World, nothing could harm him.

He could leave after reading the books; it wouldn’t affect him, and could even enhance his knowledge, aiding the improvement of Martial Dao True Understanding, and ultimately helping him become immortal.
Martial Dao True Understanding could absorb the essence of various martial arts and achieve sublimation.
Currently, it was only at version 1.0.
Once the necessary resources were absorbed, it would naturally progress to version 2.0.
"Hero, Hero. Over here, over here."

Mu Jianping was very lively, innocent, and kind. Even after months of fleeing in Jianghu, she hadn’t been tainted by the world’s dust, her heart remained pure and unsullied, which Ding Ling greatly admired.
Looking at Mu Jianping, Ding Ling seemed to see Zhong Ling.
Zhong Ling was also lively and cheerful.
However, there were differences; Zhong Ling understood many things but remained innocent and carefree, sunny and optimistic.
Mu Jianping only understood things halfway, like a beautiful flower that grew in a tranquil, peaceful environment. Though innocent and kind, there were times when she was melancholic.
At this moment, Mu Jianping had chosen an inn, had the hostler watch her horse, then went inside and chose a seat, constantly calling and waving to Ding Ling.
She bounced around without regard to how others viewed her, inadvertently revealing the unique playful charm of a young girl.
Ding Ling laughed and walked over, sat down, and ordered a few small dishes.
The two chatted and ate.
Evidently, Mu Jianping’s curiosity about Ding Ling was high; even with her mouth full of food, she didn’t forget to ask questions.
"Eat slowly. Nobody’s competing with you."
Mu Jianping’s face quickly turned red, feeling a bit embarrassed. She then started chewing slowly, appearing more ladylike.
After eating.
Mu Jianping gratefully said:
"Thank you, Hero, for the treat. I hadn’t eaten my fill in days."
"Eh."
Ding Ling sighed:
"Alright. We’re friends now. Don’t call me Hero, just call me by my name."
"How would that be appropriate?"
Mu Jianping crisply said:
"If you don’t like me calling you Hero, how about I call you Brother Ding?"
"As you wish."
"Then I’ll call you Brother Ding."
Mu Jianping’s smile was bright, with lingering dimples at the corners of her mouth. These dimples were almost identical to Zhong Ling’s, making Ding Ling marvel at the wonders of nature!
It’s amazing that two girls so similar in all aspects could appear in this world!
Even their personalities were about sixty or seventy percent similar.

Although their appearances varied in many ways, there were many similarities. The Sword Spirit had a Spiritual Eye that made Ding Ling’s eyes extremely sharp, allowing him to discern subtle differences between twins at a glance.
Not to mention identifying different people!
Therefore.
In others’ eyes, Mu Jianping and Zhong Ling’s facial features were very similar.
But in Ding Ling’s eyes, they were completely different individuals.
Perhaps due to a sense of direction, or perhaps because he hadn’t seen Zhong Ling for so long, subconsciously Ding Ling developed an affection for Mu Jianping.
In any case, he was quite attentive to Mu Jianping.
The two laughed and talked, attracting the curious glances of others.
The next day.
The two were still like this.
Moreover, because of their many conversations.
Mu Jianping learned about Ding Ling’s identity and background, exclaiming several times because of it.
She couldn’t believe that the person she was following was an Alien, what players referred to as the Jade Emperor?!
She circled around Ding Ling, her eyes widening in disbelief:
"Are you really the Jade Emperor of the Immortal Realm’s Celestial Court?!"
"Not anymore."
"What do you mean?"
Mu Jianping looked up at Ding Ling, her bright eyes flashing with confusion and disbelief:
"Surely no one dares to disrespect the Jade Emperor? Dares to knock you down from the Celestial Court?!"
"No."
Ding Ling said with a smile:
"That’s just a divine position given by the Heavenly Dao of the Lower Realm. It didn’t belong to me. Now that I’m in the Upper Realm, the divine position naturally loses its function..."
Ding Ling explained briefly and didn’t say more.
Mu Jianping didn’t ask further, just vaguely nodded:
"I see."
She was very excited and flushed with excitement, murmuring:
"Who would have thought I’d be so lucky! Just casually meeting a Jade Emperor at a tea beach! If my brother and the others find out, won’t they be envious and jealous to death?!"
The more she thought.
The faster her heart raced.
Especially when she glanced at Ding Ling’s handsome face, as chiseled as a knife’s, her heart beat even faster, like a drumming sound!
She couldn’t understand why this was happening.
Yet undeniably, her admiration for Ding Ling increased minute by minute.
An Immortal Realm Emperor of such high status turned out to be someone so kind and easy to talk to!
Truly unexpected!
On this day.
Mu Jianping and Ding Ling traveled to the area around Xiangyang.
Before entering the city.
Rumble! Rumble!
A torrent of Iron Cavalry suddenly surged forward, surrounding Ding Ling and Mu Jianping.
"What do you want?!"
Mu Jianping shouted.
Ding Ling didn’t want to attract too much attention, so he also bought a good horse on the way.
At this moment, he was also riding a horse.
But before he could speak, Mu Jianping already couldn’t help but ride out directly, confronting a General:
"Why surround us for no reason?"
The General didn’t speak.
Just shifted aside.
Along with the sound of clattering iron hooves, a person rode out from the Iron Cavalry procession. This person was dressed in Great Qing official attire, with a hat studded with a ruby.
Looking elegant and wealthy.
Clearly a somewhat cunning young man.
Mu Jianping changed color upon seeing this young man:
"Wei Xiaobao!"

chapters.title: Chapter 824 - 813: Weil Xiaobao
paragraphs: "Miss Mu, you are really hard to find."

Wei Xiaobao looked at Mu Jianping, his eyes flashed with a trace of infatuation. Recently, he had been spending time with Ding Ling, and the frosty look on Mu Jianping’s face had been washed away, making her look increasingly fresh, clear, and beautiful.
A beauty was before him.
Wei Xiaobao’s true nature emerged, and he couldn’t help but rub his hands, smiling as he said:
"Miss Mu, I wore out ten pairs of good shoes looking for you. Do you know that your brother has already agreed to our marriage? I came here to take you back and get married!"
"My brother?"
Mu Jianping’s eyes brightened slightly, and she asked eagerly:
"Where is my brother?"
"Haha..."
Wei Xiaobao pretended to laugh generously and said:
"With me around, your big brother is absolutely safe! Rest assured!"

He made a gesture as if to leap off his horse, but upon hearing Mu Jianping exclaim indignantly ’Don’t talk nonsense, my brother wouldn’t agree to me marrying you!’, he paused and sat back down, grinning shamelessly:
"Young Commandery Princess, you are destined to be my little wife. Just don’t resist."
He waved his hand.
Clatter!
A troop of cavalry charged toward Mu Jianping.
Mu Jianping was flustered and instinctively rode her horse back to Ding Ling’s side, her big bright eyes looking at Ding Ling:
"Brother Ding. I, I..."
"Who is this pretty boy?"

Wei Xiaobao looked at Ding Ling, feeling quite unhappy, scrutinizing him with irritation. The more he looked, the more displeased he became because Ding Ling was brimming with youthful vigor, handsome—truly an extraordinary young man!
Comparing himself, Wei Xiaobao.
It was a stark contrast!
Then seeing Mu Jianping’s affectionate and trusting demeanor toward Ding Ling.
Wei Xiaobao’s anger made his hair stand on end, jealousy surged within him, and he couldn’t help but taunt:

"I’ve long heard reports from my subordinates. They said the Young Commandery Princess is staying with a pretty boy, behaving intimately like a little couple. I didn’t believe it before, but now I’ve seen it. I believe it a bit."
Upon hearing ’like a little couple’, Mu Jianping blushed but didn’t refute, instead she looked at Ding Ling with shy eyes.
Seeing this, Wei Xiaobao became increasingly jealous and furious, a surge of fire rushed into his eyes, and he couldn’t help but point at Ding Ling, shouting angrily:
"Pretty boy, Laozi doesn’t care who you are. If you don’t scram obediently today, I’ll make you suffer!"
"What are you trying to do?"
Mu Jianping chastised:
"Wei Xiaobao, I witnessed your shameless face two years ago! Seeing you today, you’re even more shameless than before! No wonder my senior sisters don’t like you!
"Speaking of your senior sister, she has already become my wife."
Wei Xiaobao was unabashed, instead proudly putting his hands on his hips and laughing:
"Young Commandery Princess, you will soon become my little wife too. Then you and your senior sister can serve me together, and I’ll be sure to show you the might of your husband."
"Shameless!"
"Hee hee."
Wei Xiaobao chuckled:
"Once you marry, I’ll let you experience what is called marital harmony. Then you’ll realize how good your husband is."
Saying this.
He suddenly pulled a long face, glaring at Ding Ling:
"Why haven’t you left yet!"
Ding Ling looked at Wei Xiaobao as if watching a monkey performing on stage.
Regarding Wei Xiaobao, Ding Ling felt neither malice nor favor.
He had watched TV dramas.
Naturally, he knew Wei Xiaobao wasn’t a hero, but he wasn’t exactly a villain either.
However, the man loved women!
To acquire beauties, he would do anything!
For such shameless, despicable behavior, Ding Ling felt contempt.

Especially seeing his current attire and behavior, it was clear he was meddling due to player’s interference, either to stay alive or for beauties, wealth, and power, evidently clinging ever closer to the Great Qing. The kinds of bootlicking, shameless acts committed during this period can only be imagined.
Wei Xiaobao seemed to understand Ding Ling’s eyes and expression, and fury rose from his heart, driving him to boldly shout:
"Arrest him for me!"
He was ready to use Ding Ling to threaten Mu Jianping.
He knew Mu Jianping was pure and naive, easy to fool.

He thought that by threatening and intimidating her, whether she wanted to marry him or not, she would have to; once she was in the bridal chamber, she would be Wei Xiaobao’s, and everything would be easily resolved.
However, he was unaware that he had provoked an extremely fearsome character in Ding Ling.

As a troop of cavalry charged at Ding Ling, but only heard the sounds of piercing through bodies repeatedly resonating by his ears. Wei Xiaobao instinctively looked toward the sound. Upon seeing this, he couldn’t help but twitch his eyelids, face turning pale, as the charging cavalry, both men and mounts, had all fallen to the ground.
On closer inspection.
One could see a small hole on their foreheads.
They were evidently pierced through the forehead and killed by something!
"Gasp!"
Wei Xiaobao inhaled deeply, involuntarily retreating several steps on horseback, retreating into the crowd, before shouting:
"May I know the name of the hero ahead? Are you an Ascender from the Lower Realm or a newly risen Alien?!"
To avoid provoking experts, he almost had people compile a roster of masters, with images, and had looked through them carefully.
He assured himself this Ding Ling’s picture wasn’t among them.
That left only a few possibilities.
Nevertheless, Ding Ling ignored Wei Xiaobao; having killed people, there was no reason to stop?
He spread his fingers.
The Six Meridian Divine Sword pierced through like a machine gun.
Your hearing was filled with the sound of piercing and clashing repeatedly.
Within mere seconds.
Three hundred Iron Cavalry, including Wei Xiaobao, were all dead under the Sword Qi.
Against these Low Martial World people, there was no need to use Martial Dao True Understanding.
Martial Dao True Understanding’s every move amazed heaven and earth, Ding Ling feared a slap would directly pierce through both the ground and Celestial Palace.
Therefore, he used relatively ordinary techniques.
However, Six Meridian Divine Sword to him seemed ordinary, but to these Low Martial World people, it was akin to a bomb sweeping the floor!
A sword qi capable of turning could easily pierce through dozens or hundreds of people.
With a few down.
All these people perished.
’The integration of Six Meridian Sword Qi with Supreme Sword Dao renders the sword qi capable of turning, exceedingly convenient.’
Martial Dao True Understanding is a Divine Skill formed by the fusion of countless Martial Arts.
In the time Ding Ling received the Celestial Heart Mark, he analyzed and remembered the fusion process of each martial art.
This enabled him to freely use various two-way fusions or three-way fusion martial arts.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling called to Mu Jianping.
Mu Jianping stood stunned, her pretty face slightly pale, and upon hearing Ding Ling’s call, she seemed to come back to her senses, her body unconsciously trembled, hastily followed up on horseback:
"Brother Ding, what was that martial art just now?! How could it be so powerful?!"
"Six Meridian Divine Sword? Do you want to learn it?"
"Brother Ding, will you teach me?!"
Mu Jianping was overjoyed.
"If you want to learn, I can certainly teach you."

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - 814: Passing Down Martial Arts
paragraphs: For Ding Ling, the Six Meridian Divine Sword, which merges part of the Supreme Sword Dao’s ideas, can already be considered a new Divine Skill. But even so, compared to the Martial Dao True Understanding, it cannot be regarded as a powerful Divine Skill.
There was no one worthy of being taught by him.
"Then I... I... I want to learn!"
Mu Jianping was both surprised and delighted, but felt it was very inappropriate to receive such a fantastical benefit. Therefore, she was quite anxious and shy:
"I cannot accept Brother Ding’s skill transmission without reason."
Ding Ling didn’t comment but also did not bring up the matter of skill transmission anymore.
Seeing this, Mu Jianping breathed a sigh of relief, but at the same time, her heart surged with various inexplicable feelings.
It was at this moment.
He remembered the eyes and expression of Wei Xiaobao, which were filled with horror and disbelief!
Holding the position of a First-Grade Official in the court, Grand General of the Far East!
He just died like that?!
Mu Jianping looked at Ding Ling with three parts of awe.
It was at this moment she finally realized why Ding Ling could become the first among the group of aliens, why he could become the Jade Emperor.
As an Immortal Realm Emperor, Ding Ling’s decisiveness and ruthlessness was naturally extraordinary.
Looking at him from an ordinary person’s perspective is certainly incorrect.
However, Mu Jianping’s admiration and acknowledgment of Ding Ling did not diminish because Ding Ling had always been gentlemanly and very courteous to others.
Never putting on airs.
Wei Xiaobao was simply unlucky to have run into a gun!
Thinking this way, Mu Jianping sped up to catch up with Ding Ling.
As for Wei Xiaobao?
He had many thoughts just before he died.
Mostly fear of Ding Ling:
’Who on earth is this guy?! Killing without batting an eye! And he kills so fast, not even giving me a chance or leeway to use my eloquence!’
Wei Xiaobao was instinctively frightened, scared, and cowardly when Ding Ling killed a squad of cavalry!
He immediately changed how he addressed Ding Ling to Hero.
The instinct and adaptability were impressive.
Normally, when martial arts experts see a First-Grade Official being so respectful, they might pause for a moment and listen to Wei Xiaobao’s argument.
But what kind of person is Ding Ling?
Once he has murderous intentions, it’s very hard to take them back.

Wei Xiaobao could never have imagined that he’d be killed by Ding Ling in an instant, he who was Lord Wei, a general of the Great Qing! The person most skilled in eloquence didn’t even have the chance to say a few extra words and died miserably on the spot!
"Should’ve just brought a few aliens around me. They’d certainly recognize that damned guy!"

Because Wei Xiaobao was apprehensive about the all-knowing and formidable aliens, he had never relied on them as confidants even though he recruited many such subordinates. This time, he went out to flirt and capture Mu Jianping to be his little wife, so he eagerly did not bring alien followers.
But he unexpectedly tripped and fell hard:
"My wives. Now I don’t know which scoundrel will get the benefit!"
Wei Xiaobao’s eyes, watching Ding Ling and Mu Jianping’s distant backs, never closed.
His soul and thoughts slowly withered away.
Ding Ling did not go to Xiangyang.
Killing Wei Xiaobao and then going to Xiangyang is like openly opposing the Great Qing, isn’t it?
Ding Ling was unafraid, but he preferred less hassle than more; he didn’t want to stir up any more trouble.
He only wished to read some books, then leave this world.
With the addition of a friend, Mu Jianping.
Thus, Ding Ling could not just walk away easily.
About Mu Jianping, initially Ding Ling had no thoughts, but after interacting for some time, the two became friends, and naturally Ding Ling had no intention to abandon her.
In life, there’s a beginning and an end, and things should be dealt with clearly.
That’s Ding Ling’s way of conduct.
Therefore.
They left Xiangyang City, found a village, and settled there. Ding Ling said to Mu Jianping:

"I can’t stay in this world for long. I’m afraid I will leave soon. If you want to learn martial arts, I can teach you some now. In the future, when you’ve learned well, you won’t have to fear others bullying you."
"Brother Ding."
Mu Jianping was startled:
"You’re leaving soon? Where are you going?! Can’t you take me with you?"
"I’m going to the Upper Realm."
"Upper Realm?"
Mu Jianping thought of the Celestial Ladder outside Chang’an City, and her expression turned gloomy:
"You are the Immortal Realm Emperor, the hero praised by everyone. I, a mere woman, cannot compare at all."
At this point.
She paused, forced a smile, and said:
"If I achieve excellence, will I be able to find you in the Upper Realm in the future?"
"If you study earnestly, perhaps fate will bring us together again."
Ding Ling said:
"Do you want to learn?"
"I do!
"Good. Sit down."
To save time.
Ding Ling directly chose the Empowerment Method.
This technique is a unique method formed by integrating multiple Divine Skills such as North Nether Divine Skill, Holy Heart Technique, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, and several others.
It can very easily unblock a person’s Eight Extraordinary Meridians.
This is a method Ding Ling has figured out during the past two years in the Three Kingdoms by using the Celestial Heart Mark and observing the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Very practical.
As Ding Ling waved his hand, Mu Jianping, who was sitting cross-legged, involuntarily rose into the air, with her whole body inverted above Ding Ling’s head.
Their heads were connected.

Ding Ling recited the mantra of the fused Techniques of Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, and North Nether Divine Skill, while simultaneously channeling a Martial Arts True Qi into Mu Jianping’s Baihui Point!
Boom!
Martial Arts True Qi surged into Mu Jianping’s meridians like a mighty Celestial River, quickly and roughly unblocking one meridian after another!
This Martial Arts True Qi has the effect of repair.
Even if injury occurs in the meridians due to the rough unblocking process, it swiftly repairs them and enhances the meridians to be more resilient and powerful during the repair.
In just a moment.
Mu Jianping’s Eight Extraordinary Meridians were all unblocked!
As the True Qi spiraled into Mu Jianping’s Dantian and split into weaker versions of Muscle-Tendon Changing True Qi and North Nether True Qi.
Her cultivation level rose significantly.
In just a little while.
She reached the Innate Realm!
At this point.
Progressing further.
Was entirely up to Mu Jianping.
So Ding Ling waved his hand, and Mu Jianping descended from above his head, spun in mid-air, and landed again in front of him.
"How is it? Did you remember the energy circulation route?"
"I remembered it."

Mu Jianping, of uncommon talent and intelligence, although somewhat naive, had a clear advantage in learning martial arts. At this moment, she looked at Ding Ling with a face full of gratitude and admiration:
"Thank you, Brother Ding."
The favor of skill transmission.
Greater than the heavens!
Mu Jianping, for a moment, didn’t know how to repay or reciprocate Ding Ling, but could only keep this favor in her heart, thinking, ’Brother Ding is so good to me. I must repay him someday!’
Looking at her expression and demeanor.
Clearly at this moment, no matter what Ding Ling asked her to do, she probably wouldn’t refuse!

But even so, compared to the Martial Dao True Understanding, it cannot be regarded as a powerful Divine Skill.
There was no one worthy of being taught by him.
"Then I...
I want to learn!"
Mu Jianping was both surprised and delighted, but felt it was very inappropriate to receive such a fantastical benefit.

"I cannot accept Brother Ding’s skill transmission without reason."

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - 815: Mao Shiba
paragraphs: Ding Ling again had Mu Jianping remember the Divine Skill Mantra, and afterward, he taught Mu Jianping the Flying Swallow Technique, Ascending Skill, and other simple and easy-to-understand lightweight skills.
And so it went.
Half a day passed.
Mu Jianping continuously practiced lightweight skills, body technique, sword technique, and palm technique.
Surprisingly, she did it quite well.
Though most were not at the entry level, she only grasped the general ’form’ without its essence, being able to remember the moves and mantras in half a day was indeed impressive.
Ding Ling couldn’t expect more.
"How was it, Brother Ding?"
Having finished practicing Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, Mu Jianping breathlessly ran to Ding Ling, with her bright eyes fixed on him.
Within them, admiration, respect, and fondness nearly overflowed.
Ding Ling understood but didn’t mention it, simply nodding with a smile:
"Not bad. Continue to practice diligently. Someday you will reach the summit without doubt."

The inner power heart method Mu Jianping was cultivating comprised a fusion of multiple top divine skills such as Holy Heart Technique, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, and North Nether Divine Skill, which was extraordinary, allowing progress all the way to the Martial Arts Golden Core Realm!
Moreover, she now possesses innate level abilities; in this low martial world, claiming invincibility is not far off.

Of course, that was in the past. With the three major historical planes of the lower realm connected, all warriors can cultivate in the Immortal Realm. It is foreseeable that low martial worlds like The Deer and the Cauldron will completely collapse.
If one doesn’t encounter formidable opponents, it’s alright.
But if they meet a strong one,
Any dynasty would be destroyed.
Ding Ling, with a clear mind, communicated with Mu Jianping for a while, then lifted his foot to leave.
Mu Jianping followed Ding Ling step by step, gazing at him with her big, watery eyes:
"Brother Ding, can I follow you? I want to personally escort you to the Celestial Ladder."
Ding Ling thought for a moment and agreed.
"Thank you, Brother Ding."
Mu Jianping was very grateful.
She already felt liking during the time spent together with Ding Ling, and his revelation of identity and sharing his skills elevated this goodwill and fondness to a new level!
She couldn’t quite understand what it was.
But she knew one thing, which was that just being with Ding Ling brought her joy and elation.
She had never felt like this before.
But now she deeply felt it.
"Mu Jianping!"

As Ding Ling and Mu Jianping just led the horse out of the village entrance, hundreds of people quickly appeared ahead. The leader had a rugged face and a sturdy figure, holding a single knife, glaring fiercely at Ding Ling:
"Did you kill Lord Weil?!"
"Mao Shiba!
Mu Jianping’s expression slightly changed.
"Hahaha..."
Mao Shiba laughed up at the sky three times, then declared, ’It’s me, your grandpa!’ With a wave of his hand, hundreds surrounded Ding Ling and Mu Jianping:
"Don’t think about resisting. Behind me, there are thousands more cavalry troops. You two won’t escape this time!"
"Do you know who you’re messing with?"
Mu Jianping warned.
"Grandpa doesn’t care to know!"
Mao Shiba retorted with thick brows and eyes, strong and loud:
"You killed Lord Weil, thus are traitors, deserving death!"
"Even you joined the Qing Court?!"
"Grandpa only follows one person—that’s Lord Weil!"
Mao Shiba drew the single knife from his hand, blade aimed at Ding Ling and Mu Jianping:

"Young Commandery Princess, and this pretty boy, I don’t know what means you used to kill Lord Weil. But grandpa owes several lives to Lord Weil, and today is going all out. Even in death, I will stop you!"
"You can’t stop us!"
Mu Jianping advised: "You better leave."
"That’s not certain."
Mao Shiba laughed:
"Grandpa doesn’t need to fight to the death with you. Just needs to delay you for a moment! Soon the Great Qing’s soldiers will arrive, and you’re definitely doomed!"
As if in response to Mao Shiba’s words,
His voice had just fallen when one heard the thundering sound of iron hooves approaching from afar, earth-shattering and loudly shaking the ground.
One listen says those cavalry arriving must number in thousands.
Mu Jianping’s face turned slightly pale, and she couldn’t help looking at Ding Ling. Seeing him expressionless, her heart felt vastly more reassured, though also mourning for Mao Shiba and his men.
She had said what she needed to say. Saying further would be useless.
So she spoke no more and withdrew behind Ding Ling.
As the Immortal Realm Emperor, known as the number one by players, an unparalleled divine being! How could trivial cavalry forces deal with him?

Mu Jianping, despite being naïve, had spent considerable time engaging with aliens, naturally hearing much about Ding Ling’s exploits. Her admiration and respect for Ding Ling are etched in her bones.
This acquaintance and mutual recognition as friends further raised this admiration and respect to a new height!
Thus, she worried not about Ding Ling’s safety, only considering that in a little while, blood might flow again, somewhat not wanting it to happen.
But what was Ding Ling’s character?
She had perceived it quite well, afraid Ding Ling might dislike her urging too much, she remained anxious and at a loss, standing still.

Mao Shiba misunderstood, thinking Mu Jianping feared, thus trembled, making his heart more assured, convinced that Ding Ling and Mu Jianping murdered Weil Xiaobao with treacherous means, harboring homicidal intent with verbal hostility:
"Pretty boy, how did you kill Lord Weil?!"
His curiosity was piqued.
More so, malice:
"If you refuse to speak, bear in mind, I’ll have you torn to pieces!"
Ding Ling glanced at Mao Shiba:
"You’re quite the talker."
Buzz!
A sword intent shot from Ding Ling’s eyes, striking Mao Shiba. In the next instant, Mao Shiba’s tall, mighty body fell straight down.
"Commander!"
The other hundreds exclaimed.
Ding Ling waved his hand, a sword qi twirling with his finger, transforming into a streak in the void. In the next instant, the hundred all lay dead.
Mu Jianping’s heartstrings quivered.
Though she had known of Ding Ling’s strength, this time, slightly provoked, the swiftness of his killings was even greater!
Rumble!
The cavalry torrent surged forth.
A quick glance revealed no less than ten thousand.
Leading them was a person with a red-topped crown, armor-clad, beneath whose chin three strands of white beard floated — clearly a distinguished old general.
"Feng Xifan!"
Mu Jianping called out.
"Young Commandery Princess!"
Feng Xifan glanced at the corpses strewn across the ground, slightly raised his brows, and directly at Ding Ling, expressed considerable wariness:
"Was it you who killed Lord Weil, Mao Shiba?"
"So what if it was?"
Ding Ling responded indifferently:
"Is the Great Qing going to oppose me for Weil Xiaobao?"
When Ding Ling killed Weil Xiaobao, the commotion wasn’t much, but many witnessed it since the site wasn’t far from Xiangyang City.
Ding Ling didn’t believe no one recognized him. If they did, still choosing to oppose, isn’t that foolish?
Yet recalling Mao Shiba’s expression and demeanor.
Ding Ling felt unsure again.

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - 816: Fengh Xifan
paragraphs: Mao Shiba recognized Mu Jianping, but did not recognize him.
This seems a bit illogical.
Unless there aren’t many players in Xiangyang City, or no players saw him kill Weil Xiaobao at the time!
If indeed no players witnessed it.
That can only mean that the number of players staying in The Deer and the Cauldron World has dwindled to a certain realm!
But thinking about it, it seems understandable.
Players in the Historical Plane would stay and not leave, having cultivated for many years, it would not be worth it to leave.

But players in the Martial Hero Plane are different, as the duration is relatively shorter, and they practice the same lineage of Inner Power Heart Method as in the Upper Realm, naturally, it’s easy to understand they would move to a better cultivation environment with higher cultivation limits in the Upper Realm Plane.
Once Ding Ling figured it out, he felt relieved.
Yet, Fengh Xifan opposite him was clueless, even more unaware of where Ding Ling’s confidence came from.
After a moment of surprise, he laughed in exasperation:
"Hahaha... Who do you think you are?! How dare you utter such arrogant words!"
His eyebrows stood straight like blades:

"Lord Weil is such an important person! Even though I look down on him! But it cannot be denied that he is the favored one beside the current Holy Emperor! You’ve killed Lord Weil, do you think you can still stand in this world? If you are sensible, bind yourself and come back to the Capital City with me! Otherwise, you’ll have nothing good to eat!"
Fengh Xifan threw a rope on the ground, signaling Ding Ling to bind himself.
Ding Ling sighed.
He originally thought with player assistance, the Great Qing’s information would be extremely well-informed, and upon knowing his true identity, would choose to downplay the matter voluntarily.
After all, he actively chose to detour around Xiangyang!
If the Great Qing knew his true identity and saw his actions, they would naturally be sensible enough not to pursue it further.
But he ultimately overestimated the Great Qing’s information channels.
All said and done.
There were too many players with high cultivation like Ding Ling, already somewhat disconnected from reality.
Consider.
He hadn’t gone online in the real world for years, the reason being he was no longer afraid of nuclear threats, so did he need to care about how players viewed or discussed him?
If really provoked, would he just go directly to confront them?
Who could possibly do anything to him?

Because of such confidence, Ding Ling spent years focusing on cultivating with Diao Chan and others, not investigating the real-world network, and naturally had no idea that in Low Martial Worlds like The Deer and the Cauldron or Green Blood Sword, there were very few players.

Most of the old players were either in the Historical Plane or had moved to higher-level Planes such as Divine Eagle, Romantic Swordsman, Celestial Dragon, The Generation’s Twin Heroes, Fengyun, etc.!
New players, needless to say, would choose Planes like Fengyun where there were more and stronger Martial Arts Heart Methods.
This resulted in a severe player exodus in worlds like The Deer and the Cauldron.
Only places like the Capital, Chang’an, and Luoyang had some players.
Even in a big city like Xiangyang, there weren’t many players left.
The reason no players witnessed Ding Ling killing Weil Xiaobao was also due to this.

But Ding Ling only had vague suspicions about this, so when he saw Fengh Xifan’s intent to kill unabated, he also lost his patience, and once the killing intent arose, it could no longer be retracted.
Bang!
Ding Ling casually slapped forward, and with a loud bang, Fengh Xifan with his horse was knocked over a hundred zhang away, along the way crashing into and killing many cavalry!
The force of one slap forcibly cleared a wide avenue!
Until death.
Fengh Xifan was still shocked, bewildered, and in disbelief!
"A pretty boy! How can his skills be so terrifying! Just one slap, and he knocked me helplessly flying away!"
After flying a hundred zhang away, Fengh Xifan fell to the ground, all his bones shattered.
Even the hardest skull was cracked!
His eyes bulged wide open, yet he died with everlasting regret!
Only one thought kept swirling in his mind:

"Who exactly is this pretty boy! Such terrifying Martial Power! Not like a human at all! Simply comparable to deities descending to the Mortal Realm! The Great Qing is doomed having provoked such a person!"
He felt very frustrated and regretful.
At this moment.
He suddenly somewhat understood Ding Ling’s words.
For the sake of someone like Weil Xiaobao, there was totally no need to oppose such a terrifying master!
Just because such a master could easily be one man defending a nation!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Once Ding Ling made a move, he wouldn’t stop. With his bare hands, he continuously slapped forward, streams of Dragon-Subduing Qi Force spiraled forward!
Roar!
Dragon roars sounded, where the Qi Force passed, people and horses flipped over, and blood flowed like a river!
In just a moment.
Over ten thousand men and horses perished!
The ground was stained with blood!
All the fierce horses collapsed dead.
"Gulp."

Mu Jianping was dumbfounded, looking at Ding Ling with wide eyes, she couldn’t help but swallow nervously, but soon, she came to her senses, this was her Brother Ding, and she blushed slightly, saying somewhat anxiously:
"Brother Ding, I, I...
"Alright. Let’s go."
Ding Ling grabbed Mu Jianping, leaping with a motion that seemed like Star Shifting and more like Qiankun Great Shift, in the next moment, the two were already atop a mountain three hundred li away.
Standing here, they looked into the distance.
The mountains and rivers were vast, all life competing freely under the frosty sky!
No longer could they smell the bloody scent from before.
Mu Jianping’s Heart and Spirit relaxed all at once, her whole body calming down from a tense state, she felt a bit embarrassed.
Ding Ling, however, was indifferent, comforting:
"In times of great strife, killing is a very common thing, you must get used to facing bloodshed, and even more used to killing. Otherwise, if I’m gone. You might never see me again."
"No."
Mu Jianping tensed up immediately:
"I must see Brother Ding again!"
"If you want to see me again. You need to learn to adapt to bloodshed and killing. Can you do it?"
"This, I, this..."
"I won’t force you."
Ding Ling looked into the distance, at this moment the sun began to set in the west, the afterglow spread over the land, draping the mountains and rivers in a slightly melancholic sunset:
"I’m heading to the Capital now. Will you continue to follow or part ways with me here?"
"I want to follow you."
Mu Jianping mustered up the courage to say:
"Brother Ding, I will try my best."
She had been wandering the Jianghu for months.
She naturally understood the hard-to-judge nature of human hearts.
But quickly adapting to bloodshed and killing was also very challenging.
Ding Ling naturally knew the intricacies, nodded slightly, grasped her shoulder, and with another step, in an instant, they moved hundreds of li again.

The mountains and rivers, waterfalls, flashed by beneath their feet, Mu Jianping watched until her eyes blurred, shock waves surged endlessly in her heart, her understanding and admiration for Ding Ling elevated to another level at that moment.
Only then did she truly realize why Ding Ling was the Immortal Realm Emperor. Why he was revered and lauded as the world’s number one by countless people!
Such speed, methods, Divine Techniques.
Like nothing she had ever heard or seen!
From the start of their flight, Mu Jianping’s heart could no longer remain calm.

chapters.title: Chapter 828 817: Royal Library
paragraphs: Whoosh!
A flow of light streaked across Celestial Extreme, and the next moment, it landed in the back garden of the Capital Imperial Court.

Ding Ling's eyes were like electricity, and the Divine Meditation Technique illuminated the Ten Directions Realm, casting a clear three-dimensional image within the Sea of Consciousness over a hundred-mile radius. This made Ding Ling instantly aware of where the crowds gathered and the location of the library.
"The Divine Meditation Technique can be used here too. It's just not as effective as in the Lower Realm."
Using this technique in the Lower Realm.
In an instant, it reflected a clear image over a radius of twenty thousand miles!
With the Celestial Heart Mark added, the range and clarity climbed even further.
But upon arriving in this world.
The Divine Meditation Technique could only reflect a radius of a thousand miles.
The visual extent dropped drastically.
Ding Ling estimated it might be related to the Heavenly Dao and the stability of Heaven and Earth.
This Divine Meditation Technique might have been born for the Netherworld and the Historical Plane.

Or perhaps it's because he's not strong enough now, so the efficacy of the Divine Meditation Technique is declining. If he becomes strong enough, its effects might again expand to a range of tens of thousands of miles.

"The Deer and the Cauldron World is like this. Going to sturdier worlds like Divine Eagle or Celestial Dragon, the effectiveness of the Divine Meditation Technique is likely to decrease significantly."
Ding Ling's heart was as clear as a mirror, and he thought no more.
The Divine Meditation Technique was exceptional, and Ding Ling was very surprised when he first obtained this technique, simply because it was so useful.
The same goes now; using this technique, he locked onto the destination in an instant.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling grabbed Mu Jianping and disappeared from the back garden in a flash, appearing the next moment in the Royal Library.
This library was large.
It housed innumerable books.
There were over a dozen guards, all of whom Ding Ling pointed and flipped over to the ground with a flick of his finger.
Ding Ling fell before a bookshelf and began to read.

Mu Jianping dutifully guarded the entrance, her wide, sparkling eyes round with tension, giving her the look of a nervous thief keeping watch for her compatriots, as though her tension was penetrating to her very bones!
She seemed to momentarily forget that the person behind her was the Immortal Realm Emperor, a supreme entity capable of wiping out ten thousand cavalry at will.
Rustle!
For a moment.
Only the sound of flipping pages and Mu Jianping's slightly heavy breathing filled the Royal Library.
[Broken Gate Saber Technique Full Level]
This was a Secret Manual Mao Shiba offered to Weil Xiaobao.
It was presented by Weil Xiaobao to the current Qing Court.
But at the end of the Secret Manual, Ding Ling saw a detailed account of the origin of this technique.
[Wudang Grand Grappling Hand Full Level]
[Five Cloud Hand Full Level]
[Breakthrough Technique Full Level]
One martial art after another at Full Level.
Many were deliberately collected by the Great Qing in the past few years for the Royal Library.
Clearly, today's Emperor Kangxi understood the importance of a Martial Arts Expert to the Qing Court.
So it made perfect sense for him to deliberately collect martial arts to nurture elite Royal experts.
But these collected Martial Arts Heart Methods.
To Ding Ling, they were merely a way to enrich his foundation, nourishment to upgrade his Martial Dao True Understanding to version 2.0.
He knew far too many Divine Skills.
These martial arts were excellent for most people, but to him, they were merely average.
Rustle!

Ding Ling scanned thousands of lines with each glance, flipping through the books at an incredible speed. Eventually, he would move with just a thought, causing books to fly from the shelves and start flipping automatically.
It was Ding Ling utilizing the Wind Summoning Skill and Divine Meditation Technique, among other techniques, to assist his reading.
Truth be told.
This way of reading.
Boosted his efficiency by a hundredfold or more!
Any Secret Manual reflected in the Sea of Consciousness by the Divine Meditation Technique could be Full Level in an instant.
Therefore, Ding Ling was now looking at one bookshelf after another.
Compared to reading book by book, his efficiency had greatly improved!
Mu Jianping occasionally glanced back at these scenes, marveling, astounded, thinking to herself:
"Brother Ding is truly remarkable. Can you really read books this way? No wonder he's the Immortal Realm Emperor!"
She could not at all fathom Ding Ling's methods.
Nor did she understand if reading like this was effective?
But this didn't hinder her admiration for Ding Ling.
Rustle!
[Exotic Three Talents Saber Full Level]
[Small Capturing Hand Full Level]
[One Finger Zen Full Level]
From Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting to books on medicine, Confucianism, Buddhism, and Daoism.
Ding Ling read through them all.
[Buddha Qi +1]
[Vast Righteous Qi +1]
The Vast Righteous Qi finally accumulated and once again grew.
Totaling four in all.
Each additional Vast Righteous Qi slightly enhanced Ding Ling's heart's Defense capability.
His aura also became increasingly steady and gentle.
Should the Vast Righteous Qi be fully activated.
He'd definitely become a graceful young scholar, brimming with scholarly aura!
Rustle!
Ding Ling continued to browse through the books for half a day.
The entire Royal Library, with no less than a million volumes, was read by him.
Two years prior, in the Wind and Cloud World, he would've taken days to read such a large amount.
But now, in less than half a day, he was done.
The level of efficiency enhancement speaks volumes.
"Time to leave."
Ding Ling suddenly appeared by Mu Jianping's side and said softly.
"Ah."
Mu Jianping had been staring ahead, suddenly startled by his words, but she quickly regained her composure and smiled slightly, albeit awkwardly:
"Oh, it's Brother Ding. I was just too nervous."
"Understandable."
Ding Ling chuckled as he placed a hand on her shoulder:
"Hold tight."
"Uh-huh."
Mu Jianping nodded like a pecking chick, eager to leave this place making her feel oppressed.
She had been tense for several hours watching for Ding Ling, and she couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief as they finally left.
Whoosh!
In an instant, Ding Ling appeared in the sky above the Capital, with the Divine Meditation Technique illuminating the Ten Directions Realm.
Soon.
Ding Ling located Weil Xiaobao's Marquis of Luding's Mansion, seeing several stunning beauties within.
In the mansion's depths.
He also saw several imprisoned individuals.
Young and old alike.
Ding Ling inquired about Mu Jianping's brother's appearance.
Mu Jianping described him.
Understanding, Ding Ling took hold of Mu Jianping, and in a flash, appeared before a courtyard deep in the Marquis of Luding's Mansion.
Here, several Qing Soldiers stood guard.
With a flick of his finger, Ding Ling sent them sprawling to the ground.
Ding Ling led Mu Jianping into the courtyard and pointed at a lock, breaking a chain. Whoosh! A gust of wind blew, opening the tightly locked door, revealing the space inside.
Mu Jianping focused her gaze and, upon seeing a familiar face, exclaimed joyfully:
"Brother!"
"Little sister."
A handsome young man stared at Mu Jianping in shock:
"How did you also get caught?!"
"I wasn't caught."
Mu Jianping hurried over to free the young man's restraints:
"Brother Ding brought me to rescue you."
"Brother Ding?"
The young man, naturally Mu Jiansheng, heard this and became even more bewildered.
Mu Jianping pointed to Ding Ling and spoke fluently, saying a lot, leaving Mu Jiansheng more and more astounded until, later, his legs weakened, nearly kneeling to Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 818: Ake
paragraphs: Da da!
Just as Mu Jianping and Mu Jiansheng were reminiscing, they seemed to hear a commotion in the backyard. Several stunningly beautiful women arrived with a squad of soldiers.

The leading woman was as exquisite as jade, elegant and captivating, outshining pearls set in white jade, more beautiful than a freshly bloomed rose. Descriptors like ’stunning beauty’ and ’unparalleled elegance’ fit her perfectly.
Her beauty was comparable only to that of Diao Chan and the Little Dragon Girl.
However, compared to Diao Chan and the Little Dragon Girl, her aura was much inferior.
Beside and behind her stood four other women, each with distinct features but all extraordinarily beautiful.
One particularly dazzling woman stepped forward, calling out "Young Commandery Princess!"
Mu Jianping shuddered, turned around, and upon seeing the woman, her face lit up with joy, and she chirpily exclaimed:
"Senior Sister!"
"Why are you here?"
The senior sister was Fang Yi, who glanced at Ding Ling with a different expression before turning back to Mu Jianping:
"The defenses of this mansion are so strict, like a fortress. No one can just come in. How did you and this person..."
She pointed to Ding Ling:
"How did you get in?"
Not only was she curious.
Everyone was curious.
Judging by their expressions.
Evidently, they were still unaware of Wail Xiaobao’s death.
But calculating the time, they should soon find out about Wail Xiaobao’s demise.
Mu Jianping initially was in the dark, but with Fang Yi’s words, she quickly caught on, letting out a dry laugh before asking:
’Senior Sister, did you really marry Wail Xiaobao?’
Fang Yi blushed, responding with silence.
Mu Jianping was incredulous:
"You know Wail Xiaobao’s nature; you even know he was always coercing and threatening you. How could you marry him?"
"This isn’t something that can be explained in a few words."
Fang Yi gave a bitter smile:
"In short, I had my reasons."
She paused and added:
"Moreover, Xiaobao isn’t bad; he’s deeply affectionate to me. I’m pregnant with his child and intend to serve him for life."
"You’re pregnant with his child."
Mu Jianping was utterly stunned:
"So soon?!"
Fang Yi, embarrassed, seemingly unwilling to dwell on the topic, turned to ask:
"You still haven’t answered me, how did you and this person enter the Marquis of Luding’s Mansion?"
"We flew in.
Mu Jianping replied succinctly, as if uninterested in elaborating:
"He is my Brother Ding. Senior Sister, you should also call him Brother Ding."
"Brother Ding?"
Fang Yi sized up Ding Ling, her eyes carrying a hint of suspicion:
"The Young Commandery Princess is so naive and pure. Surely you’re not deceiving her, using some trick to enter this mansion?"
Ding Ling didn’t respond to Fang Yi, but instead looked at Mu Jianping:
"You’ve found your brother and senior sister. We shall part ways now."
"No."
Mu Jianping immediately took Mu Jiansheng by the hand, and stood beside Ding Ling, her large eyes blinking as she chirpily said:
"Brother Ding, I want to see you off one last time."
"What about your brother?"
"He will come with me."
Mu Jianping turned to Mu Jiansheng:
’Brother, what do you say?’
"Yes, yes."
Mu Jiansheng agreed repeatedly, recalling Mu Jianping’s words to him, looking at Ding Ling with reverence and awe, unable to voice any opposition.
"If that’s so. Let’s go."
Ding Ling grabbed them both, ready to leave.
"You cannot go!"
The leading woman snapped sternly:
"Intruding into the Marquis of Luding’s Mansion, how can you come and go as you please."
Fang Yi remained silent, her expressionless gaze on Ding Ling, her eyes deep and unfathomable.
Crash!
A group of Qing Soldiers rushed forward, seemingly to apprehend Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s brows raised slightly as he cast his gaze over.
Bam bam bam!
The next moment, the Qing Soldiers seemed struck by lightning, their eyes turning vacant and lifeless, collapsing onto the ground, motionless, yet all dead.
The leading woman, Fang Yi, and others, were shocked beyond words:
"How is this possible?!"
Upon looking again.
They saw Ding Ling grabbing Mu Jianping and Mu Jiansheng, instantly vanished into thin air, leaving no trace.
They exchanged glances, each clearly seeing the fear in others’ eyes.
"Who is this young man really?! To possess such earth-shattering cultivation?!"
"Vanishing without a trace! Such speed is terrifying!"
"No wonder the Young Commandery Princess said she flew here! I thought she was kidding, but she was actually telling the truth!"
Fang Yi and the others were shaken to the core, unable to calm down for a long time.
They approached and carefully inspected the Qing Soldiers.
They found no injuries on them, their breathing normal.
But no matter how they called, there was no response, as if they had become the living dead!
"One glance turned hundreds of elite guards into the living dead! This young man is absolutely extraordinary! Go, find two of the Aliens to inquire."
Even in the Marquis of Luding’s Mansion, there were Aliens acting as advisors.
After Fang Yi and the others urgently sought them out, the Aliens, who were players, asked them to describe Ding Ling’s appearance.
They vividly recounted in detail.
After listening, the players also found themselves speechless.
"Judging from your reactions, you know who it is?"

The leading stunning woman, Ake, the daughter of Li Zicheng and Chen Yuanyuan, trapped and impregnated by Wail Xiaobao, had given birth to a son, thus becoming a main wife at the Marquis of Luding’s Mansion.
Usually, her words carried authority due to the love and indulgence Wail Xiaobao showered upon her.
"Yes, Madam."
The players replied:
"If our guesses are correct, that beautiful young man should be none other than the legendary World’s Number One, Ding Ling!"
"Ding Ling?!"
Ake’s pupils contracted tightly:
"The Immortal Realm Emperor of the Historical Plane?! The founding emperor of several worlds like Fengyun?!"
Clearly.
Ake and the other women had heard plenty about Ding Ling’s tales from players.
"It is him!"
The players responded gravely:
"Ladies, this person is exceedingly lethal. It’s best not to provoke him under any circumstances!"
Fang Yi, Ake, and several women exchanged glances, seeing the relief in one another’s eyes.
If it truly was the legendary Ding Ling!
Provoking this person.
The Marquis of Luding’s Mansion would surely be bathed in blood!
They had often heard tales of Ding Ling, who would topple armies of a hundred thousand or a million with terrifying killing intent and a body count beyond their wildest imagination!
As they were feeling fortunate, suddenly a servant arrived with a Pigeon Post.
"Madam, there’s urgent news from Xiangyang."
"Oh?"
Ake received the letter, opened it, and with just a glance, she couldn’t help but black out, nearly fainting.
"What happened?"
Fang Yi moved in to read the letter.
Understanding swept over her.
A tremor seized her heart as well.
