chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 819: Princess Jianning
paragraphs: It’s hard to say whether it’s pain or reluctance.
Fang Yi’s heart is a mixture of complex emotions.
To say she really likes Weil Xiaobao, it’s not quite true. If she hadn’t been carrying Weil Xiaobao’s child, she would never agree to be his wife.
But at the very least, nominally, she is Weil Xiaobao’s wife.
Weil Xiaobao was killed by Ding Ling, the Immortal Realm Emperor.
What should she do?
Instinctively, Fang Yi chose to give up revenge.
Even when Shuang’Er angrily proposed to gather the forces of Marquis of Luding’s Mansion to deal with Ding Ling, Fang Yi couldn’t help but pour cold water on the idea, saying coldly:
"Are you sure you’re not just delivering yourself to death?"
She touched her belly and said:
"If you anger Ding Ling, the Great Emperor, everyone in Marquis of Luding’s Mansion will die. Do you want to watch Xiaobao’s unborn children die tragically?!"
Shuang’Er’s anger was immediately extinguished by this cold bucket of water, leaving her despondent, standing still.
Beside Shuang’Er, a petite and feisty young girl looked proudly defiant, her eyes unmistakably conveying arrogance and rebelliousness. After understanding, she said furiously:
"This matter definitely can’t be over just like this."
"Heh."
Fang Yi glanced at the girl, seeing it was Princess Jianning, and thought of Emperor Kangxi behind her. Fang Yi coldly smiled to herself but did not retort.
She could provoke Shuang’Er.
But she didn’t want to provoke Princess Jianning.
"Ake, what do you think?"
Princess Jianning looked towards Ake.
Ake sighed long:
"Fang Yi is right, we can’t afford to provoke Ding Ling."
"I am a princess; I will have my brother deal with Ding Ling!"
Princess Jianning was unwilling to give up easily.
Ake said:
"Now everyone knows you are the daughter of the false Empress Dowager’s illicit union. Are you sure Emperor Kangxi would offend a terrifying figure like Ding Ling for you?"
Upon hearing these words, Princess Jianning wilted instantly, anxiously pacing in place:
"What to do? Xiaobao is dead just like that; I don’t want him to die!"
Tears welled in Shuang’Er’s eyes, biting her lip, her delicate face alternating between pale and blue, clearly her inner world was in turmoil!
"I want to leave Marquis of Luding’s Mansion."
Fang Yi suddenly spoke:
"Before I leave, let’s divide the mansion’s wealth."
"What do you mean by this?!"
Princess Jianning rebuked with displeasure:
"Are you trying to split up the family?!"

"Now that Xiaobao is gone, do you think Marquis of Luding’s Mansion can last long? Emperor Kangxi won’t support a group of idle people. Preparing for the future and raising Xiaobao’s children is the important thing. Ake, Shuang’Er, Zeng Rou, what do you think?
Fang Yi looked at the three women.
Shuang’Er said nothing.
Zeng Rou wiped her tears, nodded and said:
"Okay. Fang Yi, I’ll accompany you to raise Xiaobao’s children."
"If that’s the case, let’s split the family."

Ake saw the hearts disperse, realizing she as the main wife would be unworthy of the position, living together would only lead to daily strife, chaos, and disorder, so it would be better to split the family decisively.
The players watching beside were stunned.
But knowing Fang Yi as a refined egoist made them relieved.
Fang Yi is realistic, hypocritical, power-seeking, and cold-hearted.
Choosing to protect herself first, then to split the family is entirely normal.
But since Weil Xiaobao is dead, and the wives have dispersed.
Naturally, these players had no reason to continue serving the wives and immediately scattered.
Of course.
Before dispersing, obtaining some necessary benefits was essential, so they rushed towards the mansion’s treasury.
Ding Ling was unaware of all this.
Even if he knew, he probably wouldn’t think much of it.
He wouldn’t pursue a woman just for her beauty, so throughout, Ding Ling didn’t glance at Ake, Fang Yi, or others.
The only thing he cared about in this world was his friend Mu Jianping.
Fortunately, he passed on his Divine Skill to her, as long as she practiced diligently, when fate arrives, naturally they would meet again.
Swoosh!
Ding Ling grabbed Mu Jianping and Mu Jiansheng, leaping through the void like a streaking meteor, covering hundreds of miles in moments, reaching outside Chang’an City in a few breaths.
Stood there, one could see the Celestial Ladder reaching up to the clouds.
Ding Ling released his grip.
Mu Jiansheng quickly touched himself in shock, confirming he was unharmed, and couldn’t help but laugh awkwardly, bowing towards Ding Ling:
"Greetings Immortal Realm Emperor! May the Emperor’s celestial blessing endure forever, immortal and evergreen!"
Ding Ling glanced at Mu Jiansheng, said nothing, and instead looked at Mu Jianping, saying:
"I have said everything already. Let’s part here."
"Brother Ding."
Mu Jianping appeared very reluctant, eyes slightly reddened:
"Can’t you stay a few more days?"
"There is no such thing as a banquet that never disperses. Separation and reunion are the norm in life."
Ding Ling crossed his hands on his back, took one step, and vanished before their eyes:
"Train well. I’ll wait for you in the Upper Realm.
"Brother Ding, Brother Ding!"
Mu Jianping hurriedly chased after, but how could she see Ding Ling’s figure?
"Brother Ding left just like that?"
Mu Jianping’s face darkened, raised her head looking at the direction of the Celestial Ladder, silent for a long time.
Mu Jiansheng spoke to her, but she didn’t respond, seemingly in a state of utter loss.

Mu Jiansheng’s heart skipped a beat; what kind of person was he? Though far inferior to Ding Ling, he was far better than ordinary laymen, naturally seeing his sister loved Ding Ling and seemed deeply involved.
If it were before.
He would definitely rejoice uncontrollably.
But Ding Ling came and went swiftly, clearly a traveler in this world, and Ding Ling killed Lord Weil, offending Emperor Kangxi!
If known that Mu Jianping was closely connected to Ding Ling, she’d definitely face open and hidden suppression from Kangxi and Lord Weil’s factions.
Thinking of this.
Mu Jiansheng felt a headache.
He sighed and lamented.
After waiting a whole hour, seeing Mu Jianping stand like a Wangfu Stone, he could no longer bear it, stepped forward blocking Mu Jianping’s view, grabbed her shoulder firmly, and shook:
"Little sister, wake up! Wake up!"
This shake.
Mu Jianping indeed came back to her senses, and called: "Brother."
"Your Brother Ding has gone to the Upper Realm. Let’s go."
"Where to?"
"Yes."
Mu Jiansheng was stunned:
’Where to?!’
The home is gone.
Where can he go?
"How about we go to the Upper Realm too?"
Mu Jianping suggested.
"But we can’t ascend the Celestial Ladder."
Mu Jiansheng’s face turned unpleasant:
"Are you making things difficult for me?"
"I can ascend it."
Mu Jiansheng rolled his eyes:
"Your Brother Ding has left, and you’ve gone mad?! Little sister, listen to me, Ding Ling and us are from two different worlds, you have to think it through. Don’t dream away in daylight..."

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 820: Dragon Gate Flying Armor
paragraphs: However, Mu Jiansheng’s words weren’t finished and could go no further.
Just because he saw Mu Jianping spinning and flying into the air, swirling like a drifting leaf, with a whoosh, she soared towards the direction of the Celestial Ladder.
The speed was as fast as a galloping horse.
Mu Jiansheng was stunned:
"This, this, this... "
He rubbed his eyes, confirmed his eyes weren’t deceiving him, and inhaled sharply, muttering:
’How is this possible?! Just a few months without seeing, has my little sister transformed to this extent?!’
He thought of Ding Ling being together with Mu Jianping, shivering uncontrollably, feeling both thrilled and incredulous:
"Could it be that all of this is the handiwork of Ding Ling, this Immortal Realm Emperor?!"
"That’s right! Besides this Great Emperor, who else has such heaven-defying methods to turn decay into the extraordinary?!"
He frantically chased after Mu Jianping, but no matter what, he couldn’t catch up, and could only shout loudly:
"Little sister, don’t leave your brother behind!"
Ding Ling once again stood before the Gate of Glory.
He did not hesitate.
Stepped forward and entered.
The next moment.
A beam of golden light swept over him, pulling him onto the Heaven-Reaching Dao of ’Dragon Gate Flying Armor’.
Ding Ling felt regret.
There were three paths here: Romantic Swordsman, Dragon Gate Flying Armor, World of Divine Condor.
Unexpectedly, he still couldn’t step into the World of Divine Condor this time.
Ding Ling didn’t ponder it much, just thought of going to the Dragon Gate Flying Armor world to enhance his foundation.
Thunk!
The sense of weightlessness, dizziness, directly invaded his Sea of Consciousness.
Ding Ling felt the darkness before his eyes, unable to perceive anything, could only forcibly steady his heart and spirit, for a moment, accompanied by a clear sound brushing past his ear.
Ding Ling quickly turned to look, indeed, as if a black hole flickered and vanished in the void.
This time he saw it more clearly.
"It really is black hole teleportation. But how exactly does this black hole teleport? I certainly can’t know the underlying principle."
To be honest, his cultivation is still a bit low.
But compared to before, he is much stronger.
At least before, it was impossible to see the black hole.
"Is this where the world of Dragon Gate Flying Armor is?"
Ding Ling instinctively operated the Divine Meditation Technique.
Inhaling, the Earth Realm within a radius of five hundred miles was reflected as a three-dimensional map in his Sea of Consciousness.
It was quite clear.
"Compared to the world of The Deer and the Cauldron, it’s halved."
"Not only did the Earth’s realm halve in range, but its clarity also halved."
The world of The Deer and the Cauldron can reflect a range of a thousand miles.
This world can only reflect a range of five hundred miles.
Though it’s merely five hundred miles.
But it’s still enough.
Ding Ling instantly figured out about where he was located in the Earth Realm.

"This technique is extremely useful. If I had used this technique in the beginning in the world of The Deer and the Cauldron, maybe I would have left long ago. But doing so, I wouldn’t have formed a friendship with Mu Jianping. You can only say this is destiny."
Ding Ling took a deep breath, operated his technique, ready to march towards Chang’an with lifted leg.
Yet sensing the massacre scene a hundred miles away, he couldn’t help but sigh inwardly, flashing instantaneously, the next moment, he appeared a hundred miles away in Fucheng City.
The reason he recognized this city.

It’s because when Ding Ling wandered through other worlds, he had passed by this place. Although the city’s appearance and outline were completely different from other worlds, yet the geographical features were almost the same.
This is also why Ding Ling could instantly recognize this place as Fucheng City.
After all, the Divine Meditation Technique reflects a radius of five hundred miles.

The five hundred miles of Earth’s realm were vivid in front of him, comparing them with the geography map of Jiuzhou from other worlds, if Ding Ling couldn’t figure out where this was, then he wouldn’t deserve to be the All-Purpose King.
"Kill!"
"Hahaha, leave the women, kill all the others!"
"No!"
"Big brother! Ah! I’ll fight you!"
"Child’s father, the baby can’t hold on."
Crying, shouting, laughing, the clang of weapons clashing... Sounds ceaselessly resounding through Heaven’s Edge!
Ding Ling with clear ears and sharp eyes, in Sword Spirit state empowering himself, further making his ears and eyes into Spiritual Eyes and Heaven-Reaching Ear.
In this state.
Combined with Divine Meditation Technique.
Any sound or scene within a ten-mile radius of the Earth Realm is impossible to escape his ears and eyes.
He saw very clearly.

Men wearing peculiar attire, donning armor, wielding slender and sharp wakizashi, were wildly slaughtering the elderly and children, if any man dared resist, they would be shot and killed reflexively with crossbow arrows!
They held crossbow arrows in their left hand, wakizashi in their right hand, flocking in groups, fiercely and wantonly pouncing on groups of civilians like a pack of wolves.
Their numbers were immense.
No less than five thousand.
Spread throughout the entire Fucheng City.
Fucheng City could be described as a hellish scene of a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood.
In a few corners amongst them.
There were people leading some soldiers in resistance.

Heading them was a heroically imposing eight-foot-tall female general, not yielding to men, with majestic bearing, she donned armor and wielded a Great Guan Saber, continuously swinging strike after strike, forcibly leading thirty soldiers, and grass-roots to carve out a bloody path!
But they were too few.
In a round of crossbow arrows exchange.
Almost instantly, they were nearly wiped out.
Leaving beside the female general, only a scant few remained.
"Hahaha..."
The man beside the female general had a handsome face, a dusty air, looked just like a commoner, at this moment he was blood-stained, yet laughing loudly:
"Gul Shaotang, today my Wind Saber is going to die here. Truly damn unlucky. Came with you to eradicate bandits, yet ended up costing my own life."
"Die and die, eighteen years later, I’ll be a brave man again!"
The female general, who was exactly Gul Shaotang, roared angrily, wielding the Guan Saber she charged towards the Wokou:
"I, Gul Shaotang, shall die on the path of charge!"
Whew whew whew!
Dense crossbow arrows fired towards Gul Shaotang and Wind Saber, in an instant, seemingly about to be shot dead covering them like a rain of arrows, a figure suddenly flashed in front of them.

This person didn’t seem to make any movement, merely waved a hand, the arrows in the sky paused in mid-air, then astonishingly turned their arrowheads, like a meteor shower, fiercely shot towards the Wokou.
But hearing a sound of whew whew whew of arrow rain brushing past ears.
Looking again.
Over a hundred Wokou in front instantly shot in vital spots, falling dead.
Gul Shaotang, Wind Saber inhaled deeply in chill air, their eyes widened round, faces marked full of incredulity.
They looked towards this person.
But saw this person with back facing them, couldn’t see the face, yet the poise and grandeur of a Grandmaster were apparent, instinctively arousing their reverence.
Wind Saber intended to express some words of admiration and gratitude, only to see the silhouette flash before them, the hero who just rescued them soon vanished without a trace.
"Where’s the person?!"
Wind Saber sought about, couldn’t find, clueless.
"Such swift speed!"
Gul Shaotang was also bewildered:
"Such ingenious Divine Technique, the method of controlling crossbow arrows to kill enemies just now, confirmed to be a Martial Arts technique?!"

Just because he saw Mu Jianping spinning and flying into the air, swirling like a drifting leaf, with a whoosh, she soared towards the direction of the Celestial Ladder.
The speed was as fast as a galloping horse.
Mu Jiansheng was stunned:

He rubbed his eyes, confirmed his eyes weren’t deceiving him, and inhaled sharply, muttering:

Just a few months without seeing, has my little sister transformed to this extent?!’

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 821: Gul Shaotang
paragraphs: The person just now was Ding Ling.
And he suddenly appeared, effortlessly killing over a hundred Wokou pirates.
This made Gul Shaotang, Wind Saber, and the others tremble in shock!
When had they ever seen such a powerful figure?
Almost like a deity sprung from a novel, incredibly powerful!
"Who exactly is he?! How could someone so strong appear in our world?! Could he be a divine spirit ascending from the historical planes?"
"Probably not."

Wind Saber, suspicious and undecided, had the most informed access. Many heroes sought him for information, allowing him to meet many aliens in the Jianghu, with extensive knowledge of the historical planes. Upon hearing Gul Shaotang’s words, he instinctively retorted:

"As far as I know, after becoming a deity, the restrictions are enormous; supposedly, they can only remain within the historical plane. If they ascend, their divine power is stripped away, and they’ll never be able to achieve eternal youth and immortality again!
Thus, we can conclude. Many divine spirits are unlikely to ascend at this time; it’s simply not worth it!"

"Indeed. I remember. The aliens said that many among their group have become Celestial Soldiers in the lower realm’s Celestial Court. They are acquainted with many divine spirits. Through probing, they learned a lot about the essence of divine spirits, especially during this period. The Celestial Court’s spiritual vitality is bursting, even stronger than the Upper Realm. It’s impossible for them to leave now; they would choose to cultivate in the Celestial Court, strengthening themselves. That’s the logical choice!"
"That’s the right way to think."
Wind Saber continued:
"Given this, who do you suppose the person who suddenly appeared to save us was?"
"Let’s go see to find out."
Gul Shaotang wielded the Guan Saber, speeding toward the front.
Because at that moment, she heard exclamations, accompanied by ’bang bang bang’ sounds.
These sounds seemed like people falling, even more like people kneeling and kowtowing.
She sprinted down the long street, rounded a corner, and sure enough.
She saw old folks and children kneeling on the ground, kowtowing toward a direction, chanting words that seemed to thank the deity and hero.
Without asking further.
Kept running.
As she ran.
The sight grew increasingly shocking.
Groups of Wokou lay sprawled on the ground.
Each killed by a single blow!
Moreover, the wounds were neat, without exception, all located on the forehead!
"Such powerful attack methods!"
"Too incredible!"

Gul Shaotang had honed her Breathing Technique and Inner Power Heart Method over the years, her cultivation high enough to be considered first-class. With her Great Guan Saber, she fought from south to north, west to east, with few equals.
Thus, she was esteemed, recruited, and promoted to a female general.
This time, she was ordered to collaborate with Fucheng City officials to eliminate the Wokou scourge.
Unexpectedly, the Wokou colluded inside and out, nearly cornering her like Chaozu!
Luckily, her martial skills were exceptional; otherwise, she would have perished long ago.

Still, had it not been for the mysterious person who suddenly appeared to rescue her, she would have been doomed, further proving the high combat power of this group of Wokou! Absolutely the elite army capable of dominating small countries!
Yet it was such a great army.
That was easily pierced through the forehead and killed batch by batch by the mysterious person.
Just like harvesting rice.
Wherever he passed.
Not a single Wokou survived.
Gul Shaotang ran very fast.
But even at her full speed, she couldn’t catch up with the mysterious person’s rate of killing enemies.
Her head tingled with shock, her body trembling.
This wasn’t fear.
It’s a manifestation of excitement, ecstasy.
"If the Great Ming Dynasty could recruit such a fierce general, no Wokou or foreign dynasty could withstand!"
Inwardly exhilarated, Gul Shaotang vowed to meet this mysterious person.
Very soon.
She reached the city center, where Wokou gathered in heaps.
And at that moment.
She clearly saw how the mysterious person acted.

There stood that towering figure, walking like the wind across the land, surrounded by Sword Qi. Wherever he went, the Sword Qi seemed to auto-navigate, with clanging sounds penetrating the forehead of each Wokou effortlessly.
Once he passed through the city center.
The cluster of Wokou had been completely eliminated by him.
From beginning to end.
The Wokou seemed made of paper!

No matter how they counterattacked or fired, it was as if a gentle breeze blew past the mysterious person. Not only was he unharmed, but the arrows shot at him would fly back at a faster speed, striking the Wokou’s vital spots!
"Hiss!"
Gul Shaotang watched as goosebumps rose.
"Such a divine being!"
"So powerful!"
"Who is he?"
Gul Shaotang was too curious, seeing the mysterious person about to leave, she shouted loudly:
"Hero, please wait ahead!"
The mysterious person was naturally Ding Ling.
Upon seeing the Wakizashi, he immediately knew these were Wokou infiltrating the city.
During the Great Ming Period, Wokou frequently troubled the land!
And it’s evident that the player’s involvement didn’t stop the Wokou’s troubles but seemingly accelerated this process.
The Wokou grew more fierce and valiant.
With five or six experts comparable to Super-Elite Fierce Generals among them! Such experts won’t ascend to the Upper Realm, choosing instead to wreak havoc in this world!
It proves their aspirations have waned! Preferring to enjoy comfort here.
But enjoying comfort used the wrong approach, daring to rampage across the Jiuzhou Land, meeting Ding Ling!
Had they not encountered Ding Ling, perhaps today they would have succeeded!

After all, with a Wokou Legion led by five or six Super-Elite Fierce Generals, it was indeed elite; even though Gul Shaotang was strong, she lacked capable helpers. Two fists can’t defeat four hands; her defeat was inevitable.
Now, with the Wokou Legion wiped out, Ding Ling was about to leave when he heard Gul Shaotang’s shout, causing him to pause for a moment and look back.
With this glance.
The two locked eyes.
Gul Shaotang got a clear look at Ding Ling’s face!
Handsome and dashing!
Looks like Pan An!
With an aura of deity, immortal, saint!
Just one glance and Gul Shaotang found it hard to forget the person before her because his aura and appearance were unprecedented and unseen.
Gul Shaotang’s lasting impression, a lifetime unforgettable, was naturally usual:
"May I know who the hero is?"
Gul Shaotang dared to bet she had never seen the mysterious person before her!
Such an outstanding aura and appearance!
Truly rare!
"Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?!"
Gul Shaotang, dazed, inexplicably found the name familiar:
’Seems like I’ve heard it somewhere?’
"Are you looking for me for something?"
Ding Ling answered ambiguously, smiling slightly:
"If not, I’ll be leaving."
"There is something."
Gul Shaotang quickly buried her confusion, saying:
"Hero’s divine skill is unmatched, unrivaled in the world, I wish to ask the hero to help clear the coastal Wokou troubles. Aid the suffering people."
"How long have the Wokou troubles persisted?"
"For several years now."
"Isn’t anyone managing it?"
"They can’t manage it."
Gul Shaotang smiled bitterly, sighing:
"Many masters from the court and Jianghu have ascended to the Upper Realm. Even the renowned and patriotic Zhao Huai’an has ascended to the upper realm. What of others, one can imagine."

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 822: Wind Saber
paragraphs: "In contrast, the Wokou don’t behave this way. Many masters remain in this Plane World instead of ascending but instead, they gather talent and resources fervently, invading our Central Plains."
Gul Shaotang sighed:

"Within the court, corrupt officials hold power, and many warriors willing to rise up have been killed. If it weren’t for the constant meddling and disruption from the aliens, the Central Plains might have long been overrun and occupied by the Wokou."
"I see."
Ding Ling said:
"In that case. I shall head to Japan shortly. I’ll eliminate the villain, and the Central Plains may be better off. As for the Great Ming Dynasty, you handle it yourselves."
With these words.
Ding Ling stepped forward and disappeared instantly in front of Gul Shaotang.
"Hero, hero!"
Gul Shaotang shouted out twice.
But where could she still see the person?
"Just left like that?!"
Gul Shaotang felt a bit of loss; she had planned to converse more with the hero, but the hero was straightforward, leaving with just a promise?!
"Gul Shaotang!"
Wind Saber hurriedly arrived at this very moment, panting heavily, evidently exhausted:
"You ran so fast, did you meet that hero?"
"I met him."
Gul Shaotang appeared a bit deflated.
"What kind of expression is that?"
Wind Saber was puzzled:
"You saw the hero! I haven’t even seen him yet!"
He gave Gul Shaotang a push:
"Hurry and tell me, what does the hero look like, what is his name? Don’t tell me you didn’t even find out his name!"
"He’s very handsome!"
Gul Shaotang briefly described Ding Ling’s aura and appearance, finally revealing the name:
"His name is Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?!"
Upon hearing the name, Wind Saber couldn’t help but shudder and exclaimed:
"Immortal Realm Emperor Ding Ling!!"
"What did you say?!"
Gul Shaotang turned to him.
"I said you might have seen the Immortal Realm Emperor Ding Ling!"
"How is that possible?!
"Who else could possess this kind of power, and also be named Ding Ling?"
Wind Saber asserted:
"People with the surname Ding are already rare, not to mention possessing such earth-shattering divine techniques. Who else could he be other than the Immortal Realm Emperor?"
Wind Saber said resolutely:

"I was puzzled who could be this powerful; descending gods could only be as strong as this. To think it’s the Immortal Realm Emperor, this makes sense. Only the Immortal Realm Emperor wouldn’t be content staying in the Lower Realm; he would continue to ascend to a higher Upper Realm. After all, Ding Ling, this Great Emperor descended from the Upper Realm to the Historical Plane of the Lower Realm. He went to the Historical Plane to elevate and assist his wife and friends.
Now that his purpose is fulfilled, choosing once more to ascend to the Upper Realm, improving himself in a higher and stronger Plane World, naturally makes sense."
"I see."
Gul Shaotang said:
"It seems you’ve often inquired about the Emperor’s stories."

"I am Wind Saber of the Jianghu! The Immortal Realm Emperor — what a legendary figure! I can listen to his stories for three days and nights straight! The extent of my admiration and awe for him is unmatched."
Wind Saber looked toward the void with a face full of reverence, cupped his hands, and said:
"It seems the Immortal Realm Emperor is indeed worthy of my admiration, clear in love and enmity, when it comes to the Wokou, just eliminate them decisively!"
He paused and asked:
"Did the Emperor say anything to you?"
Gul Shaotang truthfully replied.
Wind Saber was full of anticipation:
"The Emperor abides by no rules with enemies, but is extremely committed to promises with subordinates and friends. Since he said so, he will likely fulfill it."
And indeed, it was so.
In less than a day’s time.
They heard from the aliens about Japan being destroyed.
Surprised and filled with shock.
"Japan was shattered into pieces!"
"Countless Wokou died sudden deaths!"
"This time the menace has been completely eradicated!"
They looked at each other, clearly seeing the mutual joy, excitement, and shock in each other’s eyes!
"After the Emperor obliterated the Wokou, he vanished without a trace. I reckon he went to the Upper Realm."
"Indeed. In this world, his concerns are few. Staying just a moment to eliminate the Wokou is already the greatest divine miracle for us!"
In the following period.
Wind Saber spread the news everywhere.
Additionally, it was spread by the players as well.
Hence, the tale of the Immortal Realm Emperor smashing Japan quickly spread throughout Jiuzhou!
The corrupt officials in the court were trembling with fear, they couldn’t believe it was true!
But when the sent spies repeatedly confirmed Japan was indeed shattered, they nearly swooned from fear, repeatedly inquiring from underlings about Ding Ling Emperor’s whereabouts.
Upon learning from the players that Ding Ling Emperor truly left this world, they finally breathed a sigh of relief.

But they quickly remembered Ding Ling Emperor’s unpredictable actions, seeming capable of descending at any time with his great divine techniques and abilities, their hearts were unsettled once more, asking advisors and players:
"Do you think the Immortal Realm Emperor will sweep us away all at once?"
Advisors and players exchanged glances, unable to say for sure.
Due to Ding Ling’s unpredictable methods, loving and hating distinctly.
Nobody could tell if Ding Ling might come one day at the height of joy and wipe out these corrupt officials!
The officials saw the advisors and players staying silent, they all felt their hearts sink, they staggered to their feet, walked into the courtyard, knelt down, made three bows, very sincerely said:
"Immortal Realm Emperor above! I swear here today, from now on, I will absolutely be a loyal official, please don’t kill me!"
After three bows.
In the depths.
He seemed to hear a sigh.
He was further terrified, dared not raise his head, until he heard no further sounds, then dared to look up, only to see the advisors and players’ stunned expressions and demeanor.
He didn’t care, just solemnly said:
"I shall keep my word. I also hope you all can try your best!"
What good people could players who collude with corrupt officials be?
They are precise egoists.
Seeing him change face, they thought of grabbing and leaving, seeking alliance with others.
As for offending Ding Ling?
They didn’t even consider it.
Ding Ling is too powerful, too strong, coming and going freely in the Lower Realm!
Consider the vast world, so many players!
Why is Ding Ling the only one able to accomplish this?
This shows how high Ding Ling’s divine techniques and cultivation truly are, reaching a level where ordinary players can only look up in awe!
In the Great Ming World, some time later, it was surprisingly peaceful and harmonious!
This for Gul Shaotang and other chivalrous warriors was the best reward.
When they thought of Ding Ling’s deeds, they couldn’t help but feel admiration and start to desire to follow!

sentences.text: "In contrast, the Wokou don’t behave this way.
Many masters remain in this Plane World instead of ascending but instead, they gather talent and resources fervently, invading our Central Plains."
Gul Shaotang sighed:
"Within the court, corrupt officials hold power, and many warriors willing to rise up have been killed.
If it weren’t for the constant meddling and disruption from the aliens, the Central Plains might have long been overrun and occupied by the Wokou."
"I see."
Ding Ling said:
"In that case.
I shall head to Japan shortly.
I’ll eliminate the villain, and the Central Plains may be better off.
As for the Great Ming Dynasty, you handle it yourselves."
With these words.
Ding Ling stepped forward and disappeared instantly in front of Gul Shaotang.
"Hero, hero!"
Gul Shaotang shouted out twice.

"Just left like that?!"
Gul Shaotang felt a bit of loss; she had planned to converse more with the hero, but the hero was straightforward, leaving with just a promise?!
"Gul Shaotang!"
Wind Saber hurriedly arrived at this very moment, panting heavily, evidently exhausted:
"You ran so fast, did you meet that hero?"
"I met him."
Gul Shaotang appeared a bit deflated.
"What kind of expression is that?"
Wind Saber was puzzled:
"You saw the hero!
I haven’t even seen him yet!"

"Hurry and tell me, what does the hero look like, what is his name?

"He’s very handsome!"

"His name is Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?!"

"Immortal Realm Emperor Ding Ling!!"
"What did you say?!"
Gul Shaotang turned to him.
"I said you might have seen the Immortal Realm Emperor Ding Ling!"
"How is that possible?!
"Who else could possess this kind of power, and also be named Ding Ling?"
Wind Saber asserted:
"People with the surname Ding are already rare, not to mention possessing such earth-shattering divine techniques.
Who else could he be other than the Immortal Realm Emperor?"
Wind Saber said resolutely:
"I was puzzled who could be this powerful; descending gods could only be as strong as this.
To think it’s the Immortal Realm Emperor, this makes sense.
Only the Immortal Realm Emperor wouldn’t be content staying in the Lower Realm; he would continue to ascend to a higher Upper Realm.
After all, Ding Ling, this Great Emperor descended from the Upper Realm to the Historical Plane of the Lower Realm.
He went to the Historical Plane to elevate and assist his wife and friends.
Now that his purpose is fulfilled, choosing once more to ascend to the Upper Realm, improving himself in a higher and stronger Plane World, naturally makes sense."
"I see."

"It seems you’ve often inquired about the Emperor’s stories."
"I am Wind Saber of the Jianghu!
The Immortal Realm Emperor — what a legendary figure!
I can listen to his stories for three days and nights straight!
The extent of my admiration and awe for him is unmatched."

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 823: Celestial Dragon Eight Books
paragraphs: Gul Shaotang immediately prepared to step onto the Celestial Ladder to follow in Ding Ling’s footsteps.
However, as Wind Saber had weak cultivation, she couldn’t put her mind at ease and stayed beside him, urging him day and night to train in martial arts.

Ever since witnessing Ding Ling single-handedly and effortlessly annihilate the Japanese Wokou invaders, Wind Saber’s heart was trembling with admiration! The admiration and passion in his heart reached their peak!
It was on that day that he clearly realized that cleverness in the face of true strength was utterly worthless!
Only by honing oneself to the extreme can one effortlessly change a nation’s fate with a single hand!
Such divine techniques and methods.
He was extremely envious, and with Gul Shaotang continuously encouraging, urging, and assisting him by his side, Wind Saber was filled with a strong spirit of aspiration!
Even if he couldn’t become as supreme and grand as the Immortal Realm Emperor Ding Ling!
He also wanted to be an unrestrained and carefree hero who roams freely!
In the words of the Aliens!
"Ding Ling, my idol!"
"I must advance towards my idol! Catch up!"
After Ding Ling shattered the island of Japan and eradicated the Wokou menace,
he went to the Great Ming Imperial Palace.
After reviewing the million books in the library there,
Ding Ling’s Buddha Qi increased by another degree.
The foundation became even more profound.
The progress of the Martial Dao True Understanding 2.0 version moved forward a small step.
Afterwards.
He didn’t disturb the emperor or the noble consort in the palace, and with a single step, vanished from the Great Ming Imperial Palace, heading towards the location of the Chang’an Celestial Ladder.
It was still where the Ten-Mile Pavilion was located.
This time, the Celestial Ladder was different from other places.
There were guards holding ’fire guns’ guarding it.
But to Ding Ling, these guards were as non-existent; with a blink of an eye, he disappeared before them.
From start to finish.
They didn’t even notice anyone passing by them just now.
They only felt a peculiar breeze brushing past their ears, and by the time they sensed it, the breeze had already disappeared.
They were perplexed, looked around, saw nothing unusual, and resumed their posts.
Compared to the guards in other places.
The soldiers here had fire guns.

This showed how much Great Ming valued the Celestial Ladder, but unfortunately, the good steel wasn’t used on the blade edge; the fire guns weren’t used against the Wokou but against Ascenders and their own people.
Ding Ling shook his head; he had no interest in meddling with the rights and wrongs of this world.
His act of shattering the island was purely out of righteous anger in his heart.
Now, having vented his fire qi,
Ding Ling naturally did not wish to waste more time in this world.
Because even though the world’s million books’ value wasn’t substantial, it was enough to read them in passing.
Ding Ling also had no inclination to visit other realms to read more.
As such.
With a few strides, he directly ascended to the highest point of the Celestial Ladder, arriving at the Gate of Glory.
This time, the three great paths corresponded to three worlds: Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, The Generation’s Twin Heroes, and Celestial Dragon Eight Books.
Without further thought, Ding Ling stepped directly forward.
In the next instant.
A golden light, as if a ribbon, swept him up, pulling him onto the great path of ’Celestial Dragon Eight Books’.
Ding Ling’s heart was delighted:
"Finally, I can save a trip of traveling back to the Lower Realm."
In the previous two times, he hadn’t ’stepped on’ that ’one-third’ winning probability.
This time was finally successful.
It seemed his luck wasn’t as disastrously bad as it could have been.
Whizz!
The familiar feeling of weightlessness and dizziness came again.
Ding Ling opened his eyes wide and, in less than a moment, felt his eyes brighten, quickly looking back again, and this time, he could see the black hole more clearly.
But even that was for less than half a blink.
The black hole then disappeared into nothingness.
"So I’ve arrived at the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World."
Ding Ling no longer hesitated and unfolded the Divine Meditation Technique.
The three-dimensional map within a two-hundred-mile radius immediately mirrored in his Sea of Consciousness.
Compared to Dragon Gate Flying Armor’s five hundred miles and The Deer and the Cauldron’s thousand miles,
Celestial Dragon Eight Books could only reflect two hundred miles radius.
This shows that as one enters higher-level worlds, the degree of suppression of the Divine Meditation Technique also becomes greater and greater.
Even the ability to traverse and escape through the sky is heavily suppressed in this world.
In the Lower Realm, traversing hundreds of miles was just ordinary.
In this world, it’s unattainable.
Only one hundred and eighty miles or so in an instant.
But even so.
For Ding Ling, it’s already quite remarkable.
"An instant over a hundred miles. If I give it my all, traversing eight hundred miles in an instant wouldn’t be impossible."
Ding Ling was still very satisfied with his speed.
Unfolding the Flowing Light Escape Skill.
Like flowing light, more like lightning.
Speed so fast that it’s hard to perceive with the naked eye.
Using the Divine Meditation Technique, he quickly identified his location:
"Mount Heng Territory, is it?"
Numerous landscape and character images emerged in Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness.
The landscapes were quite clear; although the emotional clarity was slightly inferior to those in the Lower Realm, he could still identify where he was.
As for human figures, they were even more blurred.

It’s only through activating the Spirit Eye of the Sword Spirit, the Heaven-Reaching Ear, in conjunction with the Divine Meditation Technique that Ding Ling could roughly perceive the facial features within a two-hundred-mile radius.
Thus, for an expert like Ding Ling, it was sufficient.
In an instant.
The various figures within the two-hundred-mile radius appeared in his Sea of Consciousness.

Among them, Ding Ling saw many familiar faces: Heavenly Mountain Granny, Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum, Duan Zhengchun, Chuu Wanli, Fu Sigu, Zhu Danchen, Qin Hongmian, Duan Zhengming, and others.
He also saw many strangers.
They were fighting over a golden orb in mid-air.
The orb was crystal clear, golden light glistening all over, Sword Qi spreading in all directions!
At a glance, it was no ordinary object!
It hung suspended in mid-air, floating up and down uncertainly, and as people from all directions fought over it, it floated higher, moving further away from some people.
Some people used Lightweight Skill to attempt to reach such height but couldn’t, so they opted to shoot arrows, trying to shoot the orb from the sky.
Others chose to use fire guns; with one shot, bang!
The gunshot thundered, and not only was the orb not shot down, but it was struck further up and away.
"No use of guns!"
Heavenly Mountain Granny, not taller than five feet but exuding an imposing aura that intimidated the Ten Directions Realm, within a hundred-meter radius, no one dared approach her!
At this moment, she soared into the air, striking Duan Zhengming away with one palm, her eyes piercing, looking towards the east with a face filled with rage, shouting:
"Who is the little brat hiding and firing a gun? If you dare fire again, be careful or I’ll tear you apart!"
The Celestial Dragon Eight Books world has fire guns now.
Either Ascenders brought them from other worlds.
Or the technology of this world has advanced rapidly, and someone managed to develop these fire guns in just a few years.
In any case.
The advent of fire guns introduces more variables and opportunities for ordinary Martial Arts experts.
If an ordinary third-rate Martial Arts expert masters spear technique, they might also be able to use a fire gun to take down a first-class Inner Power expert.
With guns appearing frequently over the years,
it indicates that these worlds may perhaps move towards a future of missiles flying through the sky and nuclear bombs cleansing the earth?
Regardless of the truth.
Ding Ling couldn’t say.

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 824: Grandma Tong’s Flying Sword
paragraphs: But so many people are vying for this golden treasure bead.
This shows its extraordinary nature.
Especially as the bead flies higher and higher, it is actually floating toward his direction.
How could Ding Ling miss the opportunity to take a good look?

He leapt into the void, and in a flash, the realm within eighty miles flowed beneath his feet, and in the next moment, Ding Ling arrived at the void eighty miles away and came face to face with the treasure bead.
He grabbed the treasure bead, feeling sword qi sharp and dazzling!
In a clang, the sword qi stabbed into his palm, surprisingly bringing him a slight sense of pain!
"Such a powerful treasure bead!"
It should be known that Ding Ling’s body refining cultivation has already advanced to the Martial Arts Golden Core Realm!
He has refined the techniques such as World-Ending Demon Body, Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, and War God Technique into one Body Refining Skill.
The strength of the Body Refining Skill is evident.
Now, a treasure capable of injuring his physical body is practically non-existent in the Lower Realm.
Yet here, he encountered one.
"What on earth is this thing?"
Ding Ling was about to carefully observe the treasure bead to understand its truth.
But below the realm, cries of shock rang out.
"Someone has snatched the treasure bead!"
"Quick, release the arrows! Shoot him down!"
Whizz whizz!
Bang bang bang!
The sound of arrow rain, firearm sounds, reverberated continuously, shaking the heavens and earth.

Ding Ling held the treasure bead, stood in mid-air, allowing the arrows and bullets to fly close, and then just as they were about to hit him, he suddenly reached out into the air to grab the arrows and bullets, and fling them back toward the Lower Realm.
Whizz whizz whizz!
The arrows and bullets shot back at an even faster speed, and amidst the sound of air being pierced across the sky, only a few faint screams could be heard.
It turned out that the Divine Archers and Sharpshooters who had just acted were killed.
These two Divine Archers and Sharpshooters looked unfamiliar.
No doubt, they were either Ascenders or rising stars grown among the local natives.
But regardless.
Their daring to use firearms before the Heavenly Mountain Granny shows their high cultivation and strong spear skills.
Such figures can easily stand alongside Innate Experts.
Yet they were effortlessly slain by Ding Ling here!
Everyone present was shaken, their eyes sparkling as they looked over.
The Heavenly Mountain Granny, with her keen vision, was the first to clearly see Ding Ling, her face changing dramatically, she solemnly bowed and said:
"Lingjiu Palace Heavenly Mountain Granny, greets Your Majesty. Your Majesty, long live, long live, long live!"
Fu Sigu, Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum, Zhu Danchen, and others also had their expressions change dramatically, all falling to their knees, proclaiming Your Majesty long live.
Duan Zhengchun, Qin Hongmian, and their party were both surprised and delighted to see it was indeed Ding Ling.
Only because they pride themselves on being related to Ding Ling.
Naturally, Ding Ling will take better care of them!
Originally at a disadvantage, after Ding Ling arrived, their confidence soared, each becoming much more spirited, their pride and arrogance evident to all.
Even the likes of Heavenly Mountain Granny could not help but envy.
Now, who doesn’t know of Ding Ling’s prowess in the world!
Immortal Realm Emperor, with a thought, heavens overturn, star shifting as mere trifles!
If he favors anyone!
That person could quickly soar to divine status overnight!
Such an Immortal Realm Emperor, already exceeds the imagination of many ordinary people!
To be related to him!
That truly is a blessing cultivated over three lifetimes!
"At ease."
Ding Ling descended from the void.

Landing on the peak of Mount Heng, he looked toward Duan Zhengchun, Heavenly Mountain Granny and their group, then glanced at the strangers not far away, holding the gold bead between two fingers, and said:
"What is this?"
"Reporting to Your Majesty. This is a Sword Pill!"
Duan Zhengchun stepped forward, replied with a clasped hand:

"It is a Sword Pill that flew out from the Valley of Eternal Spring in Dali. There are eight in all. Seven of them were obtained by Chen Jinnan and others. This last one, the most precious Supreme Sword Pill, we fought over from near Dali Eternal Spring Valley to near Mount Heng, yet still without a resolution.
Rather, it only became more chaotic. The casualties are immeasurable.
Fortunately, Your Majesty timely returned. Only this prevented greater catastrophe."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling squeezed the treasure bead:
’Sword Pill?!’
"Yes."

Heavenly Mountain Granny, having heard of Ding Ling’s earth-shaking news over the years, felt regretful and remorseful for not decisively clinging to Ding Ling’s favor earlier, now, seeing Ding Ling ask further, she immediately stepped forward and solemnly reported:

"Your Majesty, Chen Jinnan, Jiunan, Su Qian, and others hit a stroke of luck. For some reason, they emerged alive from Dali Eternal Spring Valley and obtained such a treasure like the Sword Pill! Their cultivation, strength, can be said to have undergone an earth-shattering transformation.
Among them, Su Qian and Jiunan are particularly arrogant, wilful. Since emerging, they have killed countless elite warriors of our Celestial Dragon World! Truly deserving condemnation!
Heavenly Mountain Granny spoke extremely fast:
"And this golden treasure bead floated out from the Valley of Eternal Spring last month. It was for this that a big battle occurred."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling didn’t expect to hear news about Chen Jinnan, Jiunan, and Su Qian here.
Their relationship with Weil Xiaobao is quite deep.
But that’s the original storyline.

Now looking at the storyline, not only did Su Qian break free from Hong Antong’s control, but she didn’t marry Weil Xiaobao either, instead, she ascended to the Upper Realm for development and surpassing Hong Antong.
Hong Antong was killed by her.
Su Qian is still living well, and having encountered extraordinary fortunes, now she even dares a spree of killings in Celestial Dragon World?
Such luck.
Obviously, it’s not something Hong Antong possesses.
As for Jiunan?
She is Ake’s teacher, later took Weil Xiaobao as a disciple, is Emperor Chongzhen’s daughter, Princess Changping!
Such a character shouldn’t indiscriminately kill the innocent.
Ding Ling suspiciously glanced at Heavenly Mountain Granny.
Heavenly Mountain Granny’s heart skipped a beat, quickly added:
"Most they killed were heartless, ungrateful people."
That makes sense.
Ding Ling said:
"Apart from this ownerless Sword Pill, have the other Sword Pills been claimed?"
"Yes, Your Majesty."
Duan Zhengchun responded:
"Moreover, Heavenly Mountain Granny also received a Sword Pill!"
Heavenly Mountain Granny, unflustered, promptly opened her mouth and spat out a crimson Sword Pill.
This Sword Pill was a dazzling red as fire, and with Heavenly Mountain Granny performing a special sacrificial refining technique, clang!
The Sword Pill instantly started to flow like water, transforming.
In the blink of an eye, it turned into a sharp, crimson sword.

This sword, surrounded by swirling sword qi, with a point maneuvered by Heavenly Mountain Granny, whoosh! The Red Sword instantly shot forth a ten-foot fiery red sword qi, cutting and burning everything in its path.
This is clearly a Divine Sword endowed with both fire and sharp attributes.
"Sword Pill."
Interesting.
Ding Ling asked about the sacrificial refining technique.
Heavenly Mountain Granny then elaborated to Ding Ling.

This shows its extraordinary nature.
Especially as the bead flies higher and higher, it is actually floating toward his direction.
How could Ding Ling miss the opportunity to take a good look?

He leapt into the void, and in a flash, the realm within eighty miles flowed beneath his feet, and in the next moment, Ding Ling arrived at the void eighty miles away and came face to face with the treasure bead.

In a clang, the sword qi stabbed into his palm, surprisingly bringing him a slight sense of pain!

Yet here, he encountered one.

Whizz whizz!

The sound of arrow rain, firearm sounds, reverberated continuously, shaking the heavens and earth.

The arrows and bullets shot back at an even faster speed, and amidst the sound of air being pierced across the sky, only a few faint screams could be heard.

No doubt, they were either Ascenders or rising stars grown among the local natives.
But regardless.

Only because they pride themselves on being related to Ding Ling.
Naturally, Ding Ling will take better care of them!

Even the likes of Heavenly Mountain Granny could not help but envy.
Now, who doesn’t know of Ding Ling’s prowess in the world!

That person could quickly soar to divine status overnight!
Such an Immortal Realm Emperor, already exceeds the imagination of many ordinary people!

That truly is a blessing cultivated over three lifetimes!

Ding Ling descended from the void.

This is a Sword Pill!"

Seven of them were obtained by Chen Jinnan and others.
This last one, the most precious Supreme Sword Pill, we fought over from near Dali Eternal Spring Valley to near Mount Heng, yet still without a resolution.
Rather, it only became more chaotic.
The casualties are immeasurable.
Fortunately, Your Majesty timely returned.
Only this prevented greater catastrophe."

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 825: Sword Pill
paragraphs: It turns out that the Sacrificial Refining Technique for this Sword Pill was something the Heavenly Mountain Granny only figured out after a long period of solitary exploration.

And the reason she could understand the roots of the Sacrificial Refining Technique was because she once captured an expert who came from the Valley of Eternal Spring, obtaining a golden armored fragment from him.
This fragment detailed part of the techniques for refining a flying sword.
Relying on this portion of techniques.
The Heavenly Mountain Granny successfully cultivated the Red Sword.
Yet it was obvious.

She was not satisfied with this and wished to obtain the Supreme Sword Pill. Now that Ding Ling had acquired the Supreme Sword Pill, she couldn’t request it, and instead voluntarily shared the Sacrificial Refining Technique and offered the golden armored fragment.
Ding Ling took the fragment into his hand in mid-air and glanced at it.
[Celestial Escape Swordsmanship (Fragment) Full Level]
In an instant.
Ding Ling immediately comprehended the Divine Skill inscribed on the fragment.
An aura of sharp and ethereal Sword Qi surged onto his body instantaneously! This Sword Qi seemed to allow Ding Ling to instantaneously escape into the skies, eradicating all monsters and demons!
In a fleeting moment, Duan Zhengchun, the Heavenly Mountain Granny, and others seemed to witness the Sword God descend upon the mortal world.
"What is this?!"
Their hearts and spirits trembled significantly, quite perplexed.
They couldn’t understand if Ding Ling had possessed this extraordinary Sword Qi all along.

Or if it was only after viewing the fragment that he gained it? If this Sword Qi was obtained by looking at the fragment, why had the Heavenly Mountain Granny, who held the fragment for no less than half a year, been unable to cultivate such profound Sword Qi?!
Duan Zhengchun, Duan Zhengming, Qin Hongmian, Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum all gazed at Ding Ling as if seeing a deity.
The Heavenly Mountain Granny, realizing this, had her heart trembling. She admired Ding Ling utterly, and was the first to congratulate him:
"Congratulations, Your Majesty, on successfully comprehending the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship!"
"It seems you know the name of this sword technique."
Ding Ling flicked the fragment with his finger, and it floated back into the hands of the Heavenly Mountain Granny like a leaf:
"Thank you for your fragment."
"I would like to ask Your Majesty to instruct me on the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship."
The Heavenly Mountain Granny blushed slightly:

"This old lady has been comprehending the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship for six or seven months, only grasping the basics. It’s challenging to fathom its esoteric truth. Could Your Majesty resolve a few of this old lady’s confusions?"
"Feel free to speak."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, displaying great generosity.
The Heavenly Mountain Granny paused, then was overjoyed. She hadn’t expected Ding Ling to be so agreeable.
She immediately divulged her doubts and perplexities.
With the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship (Fragment) at full level, Ding Ling naturally and casually answered her questions effortlessly.
The more the Heavenly Mountain Granny inquired.
The faster her aura transformed.
Eventually.
It seemed she had unlocked some sort of mystical meridian in her body, letting out a long howl, boom! A world-shaking aura of red Sword Qi burst forth from her body!
This Sword Qi complemented the Red Sword.
The combination of both.
Was enough to elevate the Heavenly Mountain Granny into the ranks of absolute experts.
"Thank you, Your Majesty!"
After calming her aura, the Heavenly Mountain Granny half-knelt on the ground, respectfully saying:

"Without Your Majesty’s help in resolving my confusions, this old lady would have had absolutely no chance of comprehending its enigmas thoroughly in this lifetime. Naturally, I would have struggled on the grand path. Your Majesty aided this old lady in embarking on the broad path of the sword, and I have nothing to repay you with, so I am willing to follow Your Majesty. I hope Your Majesty agrees."
She gave Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum a look.
Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum, along with the members of Lingjiu Palace, immediately knelt to the ground:
"We hope Your Majesty fulfills our wish!"
Their delicate and clear voices echoed throughout the Ten Directions Realm.
Ding Ling glanced at the group of the Heavenly Mountain Granny, fully understanding their intentions and plans. He did not disclose it openly, merely nodding as a gesture of agreement.
The Heavenly Mountain Granny was overjoyed, immediately expressing her gratitude once more.
Ding Ling waved his hand, indicating that they need not bow further.

Then he slightly bowed his head, holding the golden Sword Pill in his hand, and applied the Sacrificial Refining Techniques from the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship. In no time, he had successfully refined it, clang!
The Sword Pill instantly transformed into a Divine Sword without a hilt.

The Divine Sword was entirely golden, five feet long, exceptionally sharp, as if it could pierce through vajra and mountains. Compared to the Red Sword, this Golden Sword was noticeably more solid, sharp, and unrivaled.

Ding Ling flicked his finger, and the ringing sound reverberated across the ten directions. Just by hearing the sound, one could tell this Divine Sword far exceeded ordinary Divine Weapon and Magical Treasures!
It was by no means comparable to mundane weapons like the Heaven-Swaying Sword.
Even the Celestial Destiny Saber from the Wind and Cloud World couldn’t compare!
This sword was already like an immortal with spirit!
Absolutely an unparalleled Spirit Sword!

Inside the Golden Sword, Ding Ling sensed a lively Sword Qi wandering, this Sword Qi was extremely sentient, and when sensing Ding Ling’s Sword Thought probing, it actually conveyed thoughts of affection and trust to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling sensed it very clearly, his heart and spirit leapt, pondering:

"This Divine Sword is truly extraordinary. It harbors spirit within, and this spirit is naturally generated, with limitless potential! Unlike the Dragon Spirit in my Human Emperor Saber, which was infused into it. There’s a fundamental difference between Innate Sword Spirit and Acquired Sword Spirit, and their potential is naturally completely different."
The Human Emperor Saber, although extremely powerful!
Rightly called an unparalleled Divine Saber, with few comparable weapons in the world.
Even in terms of material, this Sword Pill is completely unmatched.
But in terms of potential in spirituality, the Human Emperor Saber cannot surpass this Golden Sword!
"Moreover, this Golden Sword’s Sword Pill reminds me of the Green Pearl I obtained back in the day!"
As they say, the Green Pearl.
Was a poison pearl from which the Scarlet Venom Toad, such Divine Object, was nurtured.
When Ding Ling first got the Green Pearl, he even gave it to the Lightning Mink, which evolved thanks to it, seeming to dilute the poisonous miasma within the Green Pearl significantly.
Earlier, Ding Ling was confused about what the Green Pearl was; he merely carried it around.
Now it seems.
This Green Pearl might also be a Sword Pill, different from the Red Sword’s fire attribute.
The Golden Sword’s metal attribute.
This Green Pearl might possess a poison attribute!

"And the Green Pearl came from the vicinity of the Valley of Eternal Spring. Thus, it seems likely that the Green Pearl also flew out from the Valley of Eternal Spring, fortuitously acquired and used by the Scarlet Venom Toad!"
Ding Ling felt relieved.
Yet, he puzzled over the mysterious Valley of Eternal Spring, wondering how someone like Chen Jinnan could have set foot in it?
Unless they ascended from the start and were placed in the Valley of Eternal Spring, then upon finding opportunities, were sent out by the Sword Pill?
What the truth is.
Ding Ling couldn’t ascertain either.
He inquired with Duan Zhengchun, the Heavenly Mountain Granny, and others.
They were equally baffled and only half-understood.
The Heavenly Mountain Granny knew more, as her Red Sword was indeed stolen.
Ding Ling urged her to explain in detail.

The Heavenly Mountain Granny looked around and saw many people around. Ding Ling waved his hand, taking her and the Lingjiu Palace members including Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum, flying out of Mount Heng Territory.

Duan Zhengchun, Duan Zhengming, Zhu Danchen, and others were a bit taken aback, wanting to follow, but how could they catch up to the high-flying Ding Ling? They could only watch as Ding Ling and the Heavenly Mountain Granny’s group flew farther and farther away.
"Such strength."
Duan Zhengchun sighed:
"My son-in-law is becoming more and more mighty, carrying a group of people, yet still flying so high, so fast!"

chapters.title: Chapter 837: Red Sword Origins
paragraphs: The phrase “virtuous son-in-law” was spoken with a resounding and powerful tone.
As if afraid no one would know.
The sense of honor and recognition in Duan Zhengchun’s words was clear for anyone to hear.

The onlookers understood, some showing jealousy, some envy, while others couldn’t help but laugh heartily as they approached Duan Zhengchun, calling out ‘Brother Duan,’ their flattery and desire to curry favor blatantly obvious!
Previously, everyone was embroiled in a relentless battle over the Golden Sword.
Now the Golden Sword was obtained by Ding Ling.
Yet no one dared to step forward to snatch it; all they could do was watch helplessly as Ding Ling flew away.
Once Ding Ling was out of sight.
Many couldn’t resist moving closer to Duan Zhengchun and his group.
Duan Zhengchun was the father-in-law of Ding Ling, the Emperor of the Immortal Realm!!
If one could gain Duan Zhengchun’s trust, then get closer to Ding Ling and earn his trust, one could surely rise to great heights and achieve success!
Thinking of this.
Many people’s hearts were ablaze, their gazes toward Duan Zhengchun filled with fervor.
Duan Zhengchun noticed all this and couldn’t help but feel even more pleased and proud.
He knew full well why the onlookers’ attitudes had changed so drastically toward him.
Merely because he had an invincible son-in-law!
Especially as his son-in-law seemed to traverse the Upper and Lower Realms freely! This alone was enough to fill countless people with fear and trepidation!
From this day forth.
Who would dare to challenge the Duan Family?
The more he thought about it, the more grateful and approving Duan Zhengchun felt towards Ding Ling.
Even though Ding Ling had never called him father-in-law, it didn’t hinder him from recognizing Ding Ling as his exemplary son-in-law!
Ding Ling, with Heavenly Mountain Granny and others, flew out of the Mount Heng Territory, landing in a forest.
The group with Heavenly Mountain Granny was shocked and amazed.
To take dozens of people flying through the sky in one go.
This power was enough to shake the heavens and weep ghosts! Truly astounding! As if a tale from Arabian Nights!
If not seen with one’s own eyes.
Who would believe it?
After steadying herself, Heavenly Mountain Granny composed herself and said:
“Your Majesty. I acquired my Red Sword from a master named Hoduo.”
“Hoduo?”
Ding Ling recalled the man, in the Divine Eagle World, Hoduo was lowly to the extreme for the sake of survival. He acted diligently and conscientiously, so Ding Ling spared him his life.
Unexpectedly, the scoundrel eventually left the Divine Eagle World and ascended to the Celestial Dragon World.
Moreover, it seemed he found unusual luck, entering the Valley of Eternal Spring and obtaining the Red Sword.
But unfortunately, he crossed paths with Heavenly Mountain Granny and was slain.
“Indeed.”

Heavenly Mountain Granny’s voice was somewhat hoarse, but it’s much nicer compared to before, indicating her Martial Arts and cultivation had advanced greatly and even her body showed signs of recovery:

“This man was cruel and lustful, extremely ruthless towards women. Relying on the sharpness of the Red Sword, he was able to control the sword and dominate a region, unchallenged, until I found him abusing his power on a woman in the Southern Shu Territory and killed him.”
Having said that.
She glanced at Ding Ling and saw him give a slight nod, which made her exhale in relief.

For when she was about to kill Hoduo, he invoked Ding Ling’s name, claiming him to be a loyal lieutenant of the Immortal Realm Emperor, which indeed startled Heavenly Mountain Granny, making her hesitate to act.
Later, Hoduo took the opportunity to escape, and only after he ran far did he mock Heavenly Mountain Granny, which enraged her, prompting her to pursue and kill him without restraint.
Seeing Ding Ling’s nonchalant expression, she realized her previous worries were entirely groundless.
What kind of venerable figure was Ding Ling?
How could he possibly cover for a scoundrel who indiscriminately killed and bullied vulnerable women?
With these thoughts in mind.
She calmed down, her apprehension dissipated, and she spoke more naturally:
“Before I killed Hoduo, I tortured him and extracted much useful intelligence from him...”
Heavenly Mountain Granny succinctly recounted the events.
It turned out that significant changes had occurred in the Valley of Eternal Spring.

To enter the Valley of Eternal Spring required infusing True Qi from the ‘Small Faceless Skill, North Nether Divine Skill, Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme’ into the bark of the Immortal Tree to activate a mysterious tunnel leading to the Valley of Eternal Spring.
After activating the tunnel.
One had to navigate correctly to traverse the Ten Extremes Array and reach the Valley of Eternal Spring.
But now.
These steps were omitted.
As long as one had a Sword Pill, one could effortlessly use Sword Control to enter and exit the mysterious tunnel.
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling asked:
“Have you been to the Valley of Eternal Spring?”
“I have.”
Heavenly Mountain Granny nodded and said:

“There is an abyssal region there, with raging waves, and occasionally sword light surges forth from it. The sword light of the Red Sword is of the same origin as that from there. I suspect they all emerge from those waters.”
“The waters of the abyss?”
Ding Ling was puzzled.
“Yes. The water in the abyss is rising daily, changing constantly. At the current rate, it’s estimated that in a few years, the water will overflow the abyss and affect our world.”
Speaking here.
Heavenly Mountain Granny couldn’t help but feel anxious:
“I was just at a loss on what to do when Your Majesty appeared. Now our world is safe.”
Ding Ling remained silent.
He initially intended to inspect the general situation of Dali’s Eternal Spring Valley but decided it would be better to return to Chang’an first.
He came down to earth precisely for his beloveds like Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing, Li Qinglu, and Little Dragon Girl.
Now that he’s here.
Of course, he should visit Zhong Ling and the others first.
Thinking of this, Ding Ling bid farewell to Heavenly Mountain Granny.
“Your Majesty, I wish to follow you!”
Heavenly Mountain Granny hurriedly said:
“Also, I hope Your Majesty can accept the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum. They’ve admired and liked Your Majesty for a long time.”
“I hope Your Majesty accepts us.”

The Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum were sharp, immediately kneeling on the ground, each raising their heads to look at Ding Ling, their big, watery eyes filled with hope and longing almost overflowing.

Ding Ling was speechless. He naturally understood that Heavenly Mountain Granny sending girls at this time was not only for the sake of the Lingjiu Palace’s girls but also for the future of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum as well as her own future.
This was a grand vision, a bold move, a significant investment!
Clearly.
Heavenly Mountain Granny had high expectations for Ding Ling, eager to place her bet!
Appearing concerned that Ding Ling might escape, never to return.
“Alright.”
Ding Ling wasn’t a man ruled by lust, but he also wouldn’t refuse charming young maidens who came to him willingly.
Of course, if it were a shallow, realistic, and hypocritical woman like Fang Yi, he wouldn’t accept her even if she were given to him. He didn’t want chaos in his harem.
Nor did he want to cause difficulties for Little Dragon Girl, Diao Chan, and others.
As for the nature of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum?
Ding Ling was skilled in the Observing People Skill, and with their vast disparity in cultivation, he could see through them at a glance.

chapters.title: Chapter 838: Sword Control Skill
paragraphs: It’s precisely because he knows the nature of the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum is commendable.
Ding Ling chose to accept them.
He hopes his women can live in harmony.
“Aren’t you going to thank Your Majesty?”
Heavenly Mountain Granny let out a sigh of relief and was infinitely joyful in her heart, quickly signaling the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum.
The four women immediately knelt in thanks.
Heavenly Mountain Granny was not wrong, for they had long admired and fell in love with Ding Ling, but had no fate to be with him.
Now, under the strong encouragement of the Heavenly Mountain Granny, Ding Ling chose to accept them.
How could this not make their hearts overflow with joy?!
They were originally pure people, showing their emotions of joy, anger, and sorrow on their faces.
At this moment, in their delight, the happiness on their faces almost shone through their very bones.
Ding Ling saw clearly and smiled slightly, saying:
“If that is the case, then let Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum come back to Chang’an with me. Grandma Tong, you can come along if you wish.”
“Everyone at Lingjiu Palace is willing to follow Your Majesty.”
Heavenly Mountain Granny promptly replied.
Over the years, she’d heard the most about the stories of Ding Ling.
It could be said.
If Ding Ling’s past ten years were written into a book, it would surely prove to be a legendary and supreme book about Ding Ling!
Heavenly Mountain Granny, having listened to so much, naturally had her heart stirred, resulting in emotions of awe and recognition.
Especially when hearing about Ding Ling’s deeds in the Wind and Cloud World and the Historical Plane, it seemed like tales from Arabian Nights, feeling as if the alien was boasting!
But when Ding Ling truly descended upon the Celestial Dragon Plane World, a casual move killed the Divine Archer and Sharpshooter with ease, a glimpse gave insight into his prowess.
Combined with Ding Ling’s speed and his learning ability in the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship, it left Heavenly Mountain Granny in awe, as if gazing upon a deity!
She profoundly realized the truth of the alien’s often-spoken phrase:
“To be recognized by Ding Ling is to save fifty years, even a hundred years! Two hundred years!”
Thus.
Seeing Ding Ling accepting the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum, and asked about her intentions.
How could Heavenly Mountain Granny hesitate? She immediately expressed her intention to follow Ding Ling, wanting to pull the entire Lingjiu Palace to join his team.
Ding Ling’s eyebrows slightly raised, deeply glancing at the Heavenly Mountain Granny, and when she felt a bit uneasy, Ding Ling finally said:

“If you wish to follow, then follow. I’ll first take the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum back to Chang’an. Once you reach Chang’an, you can report to Li Canghai. You should recognize her.”
“I do.”
Heavenly Mountain Granny said solemnly:
“I will certainly remember Your Majesty’s orders!”

Ding Ling nodded slightly, waved his hand, and a stream of vigorous qi swept out like a rainbow, instantly enveloping the waists and abdomens of the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum, swoosh!
Ding Ling flew away into the air.
This time, he chose the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship to fly.
A sword light flashed through the void.
Ding Ling had already left with the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum.
“The essence of the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship lies in the word ‘escape’. Your Majesty grasped its essence just by seeing it. Truly incredible.”
Heavenly Mountain Granny was in awe, after saying a few instructions to those around her, she headed towards Lingjiu Palace.
This time.
She prepared to take all of Lingjiu Palace’s people to Chang’an to cultivate!
With Ding Ling, the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum there.
She believed the girls of Lingjiu Palace could also find a good place to belong!
Although the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship is incomplete.
Its essence is no longer martial arts but a type of Daoist skill!
This Daoist skill, the True Qi from the Martial Dao True Understanding can also drive it, after all, the Martial Dao True Understanding is an Immortal level technique.
Using an Immortal-level technique to drive this top-notch Daoist skill, the resulting energy effect is far from being as simple as 1+1=2.
Swoosh swoosh!
The sword moved like a white-feathered meteor, carrying Ding Ling and his people through the air at an unparalleled speed.
Ding Ling stood on the tip of the golden sword.
The Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum stood on the sword’s body.

This golden sword, transformed from the Supreme Sword Pill by Ding Ling, became as large as a door panel with the power of Martial Dao True Understanding and Celestial Escape Swordsmanship enhancing it, resulting in this defying, explosive effect of flying with the sword through the air!
“Sword Control Skill!”
“So this is the Sword Control Skill of the Immortal Family?!”
The Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum exclaimed continuously.
“Indeed.”
Ding Ling nodded slightly.
Though the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship is incomplete, it also records methods of refining the Sword Pill and the Sword Control Skill.
This Sword Control Skill is divided into two parts.
Flying Sword!
Slaying Enemies with the Sword.
Compared to the Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root in the Wind and Cloud World, it’s obvious the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship is more advanced.
Even its incomplete original part is by no means inferior to Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root.
Especially its capability of flying while carrying people is unmatched by other sword techniques.
Other sword techniques find it difficult to turn a sword into a door panel and take people flying in the sky and through the earth!
But this Celestial Escape Swordsmanship can achieve it!
From this point, it’s evident that a great upheaval indeed occurred in the Valley of Eternal Spring, otherwise why would such a reverse Daoist skill and sword technique leak out?
“So fast, so fast!”
The Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum screamed all the way, looking at Ding Ling with watery eyes, full of recognition, shyness, joy, and excitement, so intense.
Swoosh swoosh!
The golden sword, under Ding Ling’s control, continuously flying and breaking through the air, after a period, reached Chang’an, descending from the sky, landing in the depths of the Imperial Palace.
At this moment.
Li Canghai was accompanying Li Qinglu, Zhong Ling, and Mu Wanqing in their cultivation.
Li Canghai held almost nothing back from the three, and with no shortage of Great Medicine and other resources, it allowed the three’s cultivation to advance rapidly in the past few years!
Today, they were discussing Dao.
Suddenly hearing the sound of breaking through the air, they could not help but look up in unison.
Upon seeing it, they were all surprised.
“Sword Control Skill?!”
“Is it Chen Jinnan, Jiunan, Su Qian?!”
“No, it’s not Jiunan, it’s, it’s, it’s my husband?!”
Initially, they concluded it was Chen Jinnan and others.
Naturally, because Chen Jinnan and others also knew the Sword Control Skill, and were quite famous.
Later, as Ding Ling got closer, Zhong Ling first recognized him, her eyes reddened slightly, her voice trembling:
“It’s truly my husband!”
Li Canghai actually recognized him earlier than Zhong Ling, but she did not point it out, choosing instead to stand up and silently gaze at Ding Ling.
It’s been a long time since she saw Ding Ling.
Seeing him again.
Li Canghai’s heart also thumped rapidly.
Only because she realized the changes in Ding Ling were far beyond her imagination!
She realized she could no longer see through Ding Ling at all.
Ding Ling, controlling his sword, stood in the void, an aura surging like the sea, unfathomable, boundless!
Just looking at him.
Li Canghai felt an overwhelming sensation, let alone confronting him!
“Over the years, Your Majesty indeed as the alien said, has experienced too much and changed so much!”
Li Canghai marveled in her heart.
As she watched Ding Ling and his sword land on the ground, she immediately stepped forward, saluted:
“Greetings to Your Majesty! Long live Your Majesty forever and ever!”
