chapters.title: Chapter 839: Zhong Ling and Her Companions' Transformation
paragraphs: Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing, and Li Qinglu were not as reserved as Li Canghai. Instead, they all rushed forward, throwing themselves into Ding Ling’s embrace, each calling out husband with deep emotion.
Holding the three women, Ding Ling offered comfort for a couple of moments. Once their emotions settled, he turned to Li Canghai and said:
‘Senior, we are all on the same side, so there’s no need to be so polite with me. Just call me by my name.’
“This...”
Li Canghai hesitated for a moment, then nodded.

Ding Ling’s great reputation and high cultivation left her in awe, almost as if beholding a deity or an imposing mountain, inherently inspiring a sense of reverence towards Ding Ling. How could she dare to be disrespectful?

But since Ding Ling said so, and as a member of the Carefree Sect, and knowing Ding Ling well, after thinking for a moment and adjusting her mindset, her attitude towards Ding Ling naturally experienced a subtle shift.
Becoming more familiar, trusting, and cordial!
Ding Ling was still the same Ding Ling!
He hadn’t become dismissive of Li Canghai simply because he became the Immortal Realm Emperor and was invincible in the Upper Realm.

Nor did he forget his wives in the Lower Realm after achieving high cultivation; instead, he made a special return to enhance his wives’ cultivation. How could such a devoted and virtuous man not win Li Canghai’s admiration, trust, and acknowledgment?
The group met again.
Naturally, they had endless things to say and emotions to express.
After a day passed.
Ding Ling began imparting the 1.0 version of the Martial Dao True Understanding to Li Canghai, Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing, Li Qinglu, and the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum.
Their insights and memory varied.
Hence, progress in the Martial Dao True Understanding also differed.
Li Canghai had the highest level of comprehension, stepping into the entry level of Martial Dao True Understanding in just a few days.
She was shocked by the profound and unfathomable mysteries of Martial Dao True Understanding, deeply grateful for Ding Ling’s generosity.
What sort of technique is Martial Dao True Understanding?
She had already memorized its contents, naturally aware, and because she understood, couldn’t help but feel awe, emotion, and excitement.
This counter-heaven technique surpasses the Eternal Youth Technique by countless degrees!
Yet Ding Ling gave it away as a gift.
Moreover, he explained its esoteric truths in detail, allowing her to enter the Martial Dao True Understanding.
If not for Ding Ling’s personal explanation, she couldn’t foresee when she would have entered, let alone figured it out.
Only because Martial Dao True Understanding is indeed too difficult, too complex, unfathomable! Mysterious!
As for the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling, it was different.
They achieved Innate Realm strength in less than a moment, thanks to Ding Ling utilizing the Empowerment Method!
The progress was so fast!
Even they couldn’t believe it themselves.
The observer Li Canghai was even more taken aback.
And in the following time.
Ding Ling didn’t go to the Dali Eternal Spring Valley.
Instead, he stayed in Chang’an City, cultivating a technique that only couples can cultivate with the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling.
Ding Ling was adept at this technique.
After all, he had cultivated this technique with Diao Chan and others on the Lower Realm Historical Plane for years.
But it was the initial contact for the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling, and progress was slow.
Ding Ling was not impatient, as long as one party attained Great Perfection, with the other cooperating well, it would allow rapid advancement in cultivation.
Under such circumstances.
The cultivation of the seven ladies improved day by day, growing stronger each day!
When the Heavenly Mountain Granny and her people from Lingjiu Palace arrived, the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum went to meet her.
The Heavenly Mountain Granny wore a face of disbelief, almost suspecting herself of hallucinating or misperceiving:
“Your, your cultivation?!”
“Reporting to the Venerable Lord.”

During this period, the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum became Ding Ling’s wives, harmoniously playing Qin and Zither with him, their faces blooming with peach-like beauty, as radiant as water.
Upon seeing the expression and demeanor of the Heavenly Mountain Granny, they knew what she wanted to know, and despite some shyness, they reported truthfully:
“It’s our husband who helped us...”
They succinctly described the situation.

But the Heavenly Mountain Granny read them well? Naturally understanding, along with envy, she was extremely shocked, unable to fathom Ding Ling possessed such a counter-heaven method to rapidly assist his wives in advancing!
But thinking further, the Ancient Yellow Emperor had managed three thousand women!
And Ding Ling, in cultivation, reputation, and achievements, surpassed predecessors!
Only seven wives after all.
Naturally, there’s no big problem.
Although.
The Heavenly Mountain Granny still felt inexplicably sour in her heart, somewhat jealous.
Given she endured so much hardship, exerted so much effort to achieve her current cultivation.
But what about the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum?
With Ding Ling’s help, they surpassed her cultivation swiftly.
How could this not make the Heavenly Mountain Granny jealous and envious to the point of ‘spitting blood’?!
If not for the fact that the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum were among her own, the Heavenly Mountain Granny would have fixed her eyes red with rage and interrogated them.
Fortunately, there’s no need for interrogation, the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum confessed voluntarily.
The Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum naturally saw the spirit and expression in the eyes of the Heavenly Mountain Granny.
Amidst jubilation and pride, they couldn’t help but appreciate, admire, and acknowledge Ding Ling even more.
Ding Ling.
Their husband.
Was remarkably good to them!
They must dutifully serve and attend to Ding Ling!
Unconsciously.
From being centered around the Heavenly Mountain Granny, they shifted their focus onto Ding Ling!
“Ahem ahem.”
The Heavenly Mountain Granny acknowledged her mindset was incorrect, her old face flushed slightly, she coughed twice to change the subject, saying:
“You are already Imperial Consorts of Your Majesty. From now on, don’t call the old woman Venerable Lord anymore. The old woman can’t bear it.”
“This... Yes!”
Indeed, the shift in focus.
The Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum hesitated only a moment, then nodded, starting to consider Ding Ling.
As Ding Ling’s wives, if they called the Heavenly Mountain Granny Venerable Lord, how should Ding Ling address the Heavenly Mountain Granny?!
The Heavenly Mountain Granny was at a loss for words.
She didn’t expect that so quickly, the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum, who revered her, were subdued by Ding Ling.

But then thinking that the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum were her own offering and she had come to align herself with Ding Ling, she compassed her inner vexation and told the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum:
“I wish to meet Your Majesty, still need to trouble the four Imperial Consorts for an introduction.
“Of course. Please wait, Grandma Tong.”
After all, they were accustomed to calling her Venerable Lord, transitioning to Grandma Tong felt unfamiliar.
They turned to call Ding Ling.
At this moment, Ding Ling was meeting with Xiaoo Feng and Xiaoo Yuanshan.
They were both extremely excited and joyful to meet Ding Ling again.
Xiaoo Yuanshan immediately knelt, loudly proclaiming long live Your Majesty.
Xiaoo Feng did the same.
But Ding Ling stopped him, smiled, and said:
“Now you are the emperor of the Great Ming Kingdom. As an emperor, do not kneel to me casually.”

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - 829: Passing Down the Law
paragraphs: Xiaoo Feng is a heroic figure, bold and decisive, with exceptional courage and insight.
Seeing Ding Ling speak this way,
he no longer insisted, but instead apologized sincerely:

"After hearing about the matter of the Dali Eternal Spring Valley, I worried day and night. So, I teamed up with my father to resolve a villain causing troubles everywhere and seized their Sword Pill. I then used Sword Control to fly into the Eternal Spring Valley to investigate. I stayed there for half a month. Just recently returned, I heard that Your Majesty has arrived in this realm, so my father and I hurried over to pay our respects to Your Majesty."
Ding Ling felt relieved.
He had been wondering why so many ministers had come with their visiting cards to see him one after another, yet Xiaoo Feng and his father were delayed. The reason was now clear.
He said:
"What’s the situation in the Eternal Spring Valley exactly?"

"The speed of the flood from the Abyss is increasing, and the decay aura from it is beginning to spread into the Eternal Spring Valley. At this pace, it might not be a few years before the area around Dali is inundated with this aura of decay. By then, the southern territory of our Great Ming Kingdom might become a wasteland, just a matter of time."
Xiaoo Feng’s speculation is quite similar to what the Heavenly Mountain Granny predicted.
Ding Ling said,
"I will handle this matter appropriately."
"With Your Majesty here, we can be at ease."
Xiao Yuanshan exhaled deeply and said with a smile,
"Previously, my son couldn’t sleep at night, filled with worry and sorrow. Now that Your Majesty has descended, what difficulty could truly be difficult for Your Majesty?"
The reason for their trust in Ding Ling is natural,
because of Ding Ling’s undefeated successes across various worlds.
Ding Ling roamed several worlds,
rarely failing!
He even established the Celestial Court in the Lower Realm, conferring deities! He is a generation of Immortal Realm Emperor!
Every single matter, any one taken at random, would be sung of for ages!
How could this not fill Xiaoo Yuanshan and Xiaoo Feng with confidence toward Ding Ling?
"I hope so."
Ding Ling didn’t dare guarantee, he only said:
"Once I have handled the matters at hand, I will go to the Dali Eternal Spring Valley to see the situation."
"Then we trouble Your Majesty."
While in conversation,
the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum came to report that the Heavenly Mountain Granny had arrived.
Ding Ling then invited the Heavenly Mountain Granny in as well.
Afterward,
Ding Ling didn’t waste time, directly imparting the 1.0 version of the Martial Dao True Understanding to the Heavenly Mountain Granny, Xiaoo Feng, and Xiaoo Yuanshan.
These three are now considered close allies.
This Martial Dao True Understanding had been passed on by Ding Ling to many already.
Passing it on to three more is naturally no problem.
Of course, what he taught to the Heavenly Mountain Granny included the Fundamental Technique of Martial Dao True Understanding and one Heaven-Flipping Palm!
Xiaoo Yuanshan and Xiaoo Feng received the Fundamental Technique and Divine Emperor Fist.

The reason for not teaching the Celestial Cry Saber Technique and others is that whether Heaven-Flipping Palm or Divine Emperor Fist are Immortal Level Skills, it takes at least a hundred or eighty years to cultivate them to Great Perfection.
Unless, like Ding Ling, they have exceptional talent or someone to explain to them day and night, keeping them in a constant state of epiphany.
Therefore, one technique and one skill are enough for them.
As the saying goes, knowing all trades is not as good as being a specialist in one.
The Heavenly Mountain Granny and others clearly understood this reasoning and were greatly grateful and reverent towards Ding Ling.
They truly realized the extraordinariness and excellence of the Martial Dao True Understanding!
The Heavenly Mountain Granny secretly felt she had bet on the right treasure!
If she hadn’t been decisive enough before, she might never have encountered such a great opportunity in her lifetime.
To her,
the imparting of the Fundamental Technique and Heaven-Flipping Palm was undoubtedly the greatest, most fate-defying fortune of her life!
If she could fully digest this fortune, ascending to the position of a deity would be no issue.
Xiaoo Yuanshan was also full of emotion, feeling that Xiaoo Feng had followed the right person! Being with such a majesty as Ding Ling is truly ancestral blessings! A blessing of three lifetimes!
Time flows like water.
In the blink of an eye, three months have passed.
The Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling, Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum, Mu Wanqing, and Li Qinglu have all successively reached the Grandmaster Peak.
The speed of progress,
completely surpassing Diao Chan and her group.
The reason for this,
naturally is because Ding Ling is not who he used to be.
In the Historical Plane of the Lower Realm,
initially, Ding Ling did not have the Celestial Heart Mark, thus he could not observe the Martial Dao True Understanding through it, and thus realize special fusion methods.
The Empowerment Method was realized during that time.
Before this, Ding Ling took several days to help Zhen Jiang and her group reach the Innate Realm.
Yet here, Ding Ling could accomplish it in moments — this is efficiency!
Precisely because he understands more techniques than in the Lower Realm,
efficiency naturally improved greatly.
Three months later,
Ding Ling calculated a bit.
To let the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling surpass the Grandmaster Peak threshold and enter the Shattered Realm, it would take at least a few more months.
So he decided they should cultivate on their own.
He prepared to visit the Dali Eternal Spring Valley.
"Let me accompany you, Your Majesty."
Li Canghai stepped forward to say.
"Let us accompany Your Majesty instead."
The Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling eagerly said.
Their own cultivation now so high, they can actually overpower Li Canghai and Heavenly Mountain Granny.
Yet because of the world’s restraints,
ordinary people cannot break them.
Even Ding Ling could not break it before.
But now, he has given the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling quite an advantage!
Naturally, Li Canghai and Heavenly Mountain Granny did not receive the same favor from Ding Ling, only progressing slightly in cultivation.
The reason for breaking the restraints,
is that Ding Ling can easily break the void of this world, hence the restraints of this realm do not exist for him.
Moreover, because the cultivation methods involved are those only practiced between husband and wife,
while cultivating, Ding Ling could clearly sense the world restraints Zhong Ling and they faced, and would help them break through those restraints!
It’s precisely due to Ding Ling’s presence that Zhong Ling and the others could repeatedly break the restraints and surpass themselves.
Currently, their foundations are unbelievably strong,
because each time they break a world restraint, they undergo a subtle transformation which is incredibly beneficial to Ding Ling, let alone to them.
This transformation,
Ding Ling calls "Dao Rhyme Adornment."
Because when cultivating the Divine Skills and Secret Techniques of spouses, this Dao Rhyme is something Ding Ling also enjoys, senses, and gains from.
Although each time he cultivates and breaks restraints with Zhong Ling, he only gains a small portion,
there are many of them.
Thus, the Dao Rhyme he gains is not much less than Zhong Ling and the others.
The increase in Dao Rhyme,
not only improved Ding Ling’s intelligence and comprehension greatly, but his meridians, Dantian, and bone potential all increased as well.
This is the strange change brought about by an ever-strengthening foundation.

Precisely because cultivation improved yet again, and Ding Ling discovered that breaking through the Shattered Realm’s restraint is extremely difficult, needing meticulous effort for months, or possibly even a year,
Ding Ling now has the idea of visiting the Dali Eternal Spring Valley.
At this moment, seeing Zhong Ling and others wanting to accompany him.

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - 830: Players Heated Discussion
paragraphs: Ding Ling thought for a moment, and agreed.
At present.
The group started heading south.
Along the way.
Li Canghai and Heavenly Mountain Granny used Lightweight Skill to travel quickly, only to find that the speed of Zhong Ling’s Seven Ladies was even faster, causing them to feel moved and astonished!
They looked at Ding Ling with more admiration, reverence, and astonishment.
It’s entirely clear to them that the speed and extraordinary achievements of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum, and Zhong Ling’s group were all due to Ding Ling!
If it weren’t for Ding Ling, the seven would merely be stronger than ordinary first-class experts.
Especially the cultivation of the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum, which could only be considered average and far inferior to the Three Ladies of Zhong Ling.
But now?
The Seven Ladies without exception.

Have all reached a level that Li Canghai and Heavenly Mountain Granny couldn’t fathom! Each one’s speed was extraordinary, their Lightweight Skills refined, and their cultivation profound, leaving Li Canghai and Heavenly Mountain Granny envious.
Sometimes, they wonder if they could cultivate Divine Technique with Ding Ling; would they also elevate their cultivation rapidly like riding a rocket?
But every time they think about this.
They blush with embarrassment, internally scolding themselves!
Afterwards.
They bury these thoughts deep within their hearts, not allowing them to surface easily.
After all, age and seniority are prominent here!
Zhong Ling’s Seven Ladies can be Ding Ling’s wives.
But they could never be.
Xiaoo Feng and Xiaoo Yuanshan, father and son, returned to the Luoyang Imperial Capital.

They wanted to follow Ding Ling to Dali Eternal Spring Valley to see what was happening, but as core members of the Great Ming Kingdom, they couldn’t stay away for long. They had already been gone for more than half a month, and then stayed with Ding Ling studying Martial Dao True Understanding for quite a while. Now, they needed to return to handle their political duties.
Ding Ling naturally couldn’t take them to Dali.
It wasn’t necessary.
After all, such abyssal flood issues can’t be solved merely by numbers.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Ten streams of light streaked across the Celestial Extreme in the void, and in the next instant, they landed on one of the peaks of the Wuliang Mountain Range.
This was where the Scarlet Venom Toad lay in its deep pool.
"Look quickly! It’s Ding Ling!
"Is it the Immortal Realm Emperor Ding Ling?!"
"And his concubines and queens!"
As Ding Ling’s group just landed on the mountain peak, a commotion immediately arose nearby.
This was because it was the core region of Dali Eternal Spring Valley.
The number of players, natives, and ascenders seeking opportunities here was countless.
Thus.
Many people gathered here daily.
Today was no exception.
Seeing Ding Ling’s arrival, players were in an uproar, natives were shaken, and ascenders were taken aback.
"Is he really the Immortal Realm Emperor Ding Ling?! Surely, he’s stylish and imposing! Just the aura of dominating the universe is unmatched!"

"Did you notice the cultivation of the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum? A few months ago, their cultivation was weak, merely serving as an accompaniment beside Heavenly Mountain Granny! Now their aura is concentrated and profound, seemingly stronger than Heavenly Mountain Granny! It’s unbelievable! No wonder others say as long as you hug Ding Ling’s thigh, ascending and achieving overnight success won’t just be a dream!"
Experts who had interacted with the Four Swords of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum in the Mount Heng Territory a few months ago were shocked and amazed by their aura!
Players, natives, and ascenders looked at Ding Ling with increasingly fiery passion!
Natives, after all, are ancient people, mostly composed.
But players recklessly screamed:
"Idol! Wow! I finally see my idol!"
"Ding Ling, I want to marry you!"
"Idol, when will you accept disciples and open a school? I’ll definitely be the first to kneel at the martial school door and give you an eight-hundred bow salute!"
Players’ shouting, screaming, cheering... it echoed throughout the Ten Directions Realm.
Natives and ascenders listened to it, facing each other with helplessness.
That’s just how players are!
Over the years, they’ve gotten used to it. Sometimes, they even envy the players’ carefree nature.
The behavior of shouting when they want and hugging thighs when they desire.
They also yearn for it from the bottom of their hearts, but unfortunately, they’re concerned about their dignity, often unable to let go of their pride.
"Husband."
Zhong Ling’s Seven Ladies looked at Ding Ling with watery eyes, the sense of glory in their gaze almost overflowing.
Li Canghai and Heavenly Mountain Granny also felt honored.
To follow a powerful emperor like Ding Ling is truly blessed by the stars! Lucky beyond measure!
"Let’s go.
Ding Ling didn’t want much interaction with the player group.
Even now.
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling traveled via Wind Control, flying down the mountain like a stream of light.
Heavenly Mountain Granny, Li Canghai, Zhong Ling’s Seven Ladies also activated their Lightweight Skill to follow, each moving extremely fast, like lightning, vanishing without a trace in an instant.
Players shouted for a long time, seeing no response from Ding Ling, they felt somewhat disappointed, each whispering amongst themselves:
"Seems like Ding Ling, the game’s top Great God, really doesn’t plan to open a martial school or academy in the real world!"

"Ah. It’s such a shame. If he opened a martial school or academy, it would surely become the world’s top-level institution! At that time, celebrities, honor students from all over the world would gather in the Central Plains. What a glorious scene that would be! What prestige for our ancestors!"
"It’s evident that Ding Ling has higher aspirations. He can now withstand nuclear bombs. Money isn’t a concern. Do you think he’d settle for merely ancestral prestige?"
"You’re right. Ding Ling is probably pursuing immortality now!!"
Speaking of immortality.
Everyone’s heart instantly became fervent!

Especially some ascenders. Many among them were Princes, emperors, heroes, martial arts heroes; after ascending to the Celestial Dragon Plane World, they became ordinary. Though they still have loyal followers, compared to their former life of commanding thousands and spending lavishly, naturally, it’s a stark contrast.
But their goal aligns with Ding Ling’s, they are pursuing immortality!
Thus, mere external allurements can rarely sway their minds!
Now hearing players discuss like this, each ascender couldn’t help but be swayed, all wondering how to hug Ding Ling’s thigh without appearing humble or fawning?
After all.
Currently, the most effective way to achieve immortality seems to be holding onto Ding Ling’s thigh!
Like Cao Mengde, Dian Wei, Cao Ang, Xiahou Yuan, just by hugging the thigh in time, each became divine and immortal!
Unfortunately.
Most of them come from The Deer and the Cauldron, Green Blood Sword planes or from Romantic Swordsman and other planes, but they have no chance to ascend in the Historical Plane.
Thus, now focusing their efforts on Ding Ling’s, is naturally quite normal.
Ding Ling doesn’t know what outsiders think.
He doesn’t opt to investigate.
Once cultivation and strength reach a certain level, one just needs to move forward boldly, aiming for the heights.
At this moment.
He led Heavenly Mountain Granny’s group, already arrived near the deep pool.

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - 831: The Immortal Tree Speaks
paragraphs: Here.
Ding Ling indeed saw that mysterious tunnel.
Even the Divine Meditation Technique illuminated a surrounding area of two hundred miles, allowing Ding Ling to roughly perceive the internal conditions of the Valley of Eternal Spring.
Although compared to the 3D stereoscopic map of the outside world, the stereoscopic map within the Valley of Eternal Spring is more ambiguous.
However, with Ding Ling activating the Spiritual Eye and Heaven-Reaching Ear, he could roughly sense the situation within.
As expected, it was just as Heavenly Mountain Granny and Xiao Feng had said.
In the abyss, floodwaters were running rampant, and sword glows were soaring.
However, what differed slightly from their descriptions was that the rate at which the floodwaters rose seemed much faster than they had claimed.
As Ding Ling saw it now.
After a year or two.
The flood could potentially spread into the Valley of Eternal Spring and then flow outwards to the outside world.
Compared to the sturdiness of the world within the Valley of Eternal Spring, the outside world is obviously more fragile, posing a challenge to withstand such abyssal floodwaters for even a few days.
Not to mention for several years.
Before, Xiao Feng had already considered the situation to be quite severe.
But the fact was, if the abyssal floodwaters spread to the outside world, the entire human realm could be annihilated because of this.
"This aura?"
Ding Ling focused his attention, staring into the depths of the tunnel.

His vision was extraordinarily sharp, and besides, the Carefree Ten Extremes Array was now dilapidated, battered by the flood to the point of losing its structure, allowing ordinary first-class experts to easily navigate the mysterious tunnel with the Sword Pill.
Of course.
Only those who acquire the Sword Pill could rely on its resonance with the sword glows within the abyssal floodwaters to avoid the attacks of the Carefree Ten Extremes Array.
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But he still decided to give it a try.

He let the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling wait outside, took out the Sword Pill, and with the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship, activated the Sword Pill, which instantly transformed into a Divine Sword radiating a shifting halo!
Ding Ling stepped onto the Divine Sword, whizz!
In an instant, he vanished before the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling.
Heavenly Mountain Granny wanted to follow but, remembering Ding Ling’s words, could only suppress her anxiety and curiosity, waiting in place.
Whizz!
Ding Ling arrived at the Ten Extremes Array.
Feeling entirely different from previous experiences.
Previously, entering here required the bark of the Immortal Tree as a guide, and understanding the correct positioning of the array was necessary.
Now, however, just holding a Sword Pill seemed to automatically open up opportunities, allowing Ding Ling to freely come and go.
"It seems this Sword Pill must have a significant connection with the person who laid the Carefree Ten Extremes Array. Could it be that the array’s architect is indeed the master of the Sword Pill?"
Because they are of the same origin.
The Ten Extremes Array shows special leniency to the holder of the Sword Pill.
The actual circumstances.
Are hard to know.
Ding Ling does not seek answers for now, knowing many truths can often be revealed easily when one’s strength reaches a certain point.
If the strength is insufficient.
Rashly pondering and speculating only entraps oneself, leading to suffering.
Throughout his journey, Ding Ling had long realized this, so he decisively repressed the bewilderment in his heart and continued advancing.
Whizz!
He soon reached above the abyssal floodwaters.
Here, he could sense streams of Sword Qi violently soaring and shooting.
As expected, this Sword Qi was exactly as Heavenly Mountain Granny had described, and it shared the same origin as the Red Sword and Golden Sword.
Each blast of Sword Qi was extremely strong; a regular first-class expert falling here would face certain death.
Chen Jinnan and others survived, presumably because they received the protection of the Sword Pill.
Ding Ling was just contemplating why Chen Jinnan and his group had suddenly vanished recently.
When suddenly he noticed a strange commotion in the Valley of Eternal Spring.
He made a swift movement, bypassing the peach grove, arriving at the center of the grassland, and stood beside the Immortal Tree.
This tree seemed to have begun to decay.
Previously vibrant and seemingly immortal, it now bore scars, and its once green leaves were dotted with yellow spots, resembling a gravely ill patient on the brink of death.
Vaguely, Ding Ling heard someone speaking.
"It hurts."
"Big brother, help me."
The voice was gentle and weak.
Like a little girl speaking.
Ding Ling initially questioned if it was an illusion but soon realized that he was indeed invincible in the Lower Realm.
Moreover, even in the Wind and Cloud Upper Realm, he singlehandedly subdued an empire.
How could he possibly have random delusions?!
He looked at the Immortal Tree, pondered, and infused Martial Dao True Understanding’s True Qi into it.
The True Qi roared, brimming with absolute vitality, possessing formidable healing power, unmatched by ordinary Divine Skills.
Once the True Qi was injected into the Immortal Tree.
Vaguely, Ding Ling heard the little girl’s voice again.
"Ah, that feels so nice. Thank you, big brother."
Ding Ling was taken aback.
Has this Immortal Tree become sentient?!
He thought for a moment and asked:
"Are you the Immortal Tree?"
No response came.
Ding Ling shook his head, continuing to input True Qi.
Meanwhile, the Divine Meditation Technique illuminated a radius of one hundred miles.
The Valley of Eternal Spring’s world was indeed much sturdier than the outside, illuminating only one hundred miles.
But even so.
It was entirely sufficient.
Because the valley was inherently small, the reach of Ding Ling’s Divine Meditation Technique could extend fifty miles into the abyssal floodwaters.
He sensed clearly.
With the revival of the Immortal Tree.
The floodwaters seemed to rage?
Splashing increasingly stronger waves across the world, the rate accelerating, with decay-laden torrents threatening to engulf the entire valley.
But all were forcibly suppressed by the rushing Sword Qi.
Simultaneously.
The Immortal Tree and Fountain of Youth were glowing, seemingly aiding the sword glows in suppressing the floodwaters.
"So that’s it."
Ding Ling realized.
He previously wondered what the purpose of the Valley of Eternal Spring was?

Now, it seems clear it is meant to suppress floodwaters from the abyssal realm. These waters are laden with evil, decay, and obliterating aura; should they spread to Jiuzhou Territory, Jiuzhou would inevitably decay and perish.
Ding Ling certainly does not want Jiuzhou to collapse.

After all, Diao Chan and others are destined to ascend in the future, and if they happen to ascend to this Celestial Dragon World, wouldn’t they be unlucky encountering these decaying annihilating forces?!
Plus, Little Dragon Girl, Qu Feiyan, Hua Tuo, Zhao Zilong, and the rest.
Most of Ding Ling’s relatives and friends are in the Lower Realm.
Moreover, during ascension, there’s a one-third chance of ascending to the Celestial Dragon Plane. Some certainly will ascend to this realm.
Thus, Ding Ling naturally opts for saving this world.
Therefore.
The speed at which he injected True Qi into the Immortal Tree was further accelerated.
"Ah, this feels so nice, so nice."
The little girl’s voice resounded again.
This time it was tinged with delight:
"Thank you, big brother."
"Are you the Immortal Tree?"
Ding Ling asked again.
This time the little girl did not evade but carefully responded:
"Big brother, you, can you hear my voice?"
"Indeed."
"Ah, how can this be? You can actually hear my voice?! A few years ago when you came here, you could not hear me at all. How has it only been a few years, yet now you can hear me?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 843: Divine Mountain Sea
paragraphs: The little girl seems quite annoyed.
Ding Ling is puzzled:
“My cultivation and techniques have strengthened, so hearing you speak is normal, right? Why do you look so troubled?”
“Not normal at all.”
The little girl said crisply:
“My mother said that ordinary immortals can’t hear me speak. But you can hear. How strange!”
“Immortals?”
Ding Ling was surprised: “Who is your mother?”
“You’ve seen her.”
“I’ve seen her?!”
Ding Ling was confused.
“The Celestial Maiden that was reflected from the stone monument image a few years ago is my mother!”
The girl’s voice is soft and crisp, like a cute two or three-year-old’s talking, even with a nasal tone!
When she mentioned her mother, the girl’s voice was full of longing and attachment, almost tangible.
“A few years ago?”
Ding Ling remembered:
“Is she the remarkable beauty buried with the Celestial Ladder, who planted the Immortal Tree seedling and erected the stone monument?!”
“That’s her.”
The girl’s voice had a hint of joy:
“You indeed remember my mother.”
“Who is your mother?”
Ding Ling asked.
“Her name is Divine Mountain Sea.”
“Divine Mountain Sea?”

Ding Ling had never heard such a name, searching through ancient texts and novels would hardly find it. Unsurprisingly, this Divine Mountain Sea is certainly not a native figure of the Wuxia or Xianxia world.
Otherwise, he didn’t know either, or someone beyond his imagination.
“What is your name then?”
“I don’t have a name.”
The girl’s voice was somewhat disheartened:
“But when my mother buried me, she seemed to call me Little Mountain Sea, though I can’t clearly remember. But I’ve decided to use this name.”
“Little Mountain Sea. Do you remember any other things about your mother? Do you know where she went?”
“I don’t know.”
Little Mountain Sea seemed very bewildered:

“Mother has not appeared in many, many years. I’ve been alone here for so long. In all these years, I’ve met only about a dozen people. But they weren’t very friendly to me; they often peeled off my skin and carved words on me.”
Ding Ling was speechless and awkward.
He had also peeled off the bark!
But as the Martial Dao True Understanding constantly infused, the scars and carved words on Little Mountain Sea’s body started to fade.
“It feels so good, so comfortable.”
Little Mountain Sea’s tree body shivered, shaking her yellow-spotted leaves at Ding Ling:
“Thank you, big brother.”
“Do you know what’s going on with the water of the abyss?”
“Yes, I know.”
Little Mountain Sea said crisply:
“Mother told me. She said it was Void Nether Soul Zombie. She tasked me to guard here, preventing Void Nether Soul Zombie from escaping this realm.”
Speaking of this.
She paused, seemingly a little gloomy and self-reproaching:
“But my powers have reached a bottleneck, unable to progress, while Void Nether Soul Zombie continues to advance day and night. At this rate, I can’t hold on. Luckily, big brother, you came.”
Little Mountain Sea’s voice was full of excitement:

“Your True Qi is so powerful! Among the dozen people I’ve seen, you are the most formidable and exceptional. That Duan Siping and Murong Longcheng are far inferior. Not only couldn’t they hear me speak, but they were also captured by Void Nether Soul Zombie, becoming its puppets.”
“Puppets? Captured?”
“Yes, indeed.”
Little Mountain Sea said crisply:

“They wanted immortality, wanting to further ascend, so they climbed the Celestial Ladder to the Celestial Court. But little did they know that all the immortals in that Celestial Court were long dead. Their venture turned out to be a sheep entering the tiger’s den, resulting in being devoured by Void Nether Soul Zombie.”
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling broke out into a cold sweat:
“I also went to the Celestial Court.”
“I know.”
Little Mountain Sea ‘shook’ her leafy head, seemingly responding to Ding Ling:
“I exerted all my strength to hold back the abyss flood, preventing them from spreading, so you weren’t killed.”
Ding Ling turned, puzzled: “Then why is it that Duan Siping and the others...?”
He didn’t continue to speak.
But the meaning was clear.
Little Mountain Sea seemed a bit ashamed, her leafy head all drooped down:

“I was inexperienced at first. Therefore, the Void Nether Soul Zombie exploited the loophole, capturing and controlling Duan Siping and others. Later, when you all arrived, I already had the experience.”

Ding Ling was speechless and also secretly fortunate, thankful that Duan Siping and the others went to explore first; had it not been so, falling into the abyss would have definitely been him and Li Canghai.
“But fortunate that big brother, you didn’t venture deep into the Hongyuan under the Broken Bridge of the Celestial Court. Otherwise, even I couldn’t save you.”
“That Hongyuan?”
“It is the branch linking the abyss ahead, the Void Nether Soul Zombie.”
“Is Void Nether Soul Zombie human or ghost? Or is it a god?”
“None of them.”
Little Mountain Sea’s leaves collectively pointed to the void directly in front of Ding Ling:
“It is the Forbidden Realm, the Void Nether, the Empty Realm. In short, it is a world!”
“A world?”
Ding Ling looked forward, it was outside the valley mountains, a Forbidden Realm territory, a gray area, boundless.
This Forbidden Realm could corrode and decay all substances.
Years ago, Ding Ling tested it by throwing a bowl out; within two breaths, it turned to ashes!
But back then, he had just reached the Initial Tier of Grandmaster.
His cultivation, compared to now, is vastly different.
Originally he couldn’t withstand Forbidden Realm’s corrosion and erosion.
It doesn’t mean he can’t now.
Thinking so.

Ding Ling waved his hand, the Sword Pill was thrown out, then exhaled a breath, swoosh! The Sword Pill instantly became the Divine Sword, like a stream of light flashing across the void, the next moment, it had already reached the sky above the gray region.
Clang clang!
The Divine Sword was vibrating.
It seemed full of hostility towards this Forbidden Realm.
This was the Divine Sword’s own spirit issuing warnings and fury, clang clang! Sharp streams of Sword Qi swept the Forbidden Realm in all directions.
Once this Divine Sword made contact with the Forbidden Realm, it began to unleash unparalleled power.

This was the Divine Sword’s innate ability, it seemed born to counter the Forbidden Realm, not only did it not decay, but its sword radiance became even brighter, showing a tendency to fight more valiantly within the decaying ambiance.
Ding Ling turned to look at Little Mountain Sea:
“This sword?”
“It is Lü Dongbin’s sword!”
“Lü Dongbin?!”
“Yes.”
Little Mountain Sea said crisply:

“One of the ancient Eight Immortals refined a sword, using the Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array to suppress the abyss flood. Now, the swords they refined were forced out by the flood, hence the flood became increasingly rampant, even I’m about to be decayed. Luckily, big brother appeared in time. Otherwise, I’d be doomed.”
Little Mountain Sea seemed very grateful to Ding Ling, constantly shaking her leaves, even inclining the leafy head to brush against Ding Ling’s cheek:
“Thank you, big brother.”
“The swords of the Eight Immortals?”
Ding Ling was puzzled why it was eight Sword Pills.
Now he understood.
It’s evidently referring to the Eight Immortals, these eight individuals.
That puzzled him. Previously, the green Sword Pill he obtained, whose was it then?!

chapters.title: Chapter 844: Eight Immortals' Deeds
paragraphs: Ding Ling asked about the matter.
Little Mountain Sea also expressed not knowing.
Ding Ling then inquired about the Eight Immortals’ whereabouts.
Little Mountain Sea’s leaves drooped and gloomily said:
“They’re all dead.”
‘Even immortals can die?’
Ding Ling was moved:
“Are you sure the Eight Immortals weren’t just thoughts transformed, or perhaps merely avatars?”
“Not thoughts.”
Little Mountain Sea said crisply:

“Although I don’t remember things about my mother, I remember some events that occurred in the Celestial Court. Those Eight Immortals were powerful figures in the Ancient Era, traversing vast areas, nothing like thoughts incarnate, nor like avatars.”
“So, they were real immortals?”
Ding Ling was surprised:
“True Gods were actually killed by this Void Nether Soul Zombie?!”
“They went to their deaths willingly.”
Little Mountain Sea shook her leaves, seemingly deep in recollection:

“I remember they refined eight Divine Swords with their Primordial Spirits and heart’s blood to suppress the Abyssal Flood. The Divine Swords together restrained the flood, thereby averting the total destruction and decay of the Celestial Court and the Valley of Eternal Spring.”
She paused and continued:
“But now I’m about to hold out no longer. If you, big brother, hadn’t come, I might have died a while ago.”
She seemed exceptionally innocent and pure, speaking of death without much fear, her voice youthful, pleasant, and clear, like the tinkling of a Spiritual Spring cascading over rocks:
“Oh my, my previously peeled skin is almost healed, you know. Thanks, big brother.”
It wasn’t just the skin.
Even the lines ‘Duan Siping was here’ and ‘Murong Longcheng was here’ had completely disappeared.
Little Mountain Sea’s tree body was beginning to recover vitality.
The yellow spots covering her head gradually turned green.
Ding Ling’s Martial Arts True Qi’s restoration strength was notable.
“No need to thank me.”
Ding Ling smiled and said:
“You restrained this Void Nether Soul Zombie for the living beings, your merit is immeasurable. I should be the one thanking you.”
“This was the thing I was supposed to do.”
Little Mountain Sea said crisply:

“I’m usually asleep, rarely awake. I only wake for a moment when someone comes. But none of those people have saved or helped me. Only big brother is an exception, so of course, I need to thank you, big brother.”
Ding Ling stopped dwelling on the matter, changed the topic, and said:
“Have all the immortals in the Celestial Court died? How did they die?”
“They died in the battle against the Void Nether Soul Zombie.”
Little Mountain Sea again seemed lost in memory, ‘full-headed’ leaves swaying occasionally:

“The Void Nether Soul Zombie is shapeless and formless, hidden deep in the void, extremely hard to detect. The ancient gods fought the Void Nether Soul Zombie for hundreds or thousands of years, until the last one standing managed to suppress it into the Abyssal Flood. Normally, it remains out of sight, only appearing when people come, trying to tempt them, turning them into puppets for its use.”
“Isn’t the Void Nether Soul Zombie a world?”
“Yes.”
Little Mountain Sea said crisply:
“It is a world. But it can manifest countless enemies within its world.”
“Enemies within the world.”
Divine Mountain Sea?
Ding Ling was stirred in thought, asking:
“Is your mother from the Upper Realm? Is her true identity the Mountain and Sea Realm?!”
The Furnace Spirit of the World Furnace once said the Upper Realm has nine Mountain and Sea Realms.
And the Mountain and Sea Realm is the mother that bore Spirit!
“Mountain and Sea Realm?”
Little Mountain Sea was puzzled, but instinctively shook her leafy head:

“Possibly, perhaps. I don’t know much about my mother. She left in a hurry, leaving only some information points about the Celestial Court, Earth Realm, and how to suppress the Abyssal Flood. Other than that, I know nothing.”
If the Divine Mountain Sea really is the god that nurtures Spirit.
Then at least two of the nine Mountain and Sea Realms have already fallen.
And the enemy comparable to the Divine Mountain Sea, the Void Nether Soul Zombie, must also be a World God capable of nurturing ‘Spirit’.
However, the ‘Spirit’ born in the world of the Void Nether Soul Zombie behaves incredibly eerily, sinisterly, and powerfully.
Even the ancient gods found it hard to resist, leading to their complete annihilation, leaving only some Sword Pills and remnants as proof they once fought and struggled for this world.
“Then why didn’t Duan Siping kill me at the time?”
Ding Ling suddenly thought of this point.

“Because I was restraining the Abyssal Flood, only then did Duan Siping, emerging from the Hongyuan, have a brief chance to regain clarity of mind. Otherwise, in his madness, he would not have recognized anyone.”
“I see.”
Ding Ling was relieved.
So it turns out he survived.
It was all thanks to Little Mountain Sea exerting power in the lower Earth Realm.
At that time, he couldn’t hear Little Mountain Sea’s voice at all.
And did some things that hurt Little Mountain Sea.
Yet, Little Mountain Sea not only didn’t hold grudges but repeatedly helped him, saving him.
It shows the utmost simplicity and kindness of Little Mountain Sea’s heart!
To turn weapons of war into gifts of peace is already commendable.
To transform an enemy into a friend is rare indeed.
To fully accept someone who harmed oneself and be willing to help them wholeheartedly is a level of thought and moral conduct beyond human imagination!
“Divine Mountain Sea, Little Mountain Sea...”
Ding Ling sighed deeply.
As expected of the progeny of the Divine Mountain Sea, such inclusiveness, tolerance, and benevolence is exceedingly rare.
Whew! Whew!
Ding Ling’s Martial Arts True Qi, infused into Little Mountain Sea, became increasingly rich, causing Little Mountain Sea to frequently exclaim, ‘Oh how comfortable, how comfortable’.
As Little Mountain Sea continued to heal.
Ding Ling noticed that the more violently the abyssal flood raged and surged, the higher and more frightening the waves became.
These waves seemed at times about to engulf Ding Ling.
But each time it reached the Valley of Eternal Spring, it would be driven back by the faint glow emanating from the Immortal Tree and the Fountain of Youth.
As the Immortal Tree fully recovered.

The faint glow turned into streaks of fine light, shooting throughout the Ten Directions Realm, weaving into a net and array, repelling the Abyssal Flood back and quickly restoring the Carefree Ten Extremes Array.
The mysterious passage vanished again within the Mortal Realm.
To reappear, the Abyssal Flood would have to overflow and the Immortal Tree decay again.
“Thank you, big brother. I’m all right now.”
Little Mountain Sea’s entire tree body bent down, seeming to bow to Ding Ling as a gesture of thanks.
Ding Ling smiled, took a step back to avoid the courtesy, and said:
“Little Mountain Sea, can I kill that Void Nether Soul Zombie in the Abyssal Flood?”
The Void Nether Soul Zombie is a world.
The ‘Spirit’ it nurtures is also called Void Nether Soul Zombie.
Just like the Divine Mountain Sea, the ‘Spirit’ it nurtures is also called Little Mountain Sea.
“You probably can.”
Little Mountain Sea seemed to be thinking:
“I will cooperate well with big brother. As long as I cooperate well with big brother, I think that Void Nether Soul Zombie will not be your match.”
Saying this.
Little Mountain Sea shook her body, and suddenly a small seedling emitting a faint glow flew out:
“Big brother, this is my ‘Spirit’. You can take it, and it will guide your path forward and assist you in refining the Void Nether Soul Zombie.”

chapters.title: Chapter 845: Return to the Celestial Court
paragraphs: Ding Ling listened, his spirit lifted, and he took a step forward, carefully holding the small sapling in his palm.
“Big brother, I’ll clear the way for you.”

Just as Little Mountain Sea’s voice fell, there was a booming sound, and the stone monument standing beside him suddenly flew up. The celestial ladder, which had been suppressed, pierced through the sky like a silver thread.
Ding Ling was surprised why it didn’t go directly into the abyss behind him.
Little Mountain Sea replied:

“The abyss is the main trunk. The Celestial Court’s Hongyuan is a branch. We pick the soft targets first. We’ll first eliminate the weaker Void Nether Soul Zombies in the branch, then kill those in the main trunk. Once all the Void Nether Soul Zombies are dead, I might transform and evolve.”
“Oh?”
Ding Ling turned his gaze, intrigued:
“What’s going on?”

“I didn’t know what was happening before either. It was just when the ‘Spirit’ parted and landed in your palm, suddenly some pieces of information and knowledge appeared in my mind. They made me realize that I too could transform!”
Little Mountain Sea said gleefully:

“Every time big brother kills a Void Nether Soul Zombie, the spirit absorbs a bit of the world power from the corpse. Once it’s absorbed enough, the spirit will feed back to me, and I’ll be able to transform.”
“World power?”
Ding Ling was puzzled.
Ding Ling had heard of such power before.
But when it came to actually extracting and utilizing it, it was beyond his capability.
The Grotto Heaven Structure of the Sword Spirit also had the potential to develop into a world.
But it was still far from achieving a true world.
He wondered if this time there would be an opportunity?
Thinking this, Ding Ling decisively stepped onto the celestial ladder, swish swish swish!
He moved very swiftly.
In the blink of an eye, he covered over a hundred miles, ascending to the top of the celestial ladder in mere moments.
Ding Ling set foot on the earth realm, scanning the surroundings.
The difference from before was that the greenish mist on the other side of the chasm in the Celestial Court had grown thicker.
Ding Ling stepped out, moving to the position above the chasm.
A few years ago.
When he came here, he was extremely cautious, and even stepping above this chasm felt as if an invisible force locked him in place, making his body feel immensely heavy.
Nowadays, he no longer felt that way.
The constraining power in the chasm was like a gentle breeze against his face, insignificant.

Thinking back, his cultivation was then around Initial Tier Grandmaster, but now with the Sword Spirit upon him and the Spirit of Little Mountain Sea accompanying him, defeating a Middle Tier Primordial Spirit expert was no longer an issue, a world of difference from before.
Tap tap!
Ding Ling stepped over the hundred-zhang chasm, landing in the Celestial Court, and continued forward.
The greenish mist enveloped him.
The poisonous substance within could instantly kill a Shattering Level martial artist!
But to Ding Ling, it caused no harm.
Not only was he immune to all poisons, but because of Little Mountain Sea’s Spirit emitting a faint light continuously, the mist retreated, and no evil approached!
Passing through the South Celestial Sect, a single leap covered several miles.
In an instant.
Ding Ling arrived at the Broken Bridge.
Leaning down to look.
He could see a Hongyuan below.
In the Hongyuan, torrents raged, and the greenish mist continuously rose as if trying to engulf Ding Ling.
“This is the place.”
Ding Ling remembered clearly.
Duan Siping had once leaped from here, sending him flying with one palm strike!
If not for Ding Ling using the Six Meridian Divine Sword to clear Duan Siping’s mind a bit, he might very well have been killed by Duan Siping.
Of course.
That’s what he thought.
In hindsight, it was evident that Little Mountain Sea secretly helped, allowing Duan Siping’s mind to regain some clarity, enabling Ding Ling to survive.
“At that time, I considered myself highly skilled and brave. Little did I know I was walking on the brink of Ghost Gate’s barriers.”
Ding Ling felt a hidden gladness.
He was fortunate to have been cautious back then. Upon sensing something amiss, he quickly fled.
If he had been too curious and jumped into the abyss to find out what was really going on, as Little Mountain Sea said, even she wouldn’t be able to save him.
“But times have changed. Coming back a few years later, I can now easily crush Duan Siping. Coming here now poses little challenge.”
Ding Ling activated the ‘Profound Yin Sword Armor,’ sword qi swirling around him.

At the same time, he also activated the Celestial Escape Swordsmanship, clang! The sword spirit, highly intelligent, manifested as a divine sword hovering by Ding Ling’s right side, prepared for any eventuality.
Ding Ling, holding Little Mountain Sea’s spirit, took an instant step and leaped into the abyss.
Plop!
Like a fish leaping into the sea, a splash followed.
Ding Ling’s figure soon vanished into the depths of the Hongyuan.
Shush shush shush!
Diving all the way down.
Ding Ling discovered the Hongyuan was extremely deep, seemingly tens of thousands of meters.
Ding Ling descended rapidly, and the deeper he went, the greater the pressure, but such pressure was lethal to a Grandmaster.
For Ding Ling, it was like a light rain falling on his body, utterly harmless.
The small sapling kept emitting a faint white light.
The white light turned into a pointer, at times guiding forward, at times to the right.
Like this for a while.
When Ding Ling reached a depth of ten thousand zhang in the Hongyuan, he saw a palace embedded in the earth’s mountain cliffs.
Two figures stood at the palace entrance.
Without exception.
They were clad in solid armor, over nine feet tall, their appearances shrouded in the greenish mist, resembling fierce warriors.
With just one glance.
Ding Ling recognized one of them:
“Duan Siping!”
“And the other?”
Ding Ling looked at the nine-foot-tall fierce warrior on the left, but before he could speak, Little Mountain Sea’s crisp voice came from the sapling:
‘It’s Murong Longcheng and Duan Siping.’
“So it’s these two.”
Ding Ling took an instant step to the palace entrance. Before he could even land, Murong Longcheng and Duan Siping suddenly launched an attack on him!
Swish swish swish!
One used the Six Meridian Divine Sword, the other the Canhe Finger!

In an instant, sword qi and finger force flowed like arrows and flying spears in the torrents! It was as if the torrents amplified and enhanced them with infinite power; each sword qi and finger force was immensely powerful, capable of piercing through mountains and the Celestial Palace.
“Shattered Peak Combat Power.”
Ding Ling saw it at once.
His heart also trembled with surprise.
He was lucky he fled years ago.
Otherwise, a mere Grandmaster facing such opponents would have no chance of survival.
Fortunately, now.
These tactics were to him nothing more than drizzle ‘tickling’ him.
Clang clang!
The sword qi and finger force fell upon him, causing no harm.
“Hmm?!”

Murong Longcheng and Duan Siping’s bodies quivered, their eyes widening as if in shock. Ding Ling, however, ignored it, knowing from Little Mountain Sea’s explanation that these two had become puppets, beyond saving, and had to be killed.
Thus, Ding Ling casually slapped his palm.
With two resounding booms, Duan Siping and Murong Longcheng instantly turned into green mist and blood, scattering away.
“Dust to dust, ashes to ashes!”
“Thank you, little brother, for fulfilling this task!”
Vaguely.
Ding Ling seemed to hear two sighs of fulfillment.
The notion of dying, in this case, seemed to be a form of immense relief and joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 846: Master Xiaoyao
paragraphs: [Acquired D-level Achievement Medal: You gained Murong Longcheng’s recognition.]
[Acquired D-level Achievement Medal: You gained Duan Siping’s recognition.]

[Note: The two have been enslaved for years by the Void Nether Soul Zombies and kept alive as puppets, their lives no longer themselves, longing for death to end their exhaustion. Yet their fate isn’t theirs; even wishing for death is hard. You fulfilled their wish! They are sincerely grateful to you!]
The long-awaited notification sound echoed.
Ding Ling’s heart stirred, realizing that Little Mountain Sea was indeed correct.
Murong Longcheng and Duan Siping had truly become puppets.
But it seemed they retained spiritual awareness!
Their actions were just beyond their control!
Several years ago, Duan Siping woke up momentarily, thanks to Little Mountain Sea’s hidden efforts, stopping the abyssal flood and letting Duan Siping regain his spiritual awareness briefly.
That moment allowed Ding Ling to escape death.
“Murong Longcheng and Duan Siping still have spiritual awareness; their souls must have been speaking when they passed away. Is there Six Paths of Reincarnation in this world?”
Ding Ling couldn’t be sure.
If there are.
The future may hold a chance for another meeting.
If not.
Murong Longcheng and Duan Siping are destined to fade into nothingness, their traces never to be found.
Tap tap!
Ding Ling continued forward, reaching the door and pushing it.
The door was unimaginably thick.
Without Shattering Level strength, opening it was impossible.
Ding Ling applied slight force, and the door opened with a rumble, revealing the cosmos within.
It was a Little World within a Grotto Heaven.
Spanning an area equivalent to seven or eight cities, Ding Ling’s Divine Meditation Technique covered it, yet couldn’t fully encompass the Grotto Heaven within the palace.
Note the Divine Meditation Technique’s 3D overlay can cover fifty miles of this realm.
The Celestial Dragon Plane spans 200 miles.
The Valley of Eternal Spring’s Earth Realm is even more fortified, covering only 100 miles, yet the wall of this Celestial Court surpasses even the Valley of Eternal Spring’s Earth Realm in strength!
Hence, it could only cover fifty miles.
But even so.
It was sufficient.
Ding Ling activated Spiritual Eye, Heaven-Reaching Ear.
He roughly perceived the layout within the Grotto Heaven.
At the entrance stood rows of nine-foot strongmen.
These strongmen dressed identically to Murong Longcheng and Duan Siping.
A rough count revealed tens of thousands.
“Who are they?”
“They should be Celestial Soldiers and Generals of ancient Celestial Court.”
“Oh?”
Ding Ling contemplated.
He had encountered similar situations in the Wind and Cloud World, where countless Celestial Soldiers and Generals were also present in the Demon Realm, all corrupted by Demon Qi.
Yet, the Celestial Soldiers and Generals before him were transformed into puppets by Void Nether Soul Zombies instead of being corroded by Demon Qi!
Each seemed to have spiritual awareness, but was beyond control, just like Duan Siping and Murong Longcheng.
Ding Ling sighed inwardly.
Since they were puppets.
They were beyond saving.
Ding Ling advanced, striking them with palm after palm.
His strength was overwhelming; with each palm strike, these puppets exploded with a bang.
Tens upon tens of strikes fell!
Boom boom boom!
With each strike, covering a kilometer radius, thousands of puppets reduced to ashes!
With just a dozen strikes, all Celestial Soldiers and Generals were gone.
“Finally liberated!”
“Thank you, little brother, for fulfilling us!”
“Thank you!”
Faintly, Ding Ling seemed to hear many gratitude-filled voices around him.
Ding Ling realized it might not be an illusion; perhaps it was truly their souls speaking.
Yet Ding Ling’s Sword Spirit, born with Spiritual Eyes, could pierce through Netherworld and Ghost Souls, saw no spirits here, his heart filled with uncertainty.
Nonetheless, Ding Ling didn’t ponder much and continued forward.

The Celestial Soldiers and Generals’ strength matched those from the Wind and Cloud World, but at Shattering Level, they were far inferior to Ding Ling, whose Martial Dao True Understanding integrated Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Holy Heart Technique, Inner Canon of Huangdi, Great Sun Buddha Technique, possessing a power that restrained evil.
This accounted for his palm power’s invincibility.
Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding matched with Heaven-Flipping Palm, the bane of these puppets!
Additionally, the sapling’s faint light also had the ability to restrain and suppress evil spirits and puppets, ensuring Ding Ling’s unimpeded advance.
He progressed quickly.
Decimated the million Celestial Soldiers and Generals guarding the Grotto Heaven World.
Such a large force, any given Celestial General could easily annihilate everyone in the Celestial Dragon Plane!
Simply because the Celestial Dragon Plane’s limits were at High-tier Grandmaster, difficult to advance further.
Unless someone like Ding Ling, who could effortlessly shatter space, lent his full support, it was impossible to surpass High-tier Grandmaster.
And here all Celestial Soldiers and Generals exceeded High-tier Grandmaster in strength.
Before Ding Ling appeared, these individuals could easily throw Jianghu into turmoil, disrupting peace.
“Void Nether Soul Zombies are ahead.”
Little Mountain Sea’s voice rang sharp, the sapling’s faint light pointing toward the left front.
Ding Ling accelerated forward, taking a step, mountains and rivers flowing beneath his feet, swiftly reaching the Grotto Heaven World’s end.
There.
Ding Ling saw densely packed, lifelike human statues with vibrant Spiritual Qi.
“There they are. They’re the Void Nether Soul Zombies.”
“Strange.”
Ding Ling was puzzled.
How could statues become Void Nether Soul Zombies? But it didn’t stop him from acting; he raised his palm, about to strike, when a sword suddenly thrust sideways.
Clang!

The golden sword suspended at the side immediately clashed with the blade, resounding sharply across Celestial Extreme; upon closer inspection, Ding Ling saw his golden sword sent flying ten meters away.
Ding Ling felt slightly surprised, turning his gaze.
He saw, not far away, a graceful and elegant young man standing.
He wielded a sharp sword, looking at Ding Ling with shock and disbelief.
“Master Xiaoyao.”
Little Mountain Sea spoke.
Clearly, the young man couldn’t hear Little Mountain Sea, merely staring resolutely at Ding Ling:
“Who are you?!”
“Are you Master Xiaoyao?”
Ding Ling paused, scrutinizing Master Xiaoyao, his demeanor like jade, exuding carefree energy remarkably similar to the stone monument’s image from years ago.
But the difference was, Master Xiaoyao before him was evidently more darkened, powerful.
“You recognize me.”
Master Xiaoyao was even more astonished:
“I don’t recall having such a powerful figure in the human realm!”
“You indeed survived.”
Ding Ling stated:

“You consumed the first sip of Life Source Qi stored for countless years by Fountain of Youth and Immortal Tree; your lifespan extends for ten thousand years. Decades alone couldn’t erase such a lengthy longevity.”
Ding Ling knew this, naturally told by Little Mountain Sea.
Only Master Xiaoyao, having taken the first sip of Fountain of Youth, Immortal Tree Bark, possessed such an effect.
Subsequent consumption lacked this miraculous ability.

chapters.title: Chapter 847: A Sword Shatters Ten Thousand
paragraphs: “Since you know me, you must be from the human realm.”
Master Xiaoyao looked Ding Ling up and down, speaking with some uncertainty:

“The shackles of the human realm are extremely strong. I’ve consumed the bark of the Immortal Tree and drunk the water from the Fountain of Youth, yet I can’t break such shackles. How did you break them? And, how have you cultivated to such an astonishing Martial Arts Realm?!”
He couldn’t believe it:
‘Is it really possible to become so strong just by practicing martial arts?! Are you not a cultivator?!’
“So, you’re a cultivator then.”
Seeing the unique aura surrounding Master Xiaoyao, Ding Ling speculated a bit:
“Did you actively align with the Void Nether Soul Zombie? Is that why you’re not enslaved?”
“Hmph.”
Master Xiaoyao snorted coldly, saying:

“You are indeed unbelievably powerful. Even millions of Celestial Soldiers and Generals have been annihilated by you. I believe I am no match for you. You can kill or torture me as you please. I just want to warn you of one thing. The Void Nether Soul Zombie is far stronger than you and I can imagine. You can’t possibly be his match.”
“That’s not your concern.”
Ding Ling thrust his hand forward with a booming sound!
Heaven-Flipping Palm!
All Things Return to Void!
With the Heaven-Flipping Palm unleashed, a gigantic handprint, thousands of feet in size, pressed down directly on the humanoid statue formed by the Void Nether Soul Zombie.
Master Xiaoyao tried to stop it from the side but was suppressed immovable by the immense force, nearly suffocating to death!
He was astounded, secretly thinking:

“Who is this young man?! So incredibly strong, slaying Celestial Soldiers and Generals like dogs. To kill me, it would probably just be a whim! I couldn’t stop him at all. Alas. It seems I am about to perish.”
His life was tied to the infant body of the Void Nether Soul Zombie.
No matter if one of the infant body dies.
He could not survive.
Now, these dense and numerously tens of thousands of infant bodies have died.
His death was already in countdown mode.
Thinking of death.

Master Xiaoyao felt very unwilling; he had survived in a disgraceful way for decades, done the most humiliating and acerbic things for sake of longevity, not expecting to fall into this step eventually.
If I had known earlier.
He would have been a heroic figure like Duan Siping or Murong Longcheng! At least he would have fought gloriously, without regrets!
Just as he was pondering.
He saw in the thunderous blast sound, each and every infant body of the Void Nether Soul Zombie getting exploded and annihilated.
A rotten and poisonous stream of Void Nether Qi leaked out from within!
This Qi is invisible to the naked eye.
But Master Xiaoyao, being bound with the infant bodies, could see it clearly!
He knew that what was just destroyed was only the parasite; now it was the real infant body!
“There should be hope, right?”
Master Xiaoyao saw the infant bodies screaming and roaring as they rushed toward Ding Ling, drowning him, and spontaneously gave birth to a bit of hope in his heart:
“As long as the infant body isn’t dead, I can survive.”
For decades.
Initially, Master Xiaoyao had some vigor, but after severe torment over such long years alongside the Void Nether Soul Zombie day and night, his entire mentality and soul had been distorted.
His eyes fixed on Ding Ling, his face unconsciously began to twist, he tightly grasped the sword in his hand, ready to strike at Ding Ling at any moment!
“Better him dead than me. Young man, if you can’t kill the Void Nether Soul Zombie, then you deserve to be killed by them, by me!”
While thinking this way, suddenly heard a booming sound!
Looking again.
Ding Ling was holding a Divine Sword, stabbing out, and wherever it went, all infant bodies were obliterated!
It was as if piercing through bubbles one by one.
Only the crackling sound echoed past his ears.
Master Xiaoyao saw clearly, almost tens of thousands of infant bodies were quickly perishing and shattering.
“Really killed them?!”
“And killed tens of thousands of infant bodies in an instant!”
“What sword skill is this?! To possess such power?!”

Master Xiaoyao’s body trembled greatly, feeling both disbelief and taking a deep breath, he couldn’t believe it; only a few decades have passed in the human realm, how could it have given rise to such a majestic and supreme-level figure?!
“Beyond terrifying!”
‘Had I known earlier, the human realm would eventually give birth to such an extraordinary talent. Why bother coming to the Celestial Court?! Wouldn’t it have been better to stay in the human realm?’
Master Xiaoyao felt very annoyed, regretful, and mournful.
But alas, there was no medicine for regret in the world.
Nor did he possess eyes that could see through the future. Otherwise, he certainly wouldn’t have done such a foolish thing.
Crack!
A piece of flesh suddenly fell from his foot.
Then, the crackling sound kept ringing.
But now his entire body started to crumble.
“Really going to die, huh?”
When both his legs were entirely annihilated, his upper body also fell to the ground, he supported himself with his hands, looked towards Ding Ling, and shouted:
“Young man, what’s your name? Can you tell me?”
“Ding Ling.”
“Ding Ling? Good name!”

Master Xiaoyao, a person’s dying words, kind; the ‘lifeline’ bound with the infant body began to burn rapidly, his mind cleared a lot, the whole person seemed to return to decades ago, back to that unrestrained, carefree age:
“Have you seen Li Canghai, Wu Xingyun, Li Qiushui, and Wuya Zi?”
“Yes.”
“Oh?”
Master Xiaoyao laughed heartily:
“I knew it. As my disciple, their talents were extremely outstanding; how could they possibly remain unknown? Can you give me a brief overview of their situations?”
Ding Ling glanced at Master Xiaoyao.
His upper body had already decayed to the chest; once it decayed to the head, he would completely disperse like smoke, so he picked good things to say.
And he mentioned he was friends with the Heavenly Mountain Granny and Li Canghai!
“Hahaha...”
Master Xiaoyao laughed heartily:

“Before dying and perishing, hearing news of my disciples, I can die without regrets! Ding Ling, be cautious, the main body of the Void Nether Soul Zombie is everywhere, extremely formidable; what you killed were just a batch of infant bodies it’s cultivating. Never be careless!”
He had already decayed to the neck, could no longer speak, only silently mouthed a few words.
Then glanced at Ding Ling twice, seeming reluctant, seeming nostalgic, seeming unwilling.
As his entire head decayed and dispersed.
This person, Master Xiaoyao.
Thus vanished into smoke and mist, as if he never existed in this world.
“Master Xiaoyao.”
Ding Ling shook his head, sighed with respect; towards Master Xiaoyao, he admired and respected him, but with his perceptive skills being so strong, he also detected Master Xiaoyao’s intent to kill.
If it weren’t for this, perhaps when dealing with the infant bodies, he would’ve tried to see if he could save Master Xiaoyao.
But Master Xiaoyao had chosen to oppose him, leaving Ding Ling no choice but to disregard him.

sentences.text: “Since you know me, you must be from the human realm.”
Master Xiaoyao looked Ding Ling up and down, speaking with some uncertainty:
“The shackles of the human realm are extremely strong.
I’ve consumed the bark of the Immortal Tree and drunk the water from the Fountain of Youth, yet I can’t break such shackles.
How did you break them?
And, how have you cultivated to such an astonishing Martial Arts Realm?!”
He couldn’t believe it:
‘Is it really possible to become so strong just by practicing martial arts?!
Are you not a cultivator?!’
“So, you’re a cultivator then.”
Seeing the unique aura surrounding Master Xiaoyao, Ding Ling speculated a bit:
“Did you actively align with the Void Nether Soul Zombie?
Is that why you’re not enslaved?”
“Hmph.”
Master Xiaoyao snorted coldly, saying:
“You are indeed unbelievably powerful.
Even millions of Celestial Soldiers and Generals have been annihilated by you.
I believe I am no match for you.
You can kill or torture me as you please.
I just want to warn you of one thing.
The Void Nether Soul Zombie is far stronger than you and I can imagine.
You can’t possibly be his match.”
“That’s not your concern.”
Ding Ling thrust his hand forward with a booming sound!
Heaven-Flipping Palm!
All Things Return to Void!
With the Heaven-Flipping Palm unleashed, a gigantic handprint, thousands of feet in size, pressed down directly on the humanoid statue formed by the Void Nether Soul Zombie.
Master Xiaoyao tried to stop it from the side but was suppressed immovable by the immense force, nearly suffocating to death!
He was astounded, secretly thinking:
“Who is this young man?!
So incredibly strong, slaying Celestial Soldiers and Generals like dogs.
To kill me, it would probably just be a whim!
I couldn’t stop him at all.
Alas.
It seems I am about to perish.”
His life was tied to the infant body of the Void Nether Soul Zombie.
No matter if one of the infant body dies.
He could not survive.
Now, these dense and numerously tens of thousands of infant bodies have died.
His death was already in countdown mode.
Thinking of death.

Master Xiaoyao felt very unwilling; he had survived in a disgraceful way for decades, done the most humiliating and acerbic things for sake of longevity, not expecting to fall into this step eventually.
If I had known earlier.
He would have been a heroic figure like Duan Siping or Murong Longcheng!
At least he would have fought gloriously, without regrets!
Just as he was pondering.
He saw in the thunderous blast sound, each and every infant body of the Void Nether Soul Zombie getting exploded and annihilated.
A rotten and poisonous stream of Void Nether Qi leaked out from within!
This Qi is invisible to the naked eye.
But Master Xiaoyao, being bound with the infant bodies, could see it clearly!
He knew that what was just destroyed was only the parasite; now it was the real infant body!
“There should be hope, right?”
Master Xiaoyao saw the infant bodies screaming and roaring as they rushed toward Ding Ling, drowning him, and spontaneously gave birth to a bit of hope in his heart:
“As long as the infant body isn’t dead, I can survive.”
For decades.
Initially, Master Xiaoyao had some vigor, but after severe torment over such long years alongside the Void Nether Soul Zombie day and night, his entire mentality and soul had been distorted.
His eyes fixed on Ding Ling, his face unconsciously began to twist, he tightly grasped the sword in his hand, ready to strike at Ding Ling at any moment!
“Better him dead than me.
Young man, if you can’t kill the Void Nether Soul Zombie, then you deserve to be killed by them, by me!”
While thinking this way, suddenly heard a booming sound!
Looking again.
Ding Ling was holding a Divine Sword, stabbing out, and wherever it went, all infant bodies were obliterated!
It was as if piercing through bubbles one by one.
Only the crackling sound echoed past his ears.
Master Xiaoyao saw clearly, almost tens of thousands of infant bodies were quickly perishing and shattering.
“Really killed them?!”
“And killed tens of thousands of infant bodies in an instant!”
“What sword skill is this?!
To possess such power?!”

Master Xiaoyao’s body trembled greatly, feeling both disbelief and taking a deep breath, he couldn’t believe it; only a few decades have passed in the human realm, how could it have given rise to such a majestic and supreme-level figure?!
“Beyond terrifying!”
