chapters.title: Chapter 848: Power Surging
paragraphs: And Ding Ling ignored the outcome.
Which led to Master Xiaoyao’s swift demise.
“He has bonded his life line with the young body of the Void Nether Soul Zombie.”
Little Mountain Sea said crisply:
‘It’s extremely difficult to sever this life line. And Master Xiaoyao’s intellect has been corrupted. Even if we save him, it’s useless. Ding Ling, you don’t need to be sad.’
“I’m not sad.”
Ding Ling replied:
“I’m just lamenting the fickle nature of the world.”
At this moment, Ding Ling further realized the importance of having superior cultivation.
If not, even someone with extraordinary experiences like Master Xiaoyao.
The final result might just be becoming a pawn in others’ hands.
Thinking about it.
Who has better luck and experiences than Master Xiaoyao in the Celestial Dragon Plane?
Almost no one!

Duan Yu, Xuzhwu, and others are also considered the children of the plane, with great luck, but in front of Master Xiaoyao, who has drunk from the Fountain of Youth, obtained the Immortal Tree Bark, and learned the Eternal Youth Technique, their luck seems insignificant.
Yet such a divine-level character also perished here.
Ding Ling shook his head, sighed, and then accelerated through the group of young bodies.

With a golden sword in hand, the Breaking Technique Sword was unleashed, with the added spirit of Sword Spirit and Little Mountain Sea, wherever he passed, it was as if Buddha Light purified Demon Qi, all the young bodies were quickly annihilated and destroyed.
“Ahhh, it feels so good, so good.”
For every young body slain.
The spirit would automatically absorb a very special strand of World Qi.
This Qi, Ding Ling couldn’t see, only vaguely sensed one or two, but even just sensing it is greatly beneficial to him.
Simply because from this World Qi, he found the direction to create a world.
“Previously seeing how strong Nanhua Old Immortal’s Inner Heaven and Earth was, now it seems that Nanhua Old Immortal might just have formed his Inner Heaven and Earth by observing World Qi.”
As for whom Nanhua Old Immortal got the World Qi from?
With a master behind him, does Nanhua Old Immortal even need to worry about resources?
And now Ding Ling can observe this Qi with the help of Little Mountain Sea.

Little Mountain Sea seemed to know what Ding Ling wanted to do, extremely cooperative with Ding Ling in the process of devouring and refining World Qi, actively shared it with Ding Ling, allowing him to gain more and more insights into refining World Qi!
Especially with the library assistance.
After observing for a while.
In an instant.
[Full Level World Qi Refinement Method]
Soon.
Ding Ling comprehended the details within.
He sighed inwardly, with such cheats around him, if he still couldn’t achieve greatness, he couldn’t forgive himself!
“Having gained the refinement method, but I can’t refine it now because my cultivation is insufficient.”
To refine World Qi.
Unless strength reaches Martial Arts Dharma Level. Only at this level can one truly refine their own World Qi, thereby condensing their own Grotto Heaven World.
“So, does this mean Nanhua Old Immortal’s World Qi isn’t his own? Purely gifted by others?”
Ding Ling pondered.
Relying on gifted World Qi, the Inner Heaven and Earth’s potential developed from it is limited, it cannot further advance.
Naturally, Ding Ling doesn’t want that.
His goal isn’t merely the Martial Arts Dharma Level, he aims to become immortal!
“Although I can’t refine World Qi, the young bodies contain extremely abundant Spiritual Vitality, which I can still refine.”
This Qi.
Little Mountain Sea doesn’t need it.
She only needs to refine World Qi.
Ding Ling unceremoniously absorbed and refined all these Qi one by one.
[Inner Power Value +10]
[Inner Power Value +10]
Over these years, Ding Ling’s strength has been constantly growing, his True Qi becoming increasingly tenacious and orderly, frighteningly so!
But his True Power Value has been stuck at 351 points.
Meaning his strength keeps rising, but his cultivation realm remains unchanged!
And now with the continuous absorption of this pure Spiritual Vitality.
Ding Ling’s True Power Value began to rise steadily.
[Inner Power Value +5]
[Inner Power Value +5]
Ding Ling instantly broke through a thousand young bodies.
Killing the Void Nether Soul Zombie was like slaughtering chickens.
He didn’t find the Void Nether Soul Zombie particularly difficult to kill.
Ultimately, it’s thanks to his exceptionally unique Martial Dao True Understanding, coupled with the coordination of Little Mountain Sea and Sword Spirit, that it went so smoothly!
Switching to other experts of the same level might only lead to destruction or enslavement.
Bam bam bam!
All the way killing.
After exterminating all young bodies.
[Inner Power Value +9000]
[True Power Value: 381 points]
Directly increased by 30 points.
Quite impressive.
Note that in the Lower Realm for so many years, Ding Ling’s True Power Value hasn’t increased at all.
Regular Great Medicine is useless to him.

And the Spiritual Vitality in the Lower Realm is extremely barren, its quality far inferior to the Upper Realm, unless Ding Ling drained a whole region’s Spiritual Vitality, it’s difficult to really achieve an increase in True Power Value.

Exactly because of this, he chose to practice martial arts with Diao Chan and others, because cultivating with them is much faster in raising cultivation than absorbing the barren vitality of the Lower Realm.
Improving True Qi’s level and quality can also double attack power and combat strength.
Ding Ling knew what choice to make.
And now these young bodies seem like extraordinary Great Medicine.
Even though refining them later resulted in ‘resistance’, reducing efficacy, but refining groups still provided Inner Power Value.
“Burp.”
Little Mountain Sea seemed full, burped.
The palm-sized sapling transformed into a seven-foot tall small tree in emerald green.
The transformation was extremely obvious.
“Big Brother, we can go to the Lower Realm Abyss now.”
Little Mountain Sea was very excited:
“After killing all the Void Nether Soul Zombies, I can transform!”
She was very surprised:

“Big Brother, I didn’t expect you to be so formidable! Your kung fu is incredibly strong. You restrain these Void Nether Soul Zombies death-stiff. My Divine Techniques don’t have the restraint strength of your Divine Skill.”
Ding Ling smiled, said nothing.
His Divine Skill is a fusion of several worlds’ Supreme Skill, Confucianism, Daoism, and Buddhist Study, combining the advantages of Vast Righteous Qi, Buddha Qi, Yin and Yang Qi, etc.!
Truly a nemesis of all evil spirits and specters!
And this is just version 1.0.
It only suppresses the netherworld ghosts below immortals. When it evolves to version 2.0, it will be able to suppress Ghost Immortal Level experts!
“Let’s go.”
Ding Ling stepped out of the Grotto Heaven World, arriving at the palace entrance.
He glanced at this world one last time, without hesitation, floated out of the Celestial Court’s Hongyuan.
Duan Siping.
Murong Longcheng.
Master Xiaoyao.
These three exceptional experts of the Celestial Dragon Plane, their legendary deeds will also be completely buried here, never to be known again.
Moments later.
Ding Ling reached the Immortal Tree beside the Valley of Eternal Spring.
He placed the sapling beside the Immortal Tree.
The Immortal Tree immediately lowered a branch, wrapping the sapling up, and the next moment, boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 849: The Tribe in the Abyss
paragraphs: A surge of extremely mysterious and profound energy erupted from the Immortal Tree.
This energy fell upon Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s True Qi level seemed to have been refined.
Not only did it become purer, but there was also an addition of an extremely special Power of Life, which was enough to multiply Ding Ling’s recovery and endurance!
“What is this?!”
“This is my gift to big brother.”
Little Mountain Sea shook its head full of leaves and said crisply:

“Every time I get enhanced, a surge of extremely pure energy overflows. This energy adheres to the Fountain of Youth or the surface of my body. Therefore, anyone who takes the first sip of the Fountain of Youth or eats the bark will undergo a great transformation. But they only increase their lifespan. Big brother is being actively rewarded with this energy by me.
Not only will his lifespan increase, but his True Qi Quality will also become purer, making big brother’s foundation much thicker, and the future realms he can reach will surely be higher!”
“I see.”
Ding Ling was moved and said:
“Thank you!”
He had been curious about why the Water of Eternal Youth and the bark of the Immortal Tree had such miraculous effects.
Now he understood completely. It all stems from this!
The Immortal Tree must grow and transform to overflow with some special energy.
And this time, the Immortal Tree’s transformation was more intense, causing energy to overflow and instantly increase Ding Ling’s lifespan by ten thousand years!
Ding Ling’s lifespan now increased to more than forty thousand years!
That’s a terrifying number.
The ancient civilization spanning five thousand years has already been admired and eyed by the world.
Ding Ling could live for more than forty thousand years!
But he was not satisfied with this; his goal is true immortality—not to live for forty thousand years and then face death again!

“Brother is too kind. If it weren’t for you helping me, I wouldn’t have been able to advance again this quickly. There’s a high chance I would have completely vanished and died under the corrosion of the Abyss flood. It’s big brother who saved me. Big brother is my benefactor, and I will follow big brother from now on.”
Ding Ling smiled and asked:
“Shall we go to the Abyss now?”
“Sure.”
Little Mountain Sea shook its body and ‘spit’ out a more crystal-clear small sapling.
This small sapling was smaller than the previous one, but the light it emitted was gentler.
According to Little Mountain Sea, the strength of this small sapling is twice as much as the previous one, allowing it to better assist Ding Ling in refining the World Qi more quickly.
“Let’s go.”
Holding the small sapling, Ding Ling took a step forward and arrived above the Abyss, looking down.
The flood roared, and Sword Qi surged!
Strands of dim light formed a net or array, working with Sword Qi to fully suppress those strands of decaying, highly toxic Void Nether Qi.
This was the Qi emanating from the Void Nether Soul Zombie Body.
Clang, clang!
The Qi caused the suspended Golden Sword beside Ding Ling to tremble, instinctively showing hostility towards the Void Nether Qi.
The Golden Sword had gained such spirituality that it caught Ding Ling’s attention.
However, he didn’t think much and delved into the flood.
With the small sapling leading the way.
The wondrous array and Sword Qi avoided Ding Ling, not harming him; instead, they protected him in every way.
Ding Ling marveled inwardly.
The array must be controlled by Little Mountain Sea from behind the scenes.
But the Sword Qi also protects him?
He couldn’t understand.
Could it be because of the Golden Sword?
Yes.
This Golden Sword was refined by Lü Dongbin, expending his Primordial Spirit, blood, and energy.
It is greatly aligned with the Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array hidden in the Abyss flood!
And the Golden Sword has now recognized Ding Ling as its master.
The Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array naturally will not harm Ding Ling.
The deeper Ding Ling went, the more he marveled at the enormity of the Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array.
It nearly sealed the entire Abyss.
As he stepped through the Life Gate of the Sword Array, delving into the flood.
Ding Ling looked up, seemingly seeing eight silhouettes guarding the Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array.
Their forms and temperaments were all different, but without exception, they had the determination and courage to subdue demons, sacrifice for all beings, and the world!
“Are those the Eight Immortals?”
“Yes, big brother. They have died, but their obsession refuses to disperse. Also, thanks to their obsession, without it, I might not have survived until big brother came to see me.”
Hearing Little Mountain Sea say this.
Ding Ling felt ashamed.
He believed the words of Heavenly Mountain Granny, Xiao Feng, and the others.
Thinking the Valley of Eternal Spring could last a few more years.
But now it seems that Xiao Feng and the others estimated wrongly.

After all, although Xiao Feng and the others’ cultivation strength has increased considerably over the years, they are only at Grandmaster Level. How can they precisely calculate the floating level and speed of such an unfathomable Abyss?
Swish, swish!
Ding Ling stopped worrying and dived lower.
Soon.
He reached the Bottom of the Abyss.
Here he saw clusters of tribes!
Among the tribes, there were men and women, old and young.
Each one’s form resembled humans; men handsome as gods, women graceful as fairies, all unlike those in the Mortal World.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, they all drew the swords and knives from their waists without speaking, silently charging towards Ding Ling.
Bang, bang, bang!

When they were a thousand feet from Ding Ling, they struck with their swords, wielded their blades, and suddenly, Sword Qi and blade Qi surged like a sea, sweeping in with the waves, as if to completely overwhelm Ding Ling!
“These are the adult Void Nether Soul Zombies, then?”

Ding Ling grasped into the void, holding the Golden Sword, launching the Breaking Technique Sword. In an instant, streams of Sword Light within the flood condensed into a Sword River capable of breaking through everything. Ding Ling stepped onto the Sword River, swiftly charging ahead!
Compared to the flood, Sword River appeared quite small.
But it seemed like an all-piercing golden needle, moving upstream!
Everything it passed through was forcefully pierced and shattered!
The Breaking Technique Sword, as the name implies!
Can break all techniques!

No matter how strong the technique of the Void Nether Soul Zombies is, if they do not exceed the level of the Martial Dao True Understanding Breaking Technique Sword, they will only be broken by the Breaking Technique Sword!
As Sword Light gleamed and shimmered!
The Sword Qi from the Golden Sword swept out freely!
Quickly breaking through the enemy’s blade Qi and Sword Qi flood, reaching the Void Nether Soul Zombies upfront, clank!
Then the slaughter began.
Like chopping melons and vegetables.
With each swing, Ding Ling slayed one, rampaging among them, and in just moments, over a hundred adult Void Nether Soul Zombies were killed.

“They’re indeed strong. Each one’s strength has reached the Martial Arts Golden Core Level! Some can even rival the Initial Tier of First-Grade Primordial Spirit experts. Such experts can dominate in the Wind and Cloud World; Demon King Poxun is likely no more than this!”
“Yet here they gather in droves!”
Ding Ling let out a long whistle, fully deploying the Breaking Technique Sword.
Bang!
A single sword strike, myriad swords rushing forth, and in the blink of an eye, engulfed thousands of densely packed Void Nether Soul Zombies ahead.
Bang, bang, bang!
Each Void Nether Soul Zombie was torn apart in shape by the Sword Qi of the Breaking Technique Sword, revealing their true forms!

sentences.text: A surge of extremely mysterious and profound energy erupted from the Immortal Tree.
This energy fell upon Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s True Qi level seemed to have been refined.
Not only did it become purer, but there was also an addition of an extremely special Power of Life, which was enough to multiply Ding Ling’s recovery and endurance!
“What is this?!”
“This is my gift to big brother.”
Little Mountain Sea shook its head full of leaves and said crisply:
“Every time I get enhanced, a surge of extremely pure energy overflows.
This energy adheres to the Fountain of Youth or the surface of my body.
Therefore, anyone who takes the first sip of the Fountain of Youth or eats the bark will undergo a great transformation.
But they only increase their lifespan.
Big brother is being actively rewarded with this energy by me.
Not only will his lifespan increase, but his True Qi Quality will also become purer, making big brother’s foundation much thicker, and the future realms he can reach will surely be higher!”
“I see.”
Ding Ling was moved and said:
“Thank you!”
He had been curious about why the Water of Eternal Youth and the bark of the Immortal Tree had such miraculous effects.
Now he understood completely.
It all stems from this!
The Immortal Tree must grow and transform to overflow with some special energy.
And this time, the Immortal Tree’s transformation was more intense, causing energy to overflow and instantly increase Ding Ling’s lifespan by ten thousand years!
Ding Ling’s lifespan now increased to more than forty thousand years!
That’s a terrifying number.
The ancient civilization spanning five thousand years has already been admired and eyed by the world.
Ding Ling could live for more than forty thousand years!
But he was not satisfied with this; his goal is true immortality—not to live for forty thousand years and then face death again!
“Brother is too kind.
If it weren’t for you helping me, I wouldn’t have been able to advance again this quickly.
There’s a high chance I would have completely vanished and died under the corrosion of the Abyss flood.
It’s big brother who saved me.
Big brother is my benefactor, and I will follow big brother from now on.”
Ding Ling smiled and asked:
“Shall we go to the Abyss now?”
“Sure.”
Little Mountain Sea shook its body and ‘spit’ out a more crystal-clear small sapling.
This small sapling was smaller than the previous one, but the light it emitted was gentler.
According to Little Mountain Sea, the strength of this small sapling is twice as much as the previous one, allowing it to better assist Ding Ling in refining the World Qi more quickly.
“Let’s go.”
Holding the small sapling, Ding Ling took a step forward and arrived above the Abyss, looking down.
The flood roared, and Sword Qi surged!
Strands of dim light formed a net or array, working with Sword Qi to fully suppress those strands of decaying, highly toxic Void Nether Qi.
This was the Qi emanating from the Void Nether Soul Zombie Body.
Clang, clang!
The Qi caused the suspended Golden Sword beside Ding Ling to tremble, instinctively showing hostility towards the Void Nether Qi.
The Golden Sword had gained such spirituality that it caught Ding Ling’s attention.
However, he didn’t think much and delved into the flood.
With the small sapling leading the way.
The wondrous array and Sword Qi avoided Ding Ling, not harming him; instead, they protected him in every way.
Ding Ling marveled inwardly.
The array must be controlled by Little Mountain Sea from behind the scenes.
But the Sword Qi also protects him?
He couldn’t understand.
Could it be because of the Golden Sword?
Yes.
This Golden Sword was refined by Lü Dongbin, expending his Primordial Spirit, blood, and energy.
It is greatly aligned with the Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array hidden in the Abyss flood!
And the Golden Sword has now recognized Ding Ling as its master.
The Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array naturally will not harm Ding Ling.
The deeper Ding Ling went, the more he marveled at the enormity of the Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array.
It nearly sealed the entire Abyss.
As he stepped through the Life Gate of the Sword Array, delving into the flood.
Ding Ling looked up, seemingly seeing eight silhouettes guarding the Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array.
Their forms and temperaments were all different, but without exception, they had the determination and courage to subdue demons, sacrifice for all beings, and the world!
“Are those the Eight Immortals?”
“Yes, big brother.
They have died, but their obsession refuses to disperse.
Also, thanks to their obsession, without it, I might not have survived until big brother came to see me.”
Hearing Little Mountain Sea say this.
Ding Ling felt ashamed.
He believed the words of Heavenly Mountain Granny, Xiao Feng, and the others.
Thinking the Valley of Eternal Spring could last a few more years.
But now it seems that Xiao Feng and the others estimated wrongly.
After all, although Xiao Feng and the others’ cultivation strength has increased considerably over the years, they are only at Grandmaster Level.
How can they precisely calculate the floating level and speed of such an unfathomable Abyss?
Swish, swish!
Ding Ling stopped worrying and dived lower.
Soon.
He reached the Bottom of the Abyss.
Here he saw clusters of tribes!
Among the tribes, there were men and women, old and young.
Each one’s form resembled humans; men handsome as gods, women graceful as fairies, all unlike those in the Mortal World.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, they all drew the swords and knives from their waists without speaking, silently charging towards Ding Ling.
Bang, bang, bang!

When they were a thousand feet from Ding Ling, they struck with their swords, wielded their blades, and suddenly, Sword Qi and blade Qi surged like a sea, sweeping in with the waves, as if to completely overwhelm Ding Ling!
“These are the adult Void Nether Soul Zombies, then?”
Ding Ling grasped into the void, holding the Golden Sword, launching the Breaking Technique Sword.
In an instant, streams of Sword Light within the flood condensed into a Sword River capable of breaking through everything.
Ding Ling stepped onto the Sword River, swiftly charging ahead!
Compared to the flood, Sword River appeared quite small.
But it seemed like an all-piercing golden needle, moving upstream!
Everything it passed through was forcefully pierced and shattered!
The Breaking Technique Sword, as the name implies!
Can break all techniques!

No matter how strong the technique of the Void Nether Soul Zombies is, if they do not exceed the level of the Martial Dao True Understanding Breaking Technique Sword, they will only be broken by the Breaking Technique Sword!
As Sword Light gleamed and shimmered!
The Sword Qi from the Golden Sword swept out freely!
Quickly breaking through the enemy’s blade Qi and Sword Qi flood, reaching the Void Nether Soul Zombies upfront, clank!

chapters.title: Chapter 850: Saint-Grade Golden Core Extreme Realm
paragraphs: The essence of the Void Nether Soul Zombie is one of decay and toxic Void Nether Qi.
This Qi is invisible and intangible, with no trace or clue, unseen by the naked eye and difficult to sense spiritually.
For ordinary Martial Dao Primordial Spirit experts who come here, facing such Qi, they are left in the dark, passively taking hits!
But Ding Ling is different.

His Sword Spirit is born with a pair of Spiritual Eyes, and combined with the constant reflection of the Ten Directions Realm by the Divine Meditation Technique, he can roughly sense the general position of this Qi.
Moreover, the sapling’s faint light illuminates this land, making the Void Nether Qi have nowhere to hide!
In other words,
The sapling is also a nemesis of the Void Nether Qi.
Wherever the sapling’s light reaches, all Void Nether Qi is clearly manifested in the void.
Of course,
This clarity is relative to Ding Ling, as the sapling’s light is bestowed on him, allowing him to see what others cannot. When others come to this place, they see nothing either.
Perhaps many experts believe they have killed the Void Nether Soul Zombie by destroying its physical form, but that is not the case; they have only destroyed its outer shell.
This shell may appear human, but it’s just a layer of skin, a sculpted shell.
Ding Ling has seen the juvenile form of the Void Nether Soul Zombie and is aware of this.

He is not tempted by the appearance of the Void Nether Soul Zombie, nor is he swayed by the sight of extremely cute children or seemingly unpretentious elderly people within the zombies, as he knows these are mere facades meant to deceive the world.
“Should these Void Nether Soul Zombies enter the world, the unknowing populace would surely be deceived, leading them into an inescapable abyss!”
“Truly terrifying, where do these things originate in the Upper Realm? They should never exist in this world!”
Suddenly filled with a desire to kill, Ding Ling unleashes various Sword Skills.

With the support of the Sword Spirit, Golden Sword, and the sapling, Ding Ling moves like a bolt of lightning through a myriad of troops, causing chaos and turning over men and horses wherever he passes. All enemies are easily slain or decapitated by him!
He faces tens of thousands of densely packed Great Army alone! Yet he does not fear; instead, he grows bolder and stronger as the battle rages on!
[Inner Power Value +30]
[Inner Power Value +30]
[Inner Power Value +50]
The Spiritual Vitality within the bodies of these adult Void Nether Soul Zombies is far more intense and purer than that of the juveniles!
Each can contribute a significant amount of ‘energy’.
Ding Ling’s strength begins to soar rapidly.
Just in a short while,
[Inner Power Value +3000]
[True Power Value: 391 points!]
He’s advanced by 10 points.
Yet another short moment,
[True Power Value: 401 points.]
Ding Ling’s Cultivation Realm smoothly advances to the Saint-grade Golden Core Perfection Level!
Boom!
The power of the Sword Qi erupting from him doubles instantly. Where he once needed one sword for one First-Grade Primordial Spirit Void Nether Soul Zombie, now he can take down two or three!
Swish swish swish!
Ding Ling passes through, obliterating vastly. Despite the Void Nether Soul Zombies’ efforts to slay, annihilate, or seduce him, it is all in vain.
Ding Ling just focuses on strangling the essence, the Void Nether Qi of the Void Nether Soul Zombies!
Whoosh whoosh!
The sapling continuously absorbs and refines the World Qi, growing rapidly up to six feet tall!
And this is just the beginning.
As Ding Ling continues his slaughter,
His True Power Value unknowingly soars to 426 points!
The sapling also rises to eight feet tall!
Held in Ding Ling’s hand, it almost resembles a long spear, its emitted light solidifying almost into substance, revealing and momentarily freezing the Void Nether Soul Zombies wherever it passes!
And in that brief moment,
The passage of Ding Ling’s Sword Qi causes these Void Nether Soul Zombies to shatter.
The sapling and Ding Ling complement each other perfectly.
Together, they move through the Void Nether Soul Zombie tribe.
One immobilizes the Void Nether Soul Zombies, while the other slays them from mid-air.
Afterward, one refines the World Qi; the other refines the Spiritual Vitality!
Their combined power noticeably grows before the eye.
Unbeknownst to them,
Boom!

Ding Ling breaks through once again, his power doubling once more, his efficiency in killing further increased, instantly slaughtering five or six Initial Tier of First-Grade Primordial Spirit Void Nether Soul Zombies!
His True Power Value soars to 451 points.
“Achieved Saint-Grade Golden Core Great Perfection!”
Next is the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm.
Ding Ling feels invigorated!
Reaching this step,
Ding Ling can now easily vanquish High Tier First-Grade Primordial Spirit experts!
Those at the Initial Tier of First-Grade Primordial Spirit are dispatched in groups of five or six in an instant.
His Primordial Spirit Cultivation is highly formidable.
Whiz whiz whiz!

Ding Ling traverses the Bottom of the Abyss like a thunderbolt, surrounded by countless strands of Sword Qi, cutting through with a force like an icy Sword River sweeping by, killing off Golden Core Level experts in swathes!
Ninth-Grade Primordial Spirit experts also perish in batches!
Only the First-Grade Primordial Spirit experts manage to resist slightly longer, but once immobilized by the sapling, face an instant demise.
[Inner Power Value +30]
[Inner Power Value +30]
Ding Ling’s power and cultivation continue to rise.
The sapling grows to nine feet tall!
Reaching this point,
It can no longer grow any taller despite absorbing large amounts of World Qi, but it becomes increasingly solidified, its entire light unknowingly transforming into Aurora!
Where it passes, it sweeps like lasers, freezing groups of Void Nether Soul Zombies in place.
Ding Ling’s Sword Control and killing speed increase.
At this moment,
The Void Nether Soul Zombies finally seem to know fear.
They begin to screech, roar, and flail about helplessly, like little ghosts resisting in vain, howling at the sky!
Boom!
A Sword River erupts around Ding Ling, laying waste to everything in its path.
No matter how the Void Nether Soul Zombies howl, it is to no avail.
This massacre,
Ensues for several hours.
When Ding Ling loses count of the number of Void Nether Soul Zombies slain, Little Mountain Sea suddenly reminds him:
“Big brother, the adult Void Nether Soul Zombies have all been killed. We can go back now.”
“Oh?”
Ding Ling calms himself, scanning around.
Indeed,
The tribe in this abyss has been torn apart and left in ruins.
No trace of its previous prosperity can be seen, leaving only broken walls and scattered corpses!
Not a single intact body!
It looks quite frightening!
Those unaware might think Ding Ling to be an unmerciful executioner, a Demon King!
[Inner Power Value +12000]
[True Power Value: 491 points!]
His True Power Value increased by a full 40 points!
Ding Ling’s cultivation is now profoundly deep, reaching an Extreme Realm!
But he seems still a step away from breaking into the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit realm.
“Half-Step Primordial Spirit Realm?”
Ding Ling is thoughtful but quickly regains focus and asks:
“Where is the Void Nether Soul Zombie?”
“Once I take form, I can swallow it.”
“Oh?”
Ding Ling is surprised and curious about how Little Mountain Sea will swallow an entire world.
For as far as he knows, the Void Nether Soul Zombie encompasses the abyss flood land, and the gray, bleak Forbidden Realm beyond the high mountains of the Valley of Eternal Spring!
